### 4.3.20 Target Account (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.20-target-account}

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Buyer org that owns this record |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Console scope |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK → Evaluation Workspace | Owning workspace |
| `marketplace_domain_id` | UUID | FK → Marketplace Domain | Inherited from workspace; required for firewall isolation |
| `seller_org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | The Seller org this Target Account represents |
| `seller_display_name_snapshot` | String(128) | Not null | Snapshot of seller legal name at Target Account creation; decoupled from live Seller Profile |
| `source_type` | Enum (Appendix J `target_account_source_enum`) | Not null | `ai_discovery`, `manual_entry`, `csv_import`, `marketplace_browse`, `referral`, `sourcera_curated` |
| `source_artifact_id` | UUID | Nullable | FK target depends on `source_type`; polymorphic (Discovery Run, CSV Import Batch, Marketplace Session, Referral Invite) |
| `added_by_user_id` | UUID | FK → User | User who added the account |
| `added_at` | Timestamp | Not null | When added to workspace |
| `state` | Enum (Appendix J `target_account_state_enum`) | Not null | See Appendix L.6 state machine |
| `state_transitioned_at` | Timestamp | Not null | Timestamp of last state transition |
| `state_transitioned_by_user_id` | UUID | FK → User; nullable | Null when transition was system-driven |
| `fit_score` | Decimal(5,2) | Nullable; 0.00–100.00 | AI-generated fit score; null until Discovery scoring completes |
| `fit_score_version` | String(32) | Nullable | AI model/version that produced `fit_score` |
| `fit_score_computed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When fit score was computed |
| `disqualification_reason` | Enum (Appendix J `target_account_disqualification_enum`) | Nullable | Populated only in `disqualified` state: `no_capability_match`, `compliance_fail`, `pricing_out_of_band`, `duplicate_of_other_account`, `buyer_discretion`, `seller_declined_bid` |
| `disqualification_note` | Text(2,000) | Nullable | Free-text rationale when `disqualification_reason = buyer_discretion` or clarification of other reasons |
| `bid_workspace_id` | UUID | FK → Bid Workspace; nullable | Populated when Target Account is advanced to `solicited` (bid open) or beyond |
| `selection_report_inclusion_rank` | Integer | Nullable; ≥1 | Order in the Selection Report finalist list; populated at `finalist` state |
| `notes_markdown` | Text(10,000) | Nullable | Buyer internal notes (Markdown) |
| `tags` | Array<String(64)> | Max 20 | Buyer-assigned tags |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Not null | Row creation |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Not null | Row update |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK → User | Equals `added_by_user_id` at creation |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK → User | Last mutator |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete; tombstone behavior per §40.2 |

**Scope:** Workspace-scoped; inherits `marketplace_domain_id` from the parent Evaluation Workspace for dual-console firewall compliance (§7.2). A Target Account row never crosses marketplace domains; duplicate `seller_org_id` across workspaces is permitted.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, state)` — workspace list filtered by pipeline state
- `(workspace_id, fit_score DESC)` — fit-ranked list
- `(seller_org_id, marketplace_domain_id)` — seller-side denormalized view (Seller Console read-only via Console Bridge, never direct FK)
- `(bid_workspace_id)` WHERE `bid_workspace_id IS NOT NULL` — bid-workspace reverse lookup
- `(workspace_id, deleted_at)` — soft-delete sweep
- Unique `(workspace_id, seller_org_id)` — one Target Account per (workspace, seller) pair

**State Machine:** See Appendix L.6 Target Account Lifecycle. Terminal states: `finalist`, `disqualified`, `superseded`. `superseded` is reached when a Target Account is merged into another account on duplicate detection.

**Retention:** Workspace-life. On Evaluation Workspace archive (§4.3.11 `archived` state), Target Account rows retained with parent workspace. On Evaluation Workspace hard-delete, Target Account rows hard-deleted within 30 days per §40.2. On Org hard-delete, all Target Account rows where `org_id` = deleted org are hard-deleted within 90 days. DSAR: `added_by_user_id`, `state_transitioned_by_user_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by` pseudonymized on subject request; `notes_markdown` redacted to `[REDACTED_DSAR]` sentinel if it contains subject PII (detected via Ops review tool per §6.8.3); aggregate rows and AI score retained per §6.8.5 audit-integrity exemption.

**Relationships:** Parent = Evaluation Workspace (`workspace_id`). References User (`added_by_user_id`, `state_transitioned_by_user_id`, audit fields), Organization (`seller_org_id`), Marketplace Domain (`marketplace_domain_id`), Bid Workspace (`bid_workspace_id`), Discovery Run / CSV Import Batch / Marketplace Session / Referral Invite via polymorphic `source_artifact_id`. Is referenced by Selection Report Draft finalist roster (§4.3.21), Shortlist entries, and Fit-Score Computation Jobs.

**Authoring Intent:** Target Account is the canonical buyer-side representation of "a seller we are considering for this evaluation." It is distinct from Seller Profile (which is seller-owned and marketplace-scoped) and distinct from Bid Workspace (which is the per-seller bid transaction). The separation is required so (a) a buyer can add, annotate, and rank a seller long before opening a bid, (b) buyer-side notes and fit scores never leak into the seller's view of themselves, and (c) the Selection Report can freeze a finalist roster independent of bid lifecycle state. Full behavioral authoring — discovery-to-finalist flow, UX, notifications, AI scoring pipeline — lands in Phase 5 (Evaluation Lifecycle integration). This §4.3.20 entry is the data-model stub required for FK integrity across Phase 1.

**Failure Modes:**
1. Duplicate `(workspace_id, seller_org_id)` on concurrent add — unique index rejects second insert; UI surfaces "Already in this workspace."
2. Marketplace-domain mismatch between workspace and seller — enforced by §7.2 firewall check at write time; write rejected with `E_MARKETPLACE_DOMAIN_MISMATCH` (Appendix I).
3. `disqualification_reason` set without state transition to `disqualified` — enforced by state machine in Appendix L.6.
4. `bid_workspace_id` populated when state ∉ {`solicited`, `bidding`, `finalist`} — application-layer guard; violation logged to Audit Event §4.6.1 with severity `high`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. A Target Account can be created only within a workspace whose `marketplace_domain_id` matches the seller's `primary_marketplace_domain_id`.
2. State transitions conform strictly to Appendix L.6; no direct state mutations permitted outside the state-machine handler.
3. `fit_score` is nullable and populated asynchronously; UI treats `null` as "score pending" and never as "zero."
4. Soft-delete of a Target Account cascades to Shortlist entries but does not cascade to Bid Workspace (which becomes a pointer-only orphan, flagged in §4.4.1 Failure Modes).
5. Full feature spec (UX, notifications, AI scoring, Discovery Run integration) is deferred to Phase 5 and must replace this stub at integration time without field-level deletions.

**Integration Deferral Note — Authored Extension (requires human sign-off):** This stub was authored in Phase 1.5 to resolve dangling polymorphic FK targets (F-S-4) without full behavioral authoring. The Phase 5 integration pass replaces this §4.3.20 entry with the full Evaluation Lifecycle specification; fields listed here constitute the minimum locked schema.

### 4.3.21 Selection Report Draft (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.21-selection-report-draft}

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Buyer org |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Console scope |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK → Evaluation Workspace | Owning workspace |
| `marketplace_domain_id` | UUID | FK → Marketplace Domain | Inherited from workspace |
| `state` | Enum (Appendix J `selection_report_draft_state_enum`) | Not null | `initial`, `drafting`, `ai_generating`, `review`, `finalized`, `abandoned` |
| `version` | Integer | Not null; ≥1 | Monotonic within workspace; every save increments |
| `is_current_draft` | Boolean | Not null | Exactly one `true` per workspace where `state != finalized` |
| `author_user_id` | UUID | FK → User | Primary author |
| `collaborator_user_ids` | Array<UUID> | Max 20; FK → User | Users with edit access |
| `ai_generation_job_id` | UUID | Nullable; FK → AIOperation | Populated when `state = ai_generating` |
| `content_markdown` | Text(100,000) | Nullable | Report body (Markdown); null while AI generating |
| `finalist_account_ids` | Array<UUID> | FK → Target Account; max 50 | Finalist roster; ordered; rank = array index + 1 |
| `finalized_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Populated on `finalized` transition |
| `finalized_by_user_id` | UUID | Nullable; FK → User | Who finalized |
| `finalized_report_id` | UUID | Nullable; FK → Selection Report (§4.3.23) | Populated on transition to `finalized`; points to immutable finalized report entity |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Not null | |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Not null | |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK → User | |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK → User | |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete |

**Scope:** Workspace-scoped. One active (non-finalized) draft per workspace enforced by `is_current_draft = true` unique partial index. Multiple finalized drafts are retained for audit history.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, is_current_draft)` UNIQUE WHERE `is_current_draft = true AND deleted_at IS NULL` — single-active-draft invariant
- `(workspace_id, state)` — draft list
- `(workspace_id, version DESC)` — version history
- `(ai_generation_job_id)` WHERE `ai_generation_job_id IS NOT NULL` — AIOperation join

**Retention:** Workspace-life for non-finalized drafts. Finalized-draft rows retained 7 years per Evaluation Workspace §4.8 retention rules (audit requirement; matches §4.3.11 Evaluation Workspace retention). DSAR: `author_user_id`, `collaborator_user_ids[]`, `finalized_by_user_id`, audit fields pseudonymized on subject request; `content_markdown` redacted to `[REDACTED_DSAR]` sentinel if subject PII is detected in body text; rows retained per §6.8.5.

**Relationships:** Parent = Evaluation Workspace. References User (author, collaborators, audit fields), Target Account (`finalist_account_ids[]`), AIOperation (`ai_generation_job_id`), Selection Report (§4.3.23 via `finalized_report_id`).

**Authoring Intent:** Selection Report Draft represents the buyer's in-progress selection rationale — typically AI-co-drafted from fit scores and bid comparison data, then human-reviewed before finalization. It is distinct from the immutable Selection Report (§4.3.23), which is the frozen legally-signable artifact. The draft/finalized separation is required for audit integrity: the finalized report is write-once-read-many; drafts are mutable right up to finalization. Full UX / AI generation pipeline authoring remains in the Selection & Reporting surface sections; the finalized entity is now canonical in §4.3.23.

**Failure Modes:**
1. Two drafts simultaneously `is_current_draft = true` — unique partial index rejects second insert; race detected via optimistic-lock retry (§20 conflict semantics).
2. Finalist references a Target Account not in `state = finalist` — application-layer validation rejects finalization with `E_SELECTION_FINALIST_INVALID_STATE`.
3. AI generation job ID populated while `state != ai_generating` — guard enforced at state-machine transition; violation logged to Audit Event.
4. `finalized_report_id` populated while `state != finalized` — rejected by state-machine handler.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. At most one non-finalized draft exists per workspace at any time.
2. `content_markdown` may be edited only when `state ∈ {drafting, review}`; other states are read-only on content.
3. On `state → finalized` transition, an immutable Selection Report row is created; the draft becomes read-only.
4. Full feature specification is deferred to Phase 7 and replaces this stub without field-level deletions.

**Integration Deferral Note — Authored Extension (requires human sign-off):** Phase 1.5 stub for FK integrity; amended 2026-06-21 to bind the finalized report FK to §4.3.23.

### 4.3.22 Inbox Item Group (Org-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.22-inbox-item-group}

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Buyer org |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Console scope |
| `group_type` | Enum (Appendix J `inbox_item_group_type_enum`) | Not null | `workspace_digest`, `seller_thread_digest`, `bid_activity_digest`, `system_bundle`, `ai_recommendation_bundle` |
| `anchor_entity_type` | Enum (Appendix J `anchor_entity_type_enum`) | Not null | `evaluation_workspace`, `bid_workspace`, `target_account`, `seller_org`, `user`, `system` |
| `anchor_entity_id` | UUID | Not null | FK target depends on `anchor_entity_type`; polymorphic |
| `title` | String(128) | Not null | Human-readable group title |
| `item_count` | Integer | Not null; ≥1 | Count of Inbox Items in group |
| `unread_count` | Integer | Not null; ≥0 | Count of unread Inbox Items |
| `latest_item_at` | Timestamp | Not null | Most recent Inbox Item arrival |
| `collapsed` | Boolean | Not null; default `true` | Per-user UI state stored on group row for team-scoped groups; per-user collapse stored in separate user-pref entity |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Auto-dissolve time for transient groups |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Not null | |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Not null | |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK → User; nullable | Null for system-created groups |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK → User; nullable | |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete |

**Scope:** Org-scoped (Inbox is cross-workspace within an Org). `anchor_entity_type` + `anchor_entity_id` pair validated at application layer for FK integrity and firewall compliance (§7.2 — an Inbox Item Group anchored to a `seller_org` must not leak data across marketplace domains; enforced by cross-referencing the anchor org's primary marketplace domain against the group's `org_id` workspaces).

**Indexes:**
- `(org_id, latest_item_at DESC)` — Inbox paginated list
- `(org_id, anchor_entity_type, anchor_entity_id)` — anchor lookup
- `(org_id, group_type, latest_item_at DESC)` — type-filtered list
- `(expires_at)` WHERE `expires_at IS NOT NULL` — TTL sweep

**Retention:** Org-life while item_count ≥ 1. Groups are auto-hard-deleted 90 days after `latest_item_at` when `item_count = 0` (empty-group sweep). On Org hard-delete, all group rows hard-deleted within 30 days. DSAR: `created_by`, `updated_by` pseudonymized on subject request; `title` redacted only if it contains subject PII (rare; titles are template-generated). Rows retained per §6.8.5 if linked to audit-retained Inbox Items.

**Relationships:** Parent = Organization. Is parent to Inbox Item (§2 / Phase 2 integration). References polymorphic anchor entity.

**Authoring Intent:** Inbox Item Group exists so the Inbox can surface a condensed, grouped view rather than a raw event stream — e.g., "Acme Corp workspace: 12 new updates" rather than 12 separate rows. Grouping is required for enterprise Inbox usability (typical buyer has 50–200 concurrent workspace+bid threads). Full authoring — grouping rules, auto-dissolve logic, per-user collapse state, notification delivery semantics — lands in Phase 2 (Inbox & Notifications integration). This stub locks the FK target for §2 Inbox Item and for Notification Digest entities.

**Failure Modes:**
1. Group with `item_count = 0` persists past 90 days — TTL sweep job (§40.2) hard-deletes; monitored via PostHog event `inbox_item_group_ttl_swept`.
2. Anchor entity deleted while group exists — on cascade, group auto-dissolved (`deleted_at` set) within 24h via reconciliation job.
3. `unread_count > item_count` invariant violation — application-layer guard; violation logged to Audit Event severity `high`.
4. Cross-marketplace-domain anchor leak — §7.2 firewall check at group creation; rejection with `E_MARKETPLACE_DOMAIN_MISMATCH`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. One Inbox Item Group per `(org_id, anchor_entity_type, anchor_entity_id, group_type)` tuple; second insert upserts, merging `item_count` and `unread_count`.
2. `latest_item_at` updates transactionally on each Inbox Item arrival in the group.
3. Group with `expires_at < now()` is swept to `deleted_at` within 24h.
4. Full Inbox behavioral specification (UX, subscription rules, digest cadence, mobile push behavior) is deferred to Phase 2.

**Integration Deferral Note — Authored Extension (requires human sign-off):** Phase 1.5 stub for Inbox FK integrity; Phase 2 supersedes.

#### 4.3.22.1 InboxItem (Org-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.22.1-inboxitem}

**Authoring intent (v7.2.0-REM Phase 4.11 P1 remediation — closes D-4.11-001).** InboxItem is the first-class buyer-console item row behind §20.2. It replaces the former §20.2.2 JSON example with a canonical §4 field table and is the child row counted by Inbox Item Group (§4.3.22) and Unread Marker (§4.3.15).

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization; required | Buyer org that owns the item |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` fixed | Seller-console reads return HTTP 404 per §7.2 |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace; nullable | Populated when the item is tied to a Workspace; org-level items may be null |
| `inbox_item_group_id` | UUID | FK -> Inbox Item Group (§4.3.22); nullable | Group row used for feed compaction; null allowed for one-off system items before grouping |
| `recipient_user_id` | UUID | FK -> User; required | The user whose feed renders this item |
| `notification_item_type` | Enum | Appendix J `notification_item_type`; required | Canonical item-family value; §20.2.1 must cite this enum rather than inline-list values |
| `priority` | Enum | Appendix J `inbox_item_priority`; required | `high`, `medium`, or `low`; render ordering maps to this enum |
| `title` | String | 1-100 chars | Surface headline |
| `description` | String | 0-200 chars | Short body copy; never carries raw vendor response text |
| `action_url` | String | Nullable; internal route only; <= 512 chars | Must resolve to a route reachable by `recipient_user_id` |
| `action_label` | String | Nullable; 1-40 chars when present | Button / link copy |
| `source_event_id` | UUID | Nullable; FK -> AuditEvent / notification outbox event | Idempotency key for event-driven item creation |
| `anchor_entity_type` | Enum | Appendix J `anchor_entity_type_enum`; nullable | Mirrors group anchor when item is tied to a durable object |
| `anchor_entity_id` | UUID | Nullable | FK target depends on `anchor_entity_type`; validated at application layer |
| `delivery_state` | Enum | Appendix J `notification_delivery_state`; required; default `visible` | `visible`, `read`, `dismissed`, `expired`, `archived` |
| `read_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Supersedes the former §20.2.2 `read` Boolean |
| `dismissed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Supersedes the former §20.2.2 `dismissed` Boolean |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Governed by `notification_expiry_class` / `inbox_item_group_ttl_class_enum` semantics |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User or system actor; nullable | Null only for system-created items whose actor is the source event |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User or system actor; nullable | Last mutator |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete / retention marker |

**Required indexes.**

- `(recipient_user_id, delivery_state, created_at DESC)` — primary feed query.
- `(org_id, created_at DESC)` — Org-level audit and support lookup.
- `(workspace_id, created_at DESC)` WHERE `workspace_id IS NOT NULL` — Workspace-scoped Inbox panel.
- `(inbox_item_group_id, created_at DESC)` WHERE `inbox_item_group_id IS NOT NULL` — grouped-feed expansion.
- `(source_event_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `source_event_id IS NOT NULL` — idempotent item creation.
- `(expires_at)` WHERE `expires_at IS NOT NULL AND delivery_state IN ('visible','read')` — expiry sweep.

**Scope isolation.** Org-scoped, user-targeted, buyer-console-only. Every read filters by `recipient_user_id` and `org_id`; Workspace-linked rows additionally require the user's active Workspace Membership. Cross-Org reads and seller-console reads return HTTP 404. `action_url` is re-authorized on click; stale or permission-lost links render the §3.7 permission-denied recovery state instead of leaking the destination.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows the §40.2 InboxItem row. DSAR pseudonymizes `recipient_user_id`, `created_by`, and `updated_by`; `title` / `description` are redacted when subject-identifying text is detected; source event IDs and group linkage remain when required for audit integrity under §6.8.5. Residency follows `org_id.data_residency_region`; Workspace-linked items must match the parent Workspace residency.

**Relationships.** Parent = Organization. Optional parent = Workspace. Optional group = Inbox Item Group (§4.3.22). Drives Unread Marker (§4.3.15) upserts through `(recipient_user_id, anchor_entity_type, anchor_entity_id)` and contributes to Inbox Item Group `item_count`, `unread_count`, and `latest_item_at`.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Creating an InboxItem MUST validate `notification_item_type`, `priority`, and `delivery_state` against Appendix J.
2. Creating an InboxItem from a source event MUST be idempotent on `source_event_id`.
3. Mark-read MUST set `read_at`, transition `delivery_state` to `read`, and update the matching Unread Marker in the same transaction.
4. Dismiss MUST set `dismissed_at`, transition `delivery_state` to `dismissed`, decrement the group unread count when applicable, and preserve the item until its §40.2 retention boundary.
5. Expiry sweep MUST transition eligible items to `expired` or hard-delete them according to §40.2 without leaving `InboxItemGroup.unread_count > item_count`.
6. Seller-console tokens MUST receive HTTP 404 for every InboxItem read path, including grouped-feed expansion.

#### 4.3.22.2 WorkspacePulseHealth (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.22.2-workspacepulsehealth}

**Authoring intent (v7.2.0-REM Phase 4.11 P1 remediation — closes D-4.11-003 / D-4.11-004 / D-4.11-005 / D-4.11-007).** WorkspacePulseHealth is the persisted daily score row for §20.3. It stores the composite score, per-component terms, weight-set selection, and color-band transition used by Pulse UI, digest email, webhook thresholding, and Solo-mode engine-on / surface-off behavior (§2.8.4).

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization; required | Denormalized from Workspace |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` fixed | Buyer-console score row |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace; required | Owning evaluation |
| `recorded_at_utc` | Timestamp | Required | Daily scheduler timestamp or on-demand recompute timestamp |
| `weight_set` | Enum | Appendix J `pulse_health_weight_set`; required | `pre_phase_6`, `phase_6_to_9`, `phase_10_to_11`, `phase_12_locked` |
| `composite_score` | Decimal(5,2) | Required; 0.00 <= value <= 100.00 | Final bounded score after null-term renormalization |
| `sla_compliance_pct` | Decimal(5,2) | Nullable; 0.00 <= value <= 100.00 | Null means denominator unavailable for this phase / workspace state |
| `scoring_progress_pct` | Decimal(5,2) | Nullable; 0.00 <= value <= 100.00 | Phase 10+ term |
| `response_rate_pct` | Decimal(5,2) | Nullable; 0.00 <= value <= 100.00 | Phase 6+ term |
| `phase_velocity_pct` | Decimal(5,2) | Nullable; 0.00 <= value <= 100.00 | Normalized term defined in §20.3.1; higher is better |
| `component_weights_json` | JSONB | Required; keys limited to the four component names above; values sum to 1.0000 after renormalization | Snapshot of applied weights for audit / explainability |
| `raw_inputs_json` | JSONB | Required; no free-text or vendor response bodies | Counts and denominators used by the compute; PII excluded |
| `color_band` | Enum | Appendix J `pulse_health_color_band`; required | `green`, `yellow`, `red` |
| `prior_color_band` | Enum | Appendix J `pulse_health_color_band`; nullable | Previous persisted band for transition detection |
| `band_transition_event_id` | UUID | Nullable; FK -> webhook / notification outbox event | Populated when §31 `pulse.health_score_threshold_breached` is emitted |
| `locked_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when Workspace enters Phase 12 and score freezes |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User or system actor; nullable | System for scheduled compute |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User or system actor; nullable | Last recompute / lock actor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete marker |

**Required indexes.**

- `(workspace_id, recorded_at_utc DESC)` — trend chart and latest-score lookup.
- `(workspace_id, weight_set, recorded_at_utc DESC)` — phase-band audit.
- `(org_id, color_band, recorded_at_utc DESC)` — at-risk workspace dashboard.
- `(band_transition_event_id)` WHERE `band_transition_event_id IS NOT NULL` — webhook correlation.
- `(workspace_id, locked_at)` WHERE `locked_at IS NOT NULL` — Phase 12 lock audit.

**Scope isolation.** Workspace-scoped and buyer-console-only. Team-mode UI renders the row through §20.5; Solo-mode UI suppresses the per-component surface per §2.8.4 but the row still computes and persists. Seller-console reads return HTTP 404. Cross-Workspace reads return HTTP 404.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows the §40.2 WorkspacePulseHealth row. DSAR pseudonymizes actor FKs; raw input counts remain when they contain no subject-identifying text. `raw_inputs_json` MUST NOT store requirement text, vendor response bodies, comments, or email addresses. Residency follows the parent Workspace.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Every daily Pulse compute MUST write exactly one WorkspacePulseHealth row per `(workspace_id, recorded_at_utc::date)` unless the Workspace is deleted or archived past retention.
2. `composite_score` MUST always be within [0, 100], including zero-denominator and abandoned-workspace fixtures.
3. `phase_velocity_pct` MUST be monotonic in lateness: on-time > one-day-late > two-times-slow for the same phase-duration baseline.
4. Phase 12 entry MUST lock the latest row and prevent recompute from mutating the locked score; later rows may be appended only as audit annotations with `weight_set = phase_12_locked`.
5. Color-band transitions into yellow or red MUST populate `band_transition_event_id` when the §31 webhook / notification event is emitted.
6. Solo-mode Workspaces MUST persist the same row as Team-mode Workspaces while suppressing the per-component widget surface per §2.8.4 / Appendix M.1.

### 4.3.23 Selection Report (Finalized, Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.23-selection-report}

Immutable finalized recommendation artifact produced from the Selection Report Draft (§4.3.21) during Phase 12 (§10.12). This is the legally/audit-signable report, distinct from the mutable draft.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization | Buyer org; denormalized from Workspace |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Seller console never reads the row |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace | Owning evaluation |
| `selection_report_draft_id` | UUID | FK -> Selection Report Draft | Draft version crystallized into this immutable report |
| `selection_record_id` | UUID | FK -> Selection Record, nullable until §10.13.5 | Populated when the immutable Selection Record is assembled at Phase 13 closure |
| `status` | Enum | Appendix J `selection_report_status` | `generated`, `signed`, `approval_pending`, `approved`, `superseded`, `archived` |
| `primary_target_account_id` | UUID | FK -> Target Account | Exactly one primary finalist |
| `secondary_target_account_ids` | Array<UUID> | FK -> Target Account, max 5 | Optional secondary vendors |
| `alternate_target_account_ids` | Array<UUID> | FK -> Target Account, max 10 | Optional alternates |
| `selection_status_map_json` | JSONB | Keys = Target Account IDs; values = Appendix J `vendor_selection_status` | Complete selection-state map for all evaluated vendors |
| `content_canonical_json` | JSONB | Required; immutable after `status != generated` | Structured report body: executive summary, ranking, rationale, risks, next steps |
| `content_markdown_snapshot` | Text | Required; <= 100,000 chars | Human-readable snapshot rendered to PDF/export |
| `risk_assessment_json` | JSONB | Required | Input to Defense View risk section (§13.11.3) |
| `evidence_refs_json` | JSONB | Required | Requirement / Response / Score references used by audit receipt and Defense View |
| `signature_provider` | Enum | `sourcera_e_signature`, `external_signature`, `manual_attestation` | Signature mechanism; provider payload stored separately |
| `signed_by_user_id` | UUID | FK -> User, nullable | Workspace Owner or delegated signer |
| `signed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when signed |
| `approved_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when approval workflow approves or when approval not required and report is signed |
| `approval_workflow_id` | UUID | FK -> Approval Workflow, nullable | Required when Org approval policy applies |
| `selection_record_sha256` | String | 64 hex chars, nullable until §10.13.5 | SHA-256 of the immutable Selection Record bundle; Defense View cache key |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Usually Workspace Owner or system report generator |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last metadata mutator; content stays immutable after approval |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete only through Workspace lifecycle cascade |

**Scope Isolation:** Workspace-scoped and buyer-console-only. Seller-console reads return HTTP 404 per §7.2. Vendor-facing status notifications are projections and never include `content_markdown_snapshot`, internal comments, or buyer-only evidence notes.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, status, created_at DESC)` — report lookup and history.
- `(selection_report_draft_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `deleted_at IS NULL` — one finalized report per draft version.
- `(selection_record_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `selection_record_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL` — one report bound to one Selection Record.
- `(org_id, approved_at DESC)` — audit and export listing.
- `(selection_record_sha256)` WHERE `selection_record_sha256 IS NOT NULL` — Defense View hash lookup.

**Retention:** Inherits Workspace closure retention per §40.2; finalized reports are retained for the audit-retention class that applies to the Workspace and never purged before the Selection Record. DSAR: user IDs are pseudonymized per §6.8.4 Pattern B; report body remains retained for contract-defense / audit-integrity per §6.8.5, with detected subject PII redacted in exported copies.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. A `SelectionReport` row MUST be created only from a `SelectionReportDraft.state = finalized` transition.
2. Once `status ∈ {signed, approval_pending, approved, archived}`, `content_canonical_json`, `content_markdown_snapshot`, `risk_assessment_json`, and `evidence_refs_json` MUST be write-once except through a superseding report version before Phase 13.
3. Every vendor in the evaluated finalist set MUST have exactly one `vendor_selection_status` entry.
4. `approved_at` MUST be non-null before §10.16 permits Phase 12 -> Phase 13 when approval is required.
5. The row MUST NOT expose report body fields to seller-console APIs, Console Bridge payloads, or webhooks unless a specific public artifact (M2 PublicSelectionReport) is generated under §48.5.2 redaction rules.

| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | Metadata-only; content fields immutable |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Workspace Owner or system closure actor |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last metadata mutator |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete only through Workspace lifecycle / retention cascade |

**Scope Isolation:** Workspace-scoped, org-scoped, buyer-console-only. Seller-console reads return HTTP 404. Public derivatives (M2 PublicSelectionReport, M3 EvaluationCertificate, seller social artifacts) read from redacted snapshots and never from this raw bundle.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `deleted_at IS NULL` — one active Selection Record per Workspace.
- `(selection_report_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `deleted_at IS NULL` — one immutable record per finalized report.
- `(selection_record_sha256)` UNIQUE — content-addressed audit lookup.
- `(org_id, immutable_at DESC)` — audit and export listing.

**Retention:** Retained with closed Workspace records per §40.2 and audit-integrity exemptions in §6.8.5. DSAR: user identifiers in snapshot JSON are pseudonymized in exported views; the immutable hash and contract/audit fields are retained for contract-defense. Hard purge follows the Workspace / Org retention boundary only after dependent public artifacts and audit receipts expire.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. A `SelectionRecord` row MUST be created during §10.13.5 before Workspace `status` becomes `closed`.
2. `selection_record_sha256` MUST be computed from canonical JSON and copied to `SelectionReport.selection_record_sha256` in the same transaction.
3. Content fields MUST be immutable after `immutable_at`; corrections require a new Selection Report / Selection Record version before Phase 13 closure, or an Ops correction annotation that does not rewrite historical content.
4. Defense View (§13.11) MUST read this bundle by `selection_record_id` / `selection_record_sha256`, not live Requirements, Responses, or Scores.
5. Any export that includes this bundle MUST apply §6.8.4 DSAR redaction and §7.2 firewall rules before serialization.

### 4.3.25 Approval Workflow (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.25-approval-workflow}

Phase 12 approval sub-state for Selection Reports when Org policy requires CFO / Legal / CRO sign-off.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization | Buyer org |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Buyer-only |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace | Workspace remains in `phase_12_selection` until approved |
| `selection_report_id` | UUID | FK -> Selection Report | Report under approval |
| `status` | Enum | Appendix J `approval_workflow_status` | `pending`, `approved`, `request_changes`, `rejected` |
| `required_approver_role` | Enum | Appendix J `approval_workflow_required_role` | `cfo`, `legal`, `cro`, `procurement_owner`, `custom_policy_approver` |
| `approver_user_id` | UUID | FK -> User, nullable until assignment | Final approver or active routed approver |
| `routed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when report is sent for approval |
| `decision_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on approve / request changes / reject |
| `decision_reason` | String | 0-1000 chars, nullable | Required for `request_changes` and `rejected` |
| `resubmission_count` | Integer | >= 0 | Increments when Workspace Owner resubmits after changes or rejection |
| `current_submission_version` | Integer | >= 1 | Matches the Selection Report version under review |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Initiating Workspace Owner / Admin |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last actor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete only if parent Workspace is deleted |

**Scope Isolation:** Workspace-scoped and buyer-console-only. Only Workspace Owner/Admin and users permitted by §5.11 row `approval_workflow` can route or decide. Seller console and vendors never see approval rationale.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, status)` — active approval lookup.
- `(selection_report_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `deleted_at IS NULL` — one live workflow per report.
- `(approver_user_id, status, routed_at DESC)` — approver queue.
- `(org_id, status, updated_at DESC)` — Org-level approval dashboard.

**State Machine:** Appendix L.12 is authoritative. Approval rejection does not create a backward pipeline transition; the Workspace remains in `phase_12_selection`.

**Retention:** Retained with Selection Report / Selection Record audit class per §40.2. DSAR: approver and creator user IDs are pseudonymized on subject request; `decision_reason` is redacted in DSAR exports if it contains subject PII, but retained internally per §6.8.5 audit-integrity exemption.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. Phase 12 -> Phase 13 advancement MUST require `ApprovalWorkflow.status = approved` when Org approval policy applies.
2. `request_changes` and `rejected` MUST NOT change `Workspace.pipeline_phase`; both keep the Workspace in `phase_12_selection`.
3. Resubmission after `request_changes` or `rejected` MUST increment `resubmission_count` and return status to `pending`.
4. If scores are disputed after Phase 12 entry, the workflow MUST NOT unlock scores; the only score-changing path is cancellation and a new evaluation per §10.10 / §10.14.
5. Every decision writes an AuditEvent with the prior and new `approval_workflow_status`.

### 4.3.26 Cancellation Request (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.26-cancellation-request}

First-class record for the §10.14 Workspace cancellation lifecycle.

| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Buyer-only cancellation authority |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace | Canceled Workspace |
| `status` | Enum | Appendix J `cancellation_request_status` | `initiated`, `undo_grace`, `processing`, `recovered`, `hard_deleted` |
| `cancellation_reason` | Enum | Appendix J `workspace_cancellation_reason` | Required |

| `grace_expires_at` | Timestamp | Required; `cancelled_at + 14 days` | Undo deadline per §10.14.3 |
| `processing_started_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Day 14 transition |
| `recovered_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on undo/recovery |
| `hard_delete_eligible_at` | Timestamp | Required; `cancelled_at + 44 days` | Recovery cutoff per §10.14 |
| `cancelled_by_user_id` | UUID | FK -> User | Initiator |
| `recovered_by_user_id` | UUID | FK -> User, nullable | Recovery actor |
| `audit_event_ids` | Array<UUID> | FKs -> AuditEvent | Cancellation / recovery / processing audit rows |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Usually `cancelled_by_user_id` |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last lifecycle actor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete only after retention boundary |

**Scope Isolation:** Workspace-scoped buyer-only record. Seller-side visibility is through redacted `workspace_canceled` / `workspace_recovered` projections only.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, status)` — cancellation state lookup.
- `(org_id, status, cancelled_at DESC)` — Org cancellation audit list.
- `(grace_expires_at)` WHERE `status = 'undo_grace'` — grace sweeper.
- `(hard_delete_eligible_at)` WHERE `status = 'processing'` — hard-delete eligibility sweep.

**Retention:** Retained with Workspace lifecycle audit per §40.2 and §6.8.5. DSAR: actor IDs pseudonymized; `cancellation_reason_text` redacted in DSAR exports when it contains subject PII. Reason enum and lifecycle timestamps remain for audit.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. A Cancellation Request row MUST be created atomically with the §10.14.1 Workspace cancellation mutation.
2. `grace_expires_at` and `hard_delete_eligible_at` MUST be derived from `cancelled_at`; no separate timing singleton is permitted.
3. Undo / recovery MUST transition the row to `recovered` and emit `workspace_recovered`.
4. Seller-facing projection MUST never carry `cancellation_reason_text` or buyer-internal audit details.

### 4.3.27 Post-Evaluation Feedback (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.27-post-evaluation-feedback}

Optional stakeholder feedback captured after Phase 13 closure per §10.13.3. It is separate from the immutable Selection Record and does not alter the evaluation outcome.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization | Buyer org |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Buyer-only |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace | Closed evaluation |
| `selection_record_id` | UUID | FK -> Selection Record, nullable | Populated when feedback is tied to a finalized closure bundle |
| `respondent_user_id` | UUID | FK -> User | Stakeholder submitting feedback |
| `respondent_role_snapshot` | Enum | Workspace role enum | Frozen at submission |
| `sentiment` | Enum | Appendix J `post_evaluation_feedback_sentiment` | `positive`, `neutral`, `negative`, `mixed` |
| `process_feedback_text` | String | 0-5000 chars | "Did evaluation process go as planned?" response |
| `selection_confidence_score` | Integer | 1-5, nullable | Stakeholder confidence in selected vendor |
| `next_procurement_recommendations` | String | 0-5000 chars | Forward-looking lessons |
| `submitted_at` | Timestamp | Required | UTC |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | = respondent |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last mutator; edits allowed until archive |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete |

**Scope Isolation:** Workspace-scoped and buyer-console-only. Feedback is not included in seller-facing debriefs unless the Workspace Owner explicitly copies an excerpt into a separate seller-visible communication.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, submitted_at DESC)` — feedback list.
- `(selection_record_id, submitted_at DESC)` WHERE `selection_record_id IS NOT NULL` — closure bundle feedback.
- `(respondent_user_id, submitted_at DESC)` — user DSAR/export lookup.
- `(org_id, sentiment, submitted_at DESC)` — aggregate process-improvement analytics.

**Retention:** Workspace-life plus the Workspace retention window in §40.2. DSAR: respondent IDs pseudonymized; free-text fields redacted in DSAR exports when they contain subject PII. Aggregated sentiment metrics may be retained under §6.8.5.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. Feedback capture MUST be optional and MUST NOT block Workspace closure.
2. Feedback MUST NOT mutate Selection Report, Selection Record, scores, rankings, or vendor notifications.
3. Feedback must remain buyer-only unless explicitly copied into a separate seller-visible artifact.
4. Feedback rows must be exportable to the requesting respondent through DSAR access export.

### 4.3.28 TCO Model (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer) {#4.3.28-tco-model}

First-class persistence model for §15 TCO Modeling. A TCO Model captures pricing-only requirements, projection inputs, and computed per-vendor totals without converting pricing rows into scored capability requirements.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization | Buyer org; denormalized from parent Workspace |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Seller console never reads the row directly |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Workspace | Owning evaluation |
| `target_account_id` | UUID | FK -> Target Account; nullable | Null means Workspace-level shared assumptions; non-null means vendor-specific model row |
| `name` | String | 1-200 chars | Operator-visible model name |
| `pricing_model` | Enum | Appendix J `tco_pricing_model` | Top-level model family: perpetual, subscription, consumption, or custom |
| `pricing_requirements_json` | JSONB | Required; schema per §4.3.28.1; bounded by §39 | Pricing-only requirements. All entries have `weight=0` and are excluded from FM/PM/DNM scoring. |
| `projection_parameters_json` | JSONB | Required; schema per §4.3.28.2; bounded by §39 | Projection years, seat count, seat growth, currency, and any assumption notes. |
| `projection_results_json` | JSONB | Nullable; schema per §15.3.3 and §4.3.28.3; bounded by §39 | Computed annual totals, multi-year total, vendor pricing response snapshots, and comparison inputs. Null until first successful compute. |
| `currency_code` | Enum (Appendix J `billing_currency`) | Required; default from Workspace.`default_currency` | Display and calculation currency for this model. Locked on the model row when the first vendor pricing response snapshot is accepted. |
| `projection_years` | Integer | 1-10; default 3 | Denormalized from `projection_parameters_json` for filtering and validation |
| `initial_seat_count` | Integer | ≥ 1; default 1 | Denormalized from `projection_parameters_json` for filtering and validation |
| `seat_growth_rate` | Decimal | 0.0-0.5; default 0.0 | Denormalized from `projection_parameters_json` for validation and audit |
| `last_computed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on successful projection compute |
| `last_compute_error` | String | Nullable; 0-1000 chars | Last projection error shown to operator; cleared on successful compute |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last mutator |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete; cascades with Workspace lifecycle |

**Scope Isolation.** Workspace-scoped, Org-scoped, and Buyer-console-only. Seller-visible pricing responses are projections generated through Console Bridge / Bid Workspace flows, never direct reads of this row. Seller-console reads return HTTP 404 per §1.3 existence-leak prevention.

**Indexes:**
- `(workspace_id, target_account_id)` UNIQUE WHERE `deleted_at IS NULL` — one active vendor-specific model row per Target Account plus one shared Workspace row where `target_account_id IS NULL`.
- `(org_id, workspace_id, updated_at DESC)` — Workspace TCO model list and export.
- `(workspace_id, last_computed_at DESC)` — projection recency.
- `(target_account_id)` WHERE `target_account_id IS NOT NULL` — vendor comparison joins.

**Retention.** Workspace-life; on Workspace soft-delete, TCO Model rows cascade soft-delete and then purge with the parent unless retained by a finalized Selection Report / Selection Record evidence reference. DSAR: `created_by` / `updated_by` pseudonymized per §6.8.4 Pattern B; free-text assumption notes inside `projection_parameters_json` and `last_compute_error` are swept per §6.8.4.5. Residency inherits the parent Workspace `data_residency_region`.

**Relationships.** Parent = Workspace (§4.3.1). Optional vendor-specific binding to Target Account (§4.3.20). Pricing requirements reference no scorable Requirement rows; they are pricing-only inputs governed by §15.

#### 4.3.28.1 PricingRequirement JSON Element Schema {#4.3.28.1-pricingrequirement-json-element-schema}

`PricingRequirement` is not a standalone Requirement row in v7.1.1. It is the canonical element schema inside `TCOModel.pricing_requirements_json`; generated validators and materialized views MUST treat the table below as the field contract for each element.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Required; unique within the parent TCO Model | Stable element identifier |
| `org_id` | UUID | Inherited from `TCOModel.org_id` | Denormalized in generated views for tenant isolation |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Inherited from parent TCO Model |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | Inherited from `TCOModel.workspace_id` | Workspace scope |
| `tco_model_id` | UUID | FK -> TCOModel | Parent model |
| `use_case_id` | UUID | Required | TCO use-case grouping inside the model |
| `title` | String | Required; bounded by §39 `PricingRequirement.title` | Buyer-authored pricing question label |
| `description` | String | Nullable; bounded by §39 `PricingRequirement.description` | Buyer-authored vendor instructions |
| `type` | Enum | `pricing` (fixed); Appendix J Response Types | Pricing-only response type; not a scorable Requirement |
| `pricing_structure` | Enum | Appendix J Pricing Structures | `flat`, `tiered`, `one_time`, `percentage_of_license`, `estimate_range`, or `discount` |
| `weight` | Integer | `0` fixed | Excluded from §13 scoring denominators |
| `response_required` | Boolean | Required; default `true` | Whether vendor pricing response is mandatory |
| `unit` | String | Nullable; bounded by §39 `PricingRequirement.unit` | Unit label such as per seat, per year, or implementation fee |
| `pricing_confidential` | Boolean | Default `false` | If true, Selection Report exports suppress per-vendor unit pricing while retaining aggregate TCO |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC; element creation time |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC; element mutation time |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Buyer user who authored the element |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last buyer user to update the element |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete marker inside the parent JSON payload |

**Generated indexes.** Implementations MUST maintain queryable generated indexes or equivalent materialized projections for `(workspace_id, use_case_id, deleted_at)`, `(tco_model_id, id) UNIQUE WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`, and `(org_id, pricing_structure, updated_at DESC)`.

**Scope / retention / residency.** Scope, retention, DSAR, and residency inherit the parent TCO Model. Seller-console surfaces receive only the pricing question projection explicitly carried through Console Bridge flows; buyer-only fields and internal TCO calculations remain buyer-console-only per §25.

#### 4.3.28.2 TCOConfiguration JSON Schema {#4.3.28.2-tcoconfiguration-json-schema}

`TCOConfiguration` is the canonical schema inside `TCOModel.projection_parameters_json`; it is not a separate table. Exactly one active configuration exists per live TCO Model row.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Required; equals parent TCOModel.`id` unless versioned by future migration | Stable configuration identifier |
| `org_id` | UUID | Inherited from `TCOModel.org_id` | Tenant isolation |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Buyer-only |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | Inherited from `TCOModel.workspace_id` | Workspace scope |
| `tco_model_id` | UUID | FK -> TCOModel | Parent model |
| `projection_years` | Integer | 1-10; default 3 | Projection horizon; denormalized to TCOModel.`projection_years` |
| `initial_seat_count` | Integer | ≥ 1; default 1 | Baseline seat count; denormalized to TCOModel.`initial_seat_count` |
| `seat_growth_rate` | Decimal | 0.0-0.5; default 0.0 | Year-over-year multiplier; denormalized to TCOModel.`seat_growth_rate` |
| `currency_code` | Enum (Appendix J `billing_currency`) | Required; default from Workspace.`default_currency` | Display and calculation currency; denormalized to TCOModel.`currency_code` |
| `assumption_notes` | String | Nullable; bounded by §39 `TCOConfiguration.assumption_notes` | Buyer-authored assumptions, swept for PII under §6.8.4.5 |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Buyer actor |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User | Last buyer actor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Mirrors parent TCO Model soft-delete |

**Audit binding.** Any change to `projection_parameters_json`, `currency_code`, `projection_years`, `initial_seat_count`, or `seat_growth_rate` MUST emit an AuditEvent with `entity_type=tco_model`, `entity_id=TCOModel.id`, and a redacted before/after diff. This binds §15.5.2 recalculation to an auditable model change.

#### 4.3.28.3 Vendor Pricing Response FX Snapshot Schema {#4.3.28.3-vendor-pricing-response-fx-snapshot-schema}

Vendor-submitted monetary values for §15 pricing requirements MUST materialize into `projection_results_json.vendor_pricing_responses[]` using the schema below before any TCO calculation runs. The snapshot preserves the source currency, the locked FX rate, and the canonical USD integer-cent amount used for aggregation.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Required | Stable response snapshot id |
| `org_id` | UUID | Inherited from parent TCOModel | Buyer tenant scope |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | Stored on buyer-side TCO Model; seller write path is mediated by Console Bridge |
| `workspace_id` | UUID | Inherited from parent TCOModel | Workspace scope |
| `tco_model_id` | UUID | FK -> TCOModel | Parent model |
| `pricing_requirement_id` | UUID | FK -> PricingRequirement element id | Required |
| `target_account_id` | UUID | FK -> Target Account | Vendor/account being priced |
| `seller_org_id` | UUID | Nullable FK -> seller Organization | Populated when response came from a registered Seller Org; null for buyer-entered estimates |
| `source_amount_minor_units` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable when range fields used | Vendor amount in the source currency's minor units |
| `source_min_amount_minor_units` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable | Estimate-range minimum in source currency minor units |
| `source_max_amount_minor_units` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable; required when min is present | Estimate-range maximum in source currency minor units |
| `source_currency` | Enum (Appendix J `billing_currency`) | Required | Currency submitted by the vendor or buyer estimator |
| `fx_rate_locked_to_usd` | Decimal(12,8) | Required; default 1.0 when `source_currency=usd` | Locked at submit time using the §4.8.1 / C.84 Treasury-rate source and failover rule |
| `fx_locked_at` | Timestamp | Required | Timestamp of the FX snapshot |
| `amount_usd_cents` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable when range fields used | Canonical converted amount used for cross-vendor aggregation |
| `min_amount_usd_cents` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable | Canonical converted estimate minimum |
| `max_amount_usd_cents` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable | Canonical converted estimate maximum |
| `pricing_structure` | Enum | Appendix J Pricing Structures | Copied from the PricingRequirement element at response time |
| `submitted_at` | Timestamp | Required | Vendor/buyer submit time |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID | FK -> User or system actor | Submitter or bridge worker |
| `updated_by` | UUID | FK -> User or system actor | Last mutator before compute lock |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete marker; retained with parent TCO Model evidence |

**Currency / FX invariant.** TCO aggregation MUST use the `*_usd_cents` fields. Rendering into `TCOModel.currency_code` uses the locked FX snapshot, not live FX. A response whose `source_currency` is outside Appendix J `billing_currency` rejects before persistence; a response whose `source_currency` differs from Workspace.`default_currency` is allowed only when the FX snapshot fields above are present.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
1. Every §15.2 pricing requirement persisted for a Workspace MUST belong to a TCO Model row; inline-only JSON payloads are not authoritative.
2. TCO pricing requirements MUST satisfy §4.3.28.1, have `weight=0`, and MUST NOT enter §13 scoring denominators.
3. TCO configuration writes MUST satisfy §4.3.28.2 and emit the AuditEvent described there.
4. Vendor monetary inputs MUST satisfy §4.3.28.3 before any §15.3 calculation runs; live FX lookups during aggregation are forbidden.
5. Seller-console APIs MUST NOT expose `projection_parameters_json` assumption notes or buyer-authored `last_compute_error` text.
6. Recomputing a model MUST update `projection_results_json`, `last_computed_at`, and an Audit Event in one transaction.
7. Deleting a Workspace MUST cascade TCO Model soft-delete before retention purge.

### 4.3.29 WorkspaceTemplate (Org-Scoped, Buyer Console) {#4.3.29-workspacetemplate}

> **Authored Extension — requires human sign-off.** Phase 4.10 P1 remediation adds the buyer-console persistence model for §19 Template Library. The extension is registered as AE-V72REM-PH4P410-TEMPLATE-LIBRARY-01 and closes D-4.10-001 / -003 / -004 / -005 / -011 / -013 / -014 / -015 for the entity, entitlement, enum, retention, and Solo-mode portions of the Template Library surface. It does not close the remaining §19 API / webhook / audit-event P1 rows.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → Organization | Owning buyer Org |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` fixed | Seller-console sessions cannot read or mutate WorkspaceTemplate rows |
| `source` | Enum | Appendix J `workspace_template_source`; required | `sourcera_provided` or `org_custom` |
| `template_library_entry_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → TemplateLibraryEntry (§4.4.28) | Populated only when the row originated from a marketplace-published template clone; §19 Org templates remain buyer-scoped after clone |
| `current_version_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → WorkspaceTemplateVersion (§4.3.30) | Active version rendered in the catalog; null only during create transaction before first version row commits |
| `name` | String | Required; bounds per §39 `workspace_template.name` | Display name |
| `description_markdown` | String | Nullable; bounds per §39 `workspace_template.description_markdown` | Markdown-supported summary |
| `category` | Enum | Appendix J `workspace_template_category`; required | Canonical category for both Sourcera-provided seed templates and Org custom templates |
| `icon_token` | String | 1–64 chars; required; default `template` | Design-token or emoji-safe icon identifier rendered by §19.4 |
| `color_token` | String | 7-char hex OR design token; required; default `template.default` | Catalog-card accent; UI validates against §3 tokens where token-form is used |
| `update_state` | Enum | Appendix J `workspace_template_update_state`; required; default `current` | Server-computed badge state for Sourcera-provided templates |
| `latest_available_version_label` | String | Nullable; semver string; required when `update_state='update_available'` | Latest Sourcera registry version visible to this Org |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable FK → User or system actor | User for Org custom templates; system actor for Sourcera seed rows |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable FK → User or system actor | Last metadata updater |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete marker; deleted templates do not mutate derived Workspaces |

**Scope isolation.** Org-scoped and Buyer-console fixed. Seller-console sessions receive HTTP 404 for every WorkspaceTemplate route. Cross-org sharing is not performed through this entity; marketplace-published templates use TemplateLibraryEntry (§4.4.28) and clone into a buyer Org as an independent WorkspaceTemplate.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, source, deleted_at)`, `(org_id, lower(name)) UNIQUE WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`, `(org_id, category, source, deleted_at)`, `(org_id, update_state, updated_at DESC)`, `(template_library_entry_id) WHERE template_library_entry_id IS NOT NULL`.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Active rows are retained for Org life. On Org hard-delete, rows hard-delete within 30 days after the Org recovery window. On plan downgrade, rows remain active but authoring operations render read-only per §34.1.1 cell **Custom Templates (author / share)** and §19.6.1; downgrade never deletes templates. `created_by` and `updated_by` pseudonymize under §6.8.4 Pattern B. Template name / description are buyer-authored body fields and participate in §6.8.4.5 PII sweep. Residency follows Organization.`data_residency_region`; no cross-region customer-surface reads are allowed.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Creating an Org custom template MUST write one WorkspaceTemplate row and one active WorkspaceTemplateVersion row in the same transaction.
2. Seller-console reads of WorkspaceTemplate MUST return HTTP 404 even when the seller user belongs to the same Organization.
3. A deleted WorkspaceTemplate MUST NOT mutate or delete any Workspace whose `source_workspace_template_id` points at it.
4. Plan downgrade to Buyer Free or Buyer Solo MUST preserve existing rows and block author / share / update mutations with the same plan-gate response used by §5.11.
5. Catalog search MUST use the `(org_id, lower(name))` and `(org_id, category, source, deleted_at)` indexes; unscoped cross-Org template search is forbidden.

### 4.3.30 WorkspaceTemplateVersion (Org-Scoped, Buyer Console) {#4.3.30-workspacetemplateversion}

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → Organization | Denormalized from WorkspaceTemplate for residency partitioning |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` fixed | Mirrors parent WorkspaceTemplate |
| `template_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → WorkspaceTemplate (§4.3.29) | Parent template |
| `version_label` | String | Required; semver string `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`; unique per template | User-visible version label in §19.4 |
| `version_bump_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `workspace_template_version_bump_kind`; required | `patch`, `minor`, or `major` |
| `status` | Enum | Appendix J `workspace_template_version_status`; required | Current lifecycle state |
| `source_version_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → WorkspaceTemplateVersion | Previous Org-local version when applying an update or editing metadata |
| `superseded_by_version_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → WorkspaceTemplateVersion | Populated when a newer version becomes active |
| `content_snapshot_json` | JSONB | Required; bounded by §39 `workspace_template.content_snapshot_json` | Normalized snapshot of Use Cases, Requirements, TCO configuration, and optional team-assignment defaults. Vendor data, responses, scores, scenarios, Q&A threads, and amendments are forbidden. |
| `changelog_md` | String | Nullable; bounded by §39 `workspace_template.changelog_md` | Changelog rendered by §19.4.3 update badge / modal |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable FK → User or system actor | Version creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable FK → User or system actor | Last updater |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft-delete marker; normally null because versions are superseded, not deleted |

**Scope isolation.** Inherits WorkspaceTemplate scope: Org-scoped, Buyer-console fixed, and never readable from seller-console surfaces. Versions are immutable once they have been used to create a Workspace except for `status`, `superseded_by_version_id`, and audit fields.

**Required indexes.** `(template_id, version_label)` UNIQUE partial WHERE `deleted_at IS NULL`, `(org_id, template_id, created_at DESC)`, `(org_id, status, updated_at DESC)`, `(source_version_id) WHERE source_version_id IS NOT NULL`.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Inherits parent WorkspaceTemplate retention. Content snapshots are retained while the parent template is active and for audit replay of Workspaces created from that version. On DSAR, actor FKs pseudonymize under Pattern B and `content_snapshot_json` / `changelog_md` participate in §6.8.4.5 body-field sweep. Residency follows Organization.`data_residency_region`.

**State machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `active` | Template created or Sourcera update applied | Parent WorkspaceTemplate exists and mutation actor is authorized by §5.11 | Also sets parent `current_version_id` |
| `active` | `superseded` | Newer version becomes active | New version committed in same transaction | `superseded_by_version_id` required |
| `active` / `superseded` | `deprecated` | Sourcera deprecates source template or Org admin archives template | No active Workspace is mutated | Existing derived Workspaces remain snapshots |

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. `content_snapshot_json` MUST exclude vendor data, vendor responses, scores, scenarios, Q&A threads, and amendments.
2. Workspace creation from template MUST copy from exactly one WorkspaceTemplateVersion and stamp Workspace.`source_workspace_template_version_id`.
3. Applying a Sourcera update MUST create a new version row; it MUST NOT mutate prior versions or previously-created Workspaces.
4. Semver bump validation MUST map metadata-only edits to `patch`, additive Use Case / Requirement changes to `minor`, and removal of existing template content to `major`.
5. Deleting or deprecating a template MUST preserve the Workspace source-version FKs for audit replay.

## 4.4 Seller Console Entities {#4.4-seller-console-entities}

### 4.4.1 Bid Workspace (Console-Scoped, Seller)

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Seller's organization |
| `console` | Enum | `seller` (fixed) | Identifies console scope |
| `buyer_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Organization ID | Buyer's organization (foreign org) |
| `name` | String | 1–200 chars | Opportunity name (e.g., "Acme Corp RFP") |
| `description` | String | 0–2000 chars | Opportunity context |
| `status` | Enum | `draft` | `active` | `submitted` | `won` | `lost` | Bid lifecycle |
| `pipeline_stage_id` | Integer | 0–15 | Aligned with buyer phases for visibility. V4 (D-4.2-001 closure): integer storage maps to the canonical 13-value `pipeline_phase` enum per Appendix J Pipeline Phase Integer ↔ Enum Mapping table. The seller-side bid surface reads the projected `pipeline_phase` enum value via §25 Console Bridge; no seller-side ordinal comparison is permitted. |
| `data_residency_region` | Enum (Appendix J `data_residency_region`) | `us` \| `eu` \| `apac` \| `custom`; required at create | **Bid Workspace residency follows the Seller Org's `data_residency_region` at create time** (storage partition; Bid Response binary blobs and KB-derived artifacts land in the seller's region per §40.3 storage-partition rules). When the buyer's Workspace `data_residency_region` ≠ seller's `data_residency_region`, the §4.7.1 Console Bridge Event redaction layer ensures payload partitioning is residency-respecting: payload_json is canonicalized at the buyer-side residency boundary and re-canonicalized into the seller-side residency partition at apply time, never crossing residency in storage. CI gate `bid_workspace_residency_required_at_create` (§M.5) asserts the field is non-null on every create write. CI gate `bid_workspace_residency_storage_partition_match` asserts every Bid Response and KB-derived artifact under a Bid Workspace lands in storage backend `s3_<bid_workspace.data_residency_region>` per §40.3. **D-1V-007 remediation, 2026-04-29 — closes P0 GDPR Article 44 cross-border-transfer exposure on cross-residency bids.** |
| `owner_id` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Account owner / bid lead |
| `team_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | Team IDs | Assigned teams contributing to bid |
| `outcome_debrief_seen_by_user_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | Default `[]`; max 500 entries | Seller users who have already seen the §22.18.6.2 outcome-debrief overlay for this Bid Workspace. Idempotency key is `(bid_workspace_id, seller_user_id)`; cleared only by hard-delete of the BidWorkspace, not by disqualification cascades. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID; nullable | Last updater. (Audit-trail conformance per §4.1 Principle #2.) |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete |

**Residency Tie-Break (D-1V-007 remediation).** When buyer Workspace residency = `eu` and seller Org residency = `us`, the canonical rule is: Bid Workspace storage partitions to **seller residency** (`us`); buyer-side Workspace artifacts remain in `eu`. The §4.7.1 Console Bridge Event payload is redaction-canonicalized at the buyer-side residency boundary and decoded into the seller-side partition; raw payload bytes are never transmitted across residency boundaries. For Enterprise contracts requiring full data-residency lock (no cross-residency bid responses), the Seller Org's `data_residency_region` MUST equal the buyer Workspace's `data_residency_region` at Bid Workspace create time; mismatched create attempts return HTTP 422 `bid_workspace_residency_lock_violation` (Appendix I) when the buyer Org's contract carries the `enforce_strict_residency_lock` flag (Enterprise governance per §40.4). Default (non-Enterprise) behavior: cross-residency bid responses are permitted and stored at the seller's residency with the bridge-event canonicalization layer enforcing the firewall.

**Indexes (D-1V-007 remediation).** Composite index `(org_id, data_residency_region, status)` to support per-Seller-Org residency-partitioned reporting on Bid Workspace counts, plus `(data_residency_region, created_at DESC)` partial for Ops residency-segmented dashboards.

**Per-Bid-Workspace role assignment (V3+ remediation, 2026-05-04 — Authored Extension AE-3V-002 cross-reference).** Seller-side roles per §5.5 (`seller_bid_captain`, `seller_bid_contributor`, `seller_kb_viewer`, `seller_guest`) are resolved at runtime from the following sources, mapped onto WorkOS FGA Custom Roles scoped to the `bid_workspace` resource type per §5.13.1:

- `seller_bid_captain` — implicitly granted to the user referenced by `Bid Workspace.owner_id`.
- `seller_bid_contributor` — implicitly granted to users who hold `seller_bid_contributor` on §4.2.2 OrgMembership AND are members of any §4.2.4 Team listed in `Bid Workspace.team_ids`.
- `seller_kb_viewer` (per Bid Workspace, read-only) — granted to users who hold `seller_kb_viewer` on OrgMembership AND have an explicit guest invite to the Bid Workspace per a future per-member junction table (Authored Extension AE-3V-002 follow-on; tracked into v7.1.1 entity-rewrite cycle).
- `seller_guest` — granted via explicit guest invite to a single Bid Workspace; also tracked into the future per-member junction table.

When SCIM directory-group → role assignment per §5.13.2 fires for a seller-side role, the role binds to the user's §4.2.2 OrgMembership and propagates to every Bid Workspace where the user is `owner_id` or a member of a Team in `team_ids`. Group deletion cascade per §4.2.5 state machine revokes the OrgMembership role and recomputes the Bid Workspace role-resolution.

**Retention.** Workspace life + 7 years per §40.2 (aligned with Bid Workspace retention).

**Residency.** Each row lives in the Bid Workspace's residency region.

**§9 canonical binding.** §9 uses the customer-language term "Vendor Response"; the canonical entity is this §4.4.2 Bid Response. §9 aliases resolve as follows: `vendor_organization_id` is derived from the parent Bid Workspace's Seller Org, `content` maps to `answer_text`, `capability_declarations` maps to `capability_declaration_ids`, and team assignment uses `team_id` / `assigned_to_user_id`. §9 MUST NOT define a second Vendor Response table.

#### 4.4.2.1 Q&A Thread Seller Projection (Console-Scoped, Seller) {#4.4.2.1-q&a-thread-seller-projection}

This projection is the §4 Seller Console catalog home for the seller-visible side of Q&A. The canonical conversation object and post schema remain §18.3.1; this projection records the seller read/write envelope, NDA gate, and firewall predicates used by §24.1. It does not create a buyer-readable row and it never stores buyer-internal comments, buyer-internal mentions, or non-promoted Internal Comment content.

**Authored Extension — requires human sign-off.** This projection-table shape and its Appendix J enum bindings were authored in the v7.2.0-REM Phase 5.5 P1 pass to close D-5.5-001 / D-5.5-002 / D-5.5-003. Registry row: AE-V72REM-PH5.5-01.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Projection row id; distinct from the canonical §18.3.1 thread id |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK -> Organization | Seller Org that may read the projection |
| `console` | Enum | `seller` fixed | Seller-console scope; buyer-console reads are rejected at the §7.2 firewall |
| `bid_workspace_id` | UUID | FK -> Bid Workspace (§4.4.1); required | Seller bid context |
| `source_thread_id` | UUID | FK -> Q&A Thread (§18.3.1); required | Canonical thread id; not exposed as a buyer Workspace lookup key to seller APIs |
| `source_workspace_id_hash` | String | SHA-256; required | One-way correlation hash for bridge reconciliation; raw buyer `workspace_id` is not returned to seller clients |
| `requirement_id` | UUID | Nullable | Seller-visible requirement / Bid Response source pointer after §25.5 materialization |
| `addressed_seller_org_id` | UUID | Nullable; FK -> Organization | Required when the thread is private or directed to a specific vendor |
| `question_audience` | Enum | Appendix J `qa_thread_question_audience` | Derived from §18.3.2 visibility selection and buyer authoring action |
| `thread_visibility` | Enum | Appendix J `qa_thread_visibility` | `PUBLIC` means all NDA-cleared invited vendors may read; `PRIVATE` means only the addressed seller may read |
| `vendor_name_masked` | Boolean | Default false | Mirrors §18.3.3 author masking for public threads |
| `nda_visibility_state` | Enum | Appendix J `qa_thread_nda_visibility_state` | Computed from §4.5.3 NDA Record and Bid Workspace state; controls §24.1 read eligibility |
| `compose_state` | Enum | Appendix J `qa_thread_compose_state` | Disqualification compose state per §25.3.3; phase read-only and NDA blockers are computed guards before write authorization |
| `redaction_verification_hash` | String | SHA-256; required | Hash of the carried-field allowlist used by §4.7.1 Console Bridge Event |
| `last_projected_at` | Timestamp | UTC; required | Last successful bridge projection |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor or buyer User ID | Actor that created the bridge projection |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor | Last projection updater |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete; set only when the parent Bid Workspace is soft-deleted |

**Scope Isolation.** Reads are scoped by `(org_id, console='seller', bid_workspace_id)`. A seller can read a projection only when `org_id = addressed_seller_org_id` for `PRIVATE` / `specific_vendor` threads, or when `question_audience = all_invited_vendors` and the seller has an active Bid Workspace for the same buyer Workspace. Cross-vendor reads that fail this predicate return HTTP 404 under the §7.2 non-leak rule. Buyer-internal comments are never represented; promoted buyer text is copied into a Q&A post without any back-pointer to Internal Comment Post per §25.7.7.

**Indexes.** `(org_id, bid_workspace_id, compose_state)`, `(source_thread_id, org_id)` unique, `(addressed_seller_org_id, thread_visibility)`, `(last_projected_at)`, `(deleted_at)`.

**Retention, DSAR, Residency.** Retention follows the parent Q&A Thread row and Workspace retention in §40.2. Seller-user PII in post authorship follows §6.8 Pattern B; buyer-user PII in seller projection is pseudonymized to public display name / role label only. Projection storage follows Bid Workspace residency per §4.4.1; source Workspace bytes remain in buyer residency and cross only through §4.7.1 redaction-canonicalized bridge payloads.

**State Machine Interaction with §25.5.** The `needs_reverification` field is an advisory flag, not a separate state — the row's `status` remains `submitted` until the seller explicitly re-submits (which clears the flag and updates `submitted_at`) or reverts to `draft`. `response_lock=true` is a hard write-guard: any write (edit, submit, attach, re-submit) is rejected with `bid_response_locked` (Appendix I) until the lock is released by a subsequent `requirement_unlocked` event (out of scope for v7.0.0; documented as a Known Gap).
