### 4.4.4 Capability Declaration (Console-Scoped, Seller) {#4.4.4-capability-declaration}

**Authoring Intent.** Capability Declaration is the seller-authored assertion that their software supports a specific capability. Per §48.4.12 Constraint #4 (taxonomy validation at write path) and §22.14.3 (KB-to-Capability suggestion flow), every declaration MUST be classified as either a **taxonomy declaration** — bound to a `canonical_capability_id` from §4.8.2 CapabilityRegistryEntry and eligible for Match-Score participation, discovery surfacing, and retrieval-scoped capability inference — or a **narrative-only** free-text declaration that is preserved as seller narrative but is **not** eligible for Match-Score, discovery, or agent retrieval without explicit seller promotion to a taxonomy declaration (a distinct write). The `capability_type` field makes this boundary schema-enforced rather than prose-implied per NB-9.

**Scope:** Console-scoped (seller console), org-scoped via `org_id`, attached to a single Seller Profile via `seller_profile_id`. Cross-console firewall: buyer consoles see a projected, capability_type-filtered view (narrative-only declarations are suppressed from programmatic buyer-side APIs; they surface only in seller-authored marketing page copy per §9.3.2).

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Seller's organization |
| `console` | Enum | `seller` (fixed) | Originating console (per §2 pattern) |
| `seller_profile_id` | UUID | FK → Seller Profile | Parent profile |
| `team_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → §4.2.4 Team | Seller Team that owns or curates the declaration. Required when `visibility = team_private`; nullable for Org-shared declarations. |
| `visibility` | Enum (Appendix J `capability_declaration_visibility`) | Default `org_shared` | `team_private` limits seller-console editing and picker visibility to the owning Team; `org_shared` allows reuse by all eligible seller Teams in the same Org. Marketplace projection remains governed by `capability_type` and `state`. |
| `capability_type` | Enum | See Appendix J `capability_declaration_type`: `taxonomy_declaration`, `narrative_only` | **NB-9 required.** Structured vs. free-text distinction. Derived Match-Score eligibility is `true` iff `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` AND `state = published` |
| `canonical_capability_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → §4.8.2 CapabilityRegistryEntry; **required when `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration`**, **forbidden when `capability_type = narrative_only`** | Binds the declaration to the Ops-managed capability registry; enforced at write |
| `marketplace_category_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → §4.4.7 Marketplace Category; required when `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` | Category under which the capability is declared; validated against registry entry's permitted categories |
| `sub_taxonomy_json` | JSON | ≤ 2,000 chars; required iff Marketplace Category marks `sub_taxonomy_required = true` | Keyed sub-taxonomy selections (e.g., module, region) per Category schema |
| `geographic_scope` | Array\[Enum\] | See Appendix J `capability_geographic_scope`: `global`, `north_america`, `emea`, `apac`, `latam`, `custom`; default `global`; required when `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` | Coverage regions for Match-Score gating |
| `name` | String | 1–200 chars; required for both types | Capability display name |
| `description` | String | 0–1,000 chars (taxonomy) / 0–2,000 chars (narrative-only) | Capability narrative; narrative-only permits longer free-text per Summary C.105 free-text-capability allowance |
| `maturity_level` | Enum | See Appendix J `capability_maturity_level`: `beta`, `production`, `mature`; required when `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration`; nullable when `narrative_only` | Maturity tier |
| `supported_use_cases` | Array\[String\] | Each ≤ 120 chars; ≤ 20 entries | Buyer use-case tags (taxonomy) / free-text (narrative-only) |
| `related_capabilities` | Array\[UUID\] | FK → Capability Declaration; ≤ 12 entries | Related seller-authored declarations |
| `evidence_kb_entry_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | FK → KB Entry; ≥ 3 required when `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` (per §22.14.3); forbidden when `narrative_only` | Evidence citations backing a taxonomy declaration |
| `pricing_metadata_json` | JSON | ≤ 4,000 chars; required when `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` AND registry entry sets `requires_pricing_metadata = true` | Pricing disclosure per Marketplace Category schema |
| `state` | Enum | See Appendix J `capability_declaration_state`: `draft`, `pending_review`, `published`, `rejected`, `quarantined_taxonomy`, `quarantined_registry`, `deprecated` | State machine below |

| `promoted_from_narrative_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Capability Declaration | Set when a taxonomy_declaration was created by promoting a prior narrative_only row (preserves audit linkage) |

| `last_taxonomy_validation_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Most recent successful taxonomy-validator run (§48.4.12 Constraint #4) |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Last editor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete |

**Indexes.** `(org_id, seller_profile_id, state)`, `(org_id, team_id, state)` partial where `team_id IS NOT NULL`, `(org_id, visibility, state)`, `(org_id, capability_type, state)`, `(canonical_capability_id, state)` partial where `state='published'`, `(marketplace_category_id, state)` partial where `state='published'`, `(last_taxonomy_validation_at)` for the nightly re-validation sweep, `(deleted_at)`.

**Scope Isolation.** Org-scoped rows are never leaked across consoles except via (a) buyer-side Match-Score computations on `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` rows with `state = published`, which project `canonical_capability_id`, `marketplace_category_id`, `geographic_scope`, `maturity_level`, and derived evidence counts (but never `evidence_kb_entry_ids` themselves — KB privacy per §8), and (b) seller-authored marketing pages (§9.3.2) which may surface either type at the seller's discretion. Narrative-only declarations never flow into Ops-managed directory, comparison, or heat-map pages.

**State Machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | Seller creates | Either type allowed; narrative_only skips most taxonomy validators | Not discoverable |
| `draft` | `pending_review` | Seller submits (taxonomy_declaration) | `canonical_capability_id`, `marketplace_category_id`, `evidence_kb_entry_ids.length ≥ 3`, geographic_scope, maturity_level populated; taxonomy validator passes | Narrative-only skips review and goes `draft → published` |
| `draft` | `published` | Seller publishes (narrative_only) | `capability_type = narrative_only`; name + description populated | No taxonomy review gate; NOT eligible for Match-Score |
| `pending_review` | `published` | Ops approves OR nightly auto-approve at 24h if no Ops flag | Per §22.14.3 review SLA | `published_at` set; discoverable |
| `pending_review` | `rejected` | Ops rejects | `pending_review_reason`-specific rejection; seller notified | Seller may revise and resubmit (new state_transition edge from `rejected → pending_review`) |
| `published` | `quarantined_taxonomy` | Nightly re-validator detects drift | e.g., `canonical_capability_id` retired (§4.8.2 state = `retired`) OR `marketplace_category_id` deprecated without successor resolved | Suppressed from buyer surfaces; seller notified with remediation prompt |
| `published` | `quarantined_registry` | §4.8.2 CapabilityRegistryEntry marked `compromised` / `recall` | Broad-strokes capability recall | Same suppression as taxonomy; recovery path via replacement `canonical_capability_id` |
| `quarantined_*` | `draft` | Seller edits to acknowledge quarantine | — | Clears quarantine state; re-enters review on resubmit |
| any terminal | `deprecated` | Seller retires OR Ops retires | Retired declarations retained for audit; not discoverable | — |
| `narrative_only / published` | `deprecated` (implicit) on promotion | Seller promotes to taxonomy_declaration | New row created with `promoted_from_narrative_id` set; original row transitions to `deprecated`, `superseded_by_id` set | Promotion is non-destructive |

**Write-Path Invariants.**

1. `capability_type` is immutable post-creation. To move between types, a new row MUST be created and the prior row transitioned to `deprecated` with `superseded_by_id` set (enforcement: write layer rejects `capability_type` mutation with HTTP 409 `capability_type_immutable` per Appendix I).
2. `canonical_capability_id` presence/absence MUST match `capability_type` per the field constraints above. Violations return HTTP 422 `capability_type_canonical_id_mismatch` (new; Appendix I).
3. `evidence_kb_entry_ids` MUST reference KB entries owned by the same `org_id` (enforcement at write; cross-org evidence rejected with HTTP 422 `capability_evidence_cross_org`).
4. `evidence_kb_entry_ids` MUST cite ≥ 3 KB entries sharing at least one overlapping `topic_tags` value per §22.14.3 rule set (enforcement at `draft → pending_review` transition; rejected with HTTP 422 `capability_evidence_topic_overlap_missing`).
5. Publishing a `narrative_only` declaration with `evidence_kb_entry_ids` populated MUST be rejected with HTTP 422 `capability_narrative_evidence_forbidden` (evidence is reserved for taxonomy declarations to prevent narrative-only row-padding).
6. `pricing_metadata_json` schema is validated against the Marketplace Category's declared schema at write; failure returns HTTP 422 `capability_pricing_metadata_schema_violation`.
7. The nightly revalidator MUST reclassify `capability_declaration_taxonomy_violation` fires by `violation_kind` (per §48.4.12) to either `quarantined_taxonomy` or `quarantined_registry` state and MUST emit `capability_declaration_quarantined_fired` per Appendix G.
8. `visibility = team_private` MUST require `team_id` and MUST reject cross-Team picker reads with HTTP 404; `visibility = org_shared` MAY have `team_id` for stewardship but remains reusable by eligible seller Teams inside the same Org. `reuse_count` is read-only and recomputed from submitted Bid Response references; direct client writes to `reuse_count` are rejected.

**Match-Score Eligibility (Derived, Not Stored).**

`match_score_eligible = (capability_type = 'taxonomy_declaration') AND (state = 'published') AND (last_taxonomy_validation_at ≥ now − 7 days)`. Stale re-validation (> 7 days) suppresses participation until the nightly sweep refreshes the timestamp; the buyer-side Match-Score computation MUST exclude stale rows.

**Retention & Privacy.** Life of seller Org; soft-deleted rows retained 180 days for Ops audit then hard-purged unless linked to an unsettled OutcomeContract (in which case retention extends per §40.2 `ai_operation_session_log_archive` alignment). `deprecated` rows are retained indefinitely to preserve `superseded_by_id` audit chains. DSAR: Seller user PII in `created_by` / `updated_by` only; anonymize on user-account deletion per §6.8. Residency: follows Seller Org residency partition.

**PostHog Events (Appendix G).**

| Event | Emitted When | Key Properties |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `capability_declaration_created` | Row created | `seller_org_id`, `capability_type`, `origin ∈ {seller_authored, kb_to_capability_suggestion}` |
| `capability_declaration_published` | State → `published` | `seller_org_id`, `capability_type`, `time_in_pending_review_seconds` (null if `narrative_only`) |
| `capability_declaration_type_promotion` | Row created with `promoted_from_narrative_id` set | `seller_org_id`, `promoted_from_id`, `days_between_narrative_and_promotion` |
| `capability_declaration_taxonomy_violation_fired` | Write rejected by §48.4.12 validator | Existing definition; see Appendix G M9-M13 subsection |
| `capability_declaration_quarantined_fired` | State → `quarantined_*` | `seller_org_id`, `prior_state`, `quarantine_reason_enum` |
| `capability_declaration_narrative_evidence_blocked` | HTTP 422 fired per invariant #5 | `seller_org_id`, `attempted_evidence_count` |
| `capability_declaration_match_score_eligibility_evaluated` | Buyer-side Match-Score computation | `buyer_org_id`, `capability_type_considered`, `eligible`, `excluded_reason ∈ {narrative_only, not_published, validation_stale, quarantined}` |

**Appendix J Enum Registrations (added in this prompt).**

1. `capability_declaration_type`: `taxonomy_declaration`, `narrative_only`
2. `capability_declaration_state`: `draft`, `pending_review`, `published`, `rejected`, `quarantined_taxonomy`, `quarantined_registry`, `deprecated`
3. `capability_declaration_quarantine_reason`: `canonical_id_retired`, `canonical_id_unknown`, `category_retired`, `sub_taxonomy_invalid`, `pricing_metadata_missing`, `evidence_insufficient`, `geographic_scope_unsupported`
4. `capability_maturity_level`: `beta`, `production`, `mature` (registers the previously prose-only enum)
5. `capability_geographic_scope`: `global`, `north_america`, `emea`, `apac`, `latam`, `custom`

**Appendix I Error Codes (added in this prompt).**

| Code | HTTP | Source Section | Semantics |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `capability_type_immutable` | 409 | §4.4.4 invariant #1 | `capability_type` mutation attempted on an existing row |
| `capability_type_canonical_id_mismatch` | 422 | §4.4.4 invariant #2 | `canonical_capability_id` presence/absence inconsistent with `capability_type` |
| `capability_evidence_cross_org` | 422 | §4.4.4 invariant #3 | `evidence_kb_entry_ids` references a KB entry from a different `org_id` |
| `capability_evidence_topic_overlap_missing` | 422 | §4.4.4 invariant #4 | `evidence_kb_entry_ids` fails topic-overlap rule per §22.14.3 |
| `capability_narrative_evidence_forbidden` | 422 | §4.4.4 invariant #5 | `narrative_only` declaration attempted with non-empty `evidence_kb_entry_ids` |
| `capability_pricing_metadata_schema_violation` | 422 | §4.4.4 invariant #6 | `pricing_metadata_json` fails Marketplace Category schema validation |

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Creating a `capability_type = taxonomy_declaration` row without `canonical_capability_id`, `marketplace_category_id`, or `geographic_scope` MUST be rejected with `capability_type_canonical_id_mismatch` (HTTP 422). Integration test asserts 100% rejection across a 1,000-row fabricated-input fixture.
2. Creating a `capability_type = narrative_only` row WITH `canonical_capability_id` set MUST be rejected with `capability_type_canonical_id_mismatch` (HTTP 422). The error payload MUST explicitly state "narrative_only declarations MUST NOT reference a canonical capability id; promote to taxonomy_declaration instead."
3. Attempting to mutate `capability_type` on an existing row MUST be rejected with `capability_type_immutable` (HTTP 409). The error payload MUST include a deep-link to the seller-console promotion flow.
4. Match-Score computations against a seller Org MUST exclude every row where `capability_type = narrative_only` OR `state ≠ published` OR `last_taxonomy_validation_at < now − 7 days`. Unit test asserts that a fixture seller with 10 narrative_only + 5 taxonomy_declaration rows yields a Match-Score surface area of exactly 5 (not 15).
5. Promoting a `narrative_only` row to `taxonomy_declaration` MUST create a new row with `promoted_from_narrative_id = <original_id>` and MUST transition the original row to `deprecated` with `superseded_by_id = <new_id>` atomically (single Convex transaction). Partial promotions MUST be rejected with HTTP 409 `capability_promotion_transaction_failed` (new; Appendix I).
6. Nightly re-validator MUST touch every `published` row's `last_taxonomy_validation_at` within a rolling 24-hour window; Ops Console SLA dashboard flags any row with `last_taxonomy_validation_at < now − 36 hours` as `validation_sweep_slo_breach` per §47.
7. `capability_declaration_match_score_eligibility_evaluated` event MUST fire exactly once per buyer Match-Score computation per declaration considered; duplicate emissions per request MUST be suppressed by the buyer-side retrieval cache (enforcement: PostHog dedup key = `(buyer_request_id, declaration_id)`).
8. A narrative-only declaration with seller-authored marketing text containing capability-like prose (e.g., regex match on Marketplace Category keyword lexicon) MUST surface a UI nudge: "Consider promoting this to a taxonomy declaration to appear in buyer discovery results." Nudge analytics event: `capability_narrative_promotion_nudge_shown`.
9. Buyer Console API `GET /v1/sellers/{org_id}/capabilities` MUST return **only** `taxonomy_declaration` rows in `state = published`; passing `?include=narrative_only` MUST return HTTP 403 `buyer_narrative_access_forbidden` (new; Appendix I).
10. A seller with 100% `narrative_only` declarations (no taxonomy rows) MUST surface a dashboard banner warning: "Your capabilities are not eligible for Match-Score. Promote at least one declaration to a taxonomy declaration to appear in buyer discovery results."

**Authored Extension Flag.** §4.4.4 is an extension of the v6 thin entity (fields `id`, `org_id`, `seller_profile_id`, `name`, `category`, `description`, `maturity_level`, `supported_use_cases`, `related_capabilities` retained with tightened constraints; all other fields, the state machine, invariants, Match-Score derivation, and acceptance criteria are Authored Extensions per NB-9 remediation and require human sign-off before v7.0.0 merge. Legacy `category` field is retained as a nullable free-text convenience field but is superseded by `marketplace_category_id` for taxonomy declarations.

### 4.4.7 Marketplace Category (Platform-Scoped, Ops-Managed Taxonomy) {#4.4.7-marketplace-category}

**Authoring Intent.** Marketplace Category is the canonical, Ops-maintained controlled-vocabulary taxonomy that all vendor-facing and platform-generated Marketplace entities reference by FK. Per Summary C.60 (Marketplace Tags & Controlled Vocabulary) this registry is maintained in the Ops Console CMS, not authored per-Org. Enumerates the `category` dimension used by SellerSoftware, SoftwarePage, CategoryPage, GuidePage, ComparisonPage, MarketIntelligenceReport, HeatMapCell, and SellerSignal.

**Scope:** Platform-scoped (no `org_id`; single global taxonomy). Not console-scoped. Read access is public; write access restricted to the Ops Console role `ops_taxonomy_admin` (new; added to Appendix J).

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `slug` | String | 3–60 chars, lowercase, `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, globally unique | URL segment for Category, Guide, Heat Map paths |
| `name` | String | 1–100 chars | Display name (e.g., "HRMS for Mid-Market") |
| `short_name` | String | 1–40 chars | Compact label for breadcrumbs and comparison headers |
| `description` | String | 0–2000 chars | Ops-authored category description (markdown) |
| `parent_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Marketplace Category | Supports two-level hierarchy (parent + child); deeper nesting rejected at write |
| `depth` | Integer | 0 or 1 | Computed; 0 = root, 1 = child. Enforced at write |
| `sort_order` | Integer | ≥ 0 | Display order within parent |
| `icon_token` | String | See Appendix J `marketplace_category_icon_token` | Design-system icon reference |
| `state` | Enum | See Appendix J `marketplace_category_state`: `draft`, `active`, `deprecated` | See state machine below |
| `deprecated_replaces_with_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Marketplace Category | Populated when `state=deprecated`; points to successor |
| `seo_metadata_json` | JSON | ≤ 4000 chars | Default `meta_title`, `meta_description`, and `hreflang` defaults for derived pages |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Ops User ID | Creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Ops User ID | Last editor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete; cascade per Scope Isolation below |

**Indexes.** `(slug)` unique, `(parent_id, sort_order)`, `(state)`, `(deleted_at)`.

**Scope Isolation.** Category rows are global. FKs pointing at Category (from SellerSoftware, SoftwarePage, etc.) do **not** confer any Org-level read access. Deleting (soft) a Category MUST NOT orphan SellerSoftware rows — the write layer rejects delete when ≥1 SellerSoftware references the Category; Ops must reassign via the `deprecated_replaces_with_id` migration worker (authored below) before soft-delete. Hard-delete is forbidden; deprecation is the terminal state.

**State Machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | Ops creates | — | New taxonomy node; not resolvable on public paths |
| `draft` | `active` | Ops publishes | Slug + name + parent valid; SEO metadata populated | Category becomes resolvable; search indexers pick up |
| `active` | `deprecated` | Ops deprecates | `deprecated_replaces_with_id` set; zero referencing SellerSoftware rows (after migration) | Public paths 301-redirect to successor; derived pages archived per each page type's state machine |
| `deprecated` | `active` | Ops reactivates | Within 30 days of deprecation | Reverses redirects and un-archives derived pages |
| `draft` | `deleted_at` (soft) | Ops deletes | Zero referencing rows | Only valid from `draft` |

**Retention.** Life of platform. Soft-deleted `draft` rows purged 30 days after soft-delete. `deprecated` nodes retained indefinitely to preserve historical FK integrity and redirect continuity. DSAR: not applicable (no PII). Residency: served from global edge cache; taxonomy does not carry customer data.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Creating a Category with `depth=1` and a `parent_id` that is itself `depth=1` MUST be rejected with error `taxonomy_max_depth_exceeded` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).
2. Attempting to soft-delete a Category that has ≥1 active referencing SellerSoftware row MUST be rejected with error `taxonomy_delete_blocked_by_references` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409). The error payload MUST include the count of referencing rows and a link to the migration endpoint.
3. Transitioning a Category to `deprecated` without `deprecated_replaces_with_id` populated MUST be rejected with error `taxonomy_deprecate_requires_successor` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).
4. Category slug collisions MUST be rejected at write with error `taxonomy_slug_conflict` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409). Slug is case-insensitive-unique.
5. Resolving a deprecated Category on a public path MUST 301-redirect to the successor's public path; the redirect chain depth MUST NOT exceed 3 hops.
6. Cache-invalidation events for CategoryPage, GuidePage, ComparisonPage, HeatMapCell, and MarketIntelligenceReport rows referencing an updated Category MUST fire within 60s of the Category `updated_at` bump (observable via the `taxonomy.category.updated` webhook authored in a subsequent phase).

### 4.4.8 Vendor Opt-Out Record (Org-Scoped, Seller-Origin, Platform-Honored) {#4.4.8-vendor-opt-out-record}

**Authoring Intent.** Vendor Opt-Out Record is the authoritative Opt-Out Registry per Summary C.123. A Seller Org uses it to suppress their name, pages, or product references from public-facing, Sourcera-owned Marketplace mechanics (Public Selection Reports, Category Pages, Comparison Pages, Heat Map, Market Intelligence Reports, Guide Pages, and any other downstream mechanic that references their identity). Opt-outs are retroactive (scan-and-redact existing rendered content), honored across all buyer Orgs, and append-only: new opt-outs create new rows rather than mutating prior ones, so the audit trail is immutable.

**Scope:** Org-scoped (`org_id` = Seller Org). Cross-Org read: Platform read access only (Ops Console + derived-page rendering paths); never exposed via the Buyer Console API.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Seller's organization |
| `console` | Enum | `seller` (fixed) | Identifies originating console |
| `scope_kind` | Enum | See Appendix J `vendor_opt_out_scope_kind`: `global`, `category`, `software`, `page_type`, `specific_page` | Controls suppression breadth |
| `scope_ref_id` | UUID (FK, polymorphic) | Nullable for `global`; required otherwise | FK target depends on `scope_kind` (Marketplace Category, SellerSoftware, Page entity, etc.) |
| `scope_ref_type` | Enum | See Appendix J `vendor_opt_out_scope_ref_type`: `marketplace_category`, `seller_software`, `category_page`, `comparison_page`, `guide_page`, `market_intelligence_report`, `heat_map_cell`, `public_selection_report`, `null` | `null` only when `scope_kind=global` or `page_type` |
| `page_type_filter` | Enum | Nullable; see Appendix J `vendor_opt_out_page_type_filter`: `comparison_page`, `category_page`, `guide_page`, `market_intelligence_report`, `heat_map_cell`, `public_selection_report`, `seller_org_page`, `software_page` | Required when `scope_kind=page_type`; forbidden otherwise |
| `effective_from` | Timestamp | Immutable | When the opt-out becomes active; may be backdated by Ops |
| `effective_until` | Timestamp | Nullable | Expiration; null = indefinite |
| `reason_code` | Enum | See Appendix J `vendor_opt_out_reason_code`: `legal`, `competitive`, `accuracy_dispute`, `gdpr_request`, `ops_imposed`, `other` | Drives Ops review routing |
| `reason_note` | String | 0–1000 chars | Seller-provided rationale; required when `reason_code=other` |
| `authority_attestation_id_ref` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → VendorOptOutAuthorityAttestation (§27.10.2.1) | Write-time authority proof. Required (non-null) on all rows created after the §27.10 authority model ships; nullable for legacy rows written before §27.10 (grandfathered as `ops_imposed` per §27.10.11.5 back-migration). MUST reference a `verified`-state attestation at write time; post-hoc revocation of the referenced attestation does NOT auto-revoke this row. Preserved for audit even if the referenced attestation is later hard-deleted. |
| `ops_review_status` | Enum | See Appendix J `vendor_opt_out_ops_review_status`: `auto_honored`, `pending_ops_review`, `approved`, `rejected`, `revoked` | Opt-outs are auto-honored on write; Ops review runs post-hoc per C.123 |
| `ops_reviewed_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; Ops User ID | Set on Ops action |
| `ops_reviewed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on Ops action |
| `ops_rejection_reason` | String | 0–500 chars; nullable | Populated when `ops_review_status=rejected` |
| `retro_backfill_status` | Enum | See Appendix J `vendor_opt_out_retro_backfill_status`: `pending`, `in_progress`, `complete`, `failed`, `not_applicable` | Tracks sweep of already-published pages |
| `retro_backfill_completed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when backfill sweep finishes |
| `retro_backfill_affected_page_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; nullable | Count of public-page rows updated |
| `retro_backfill_targets_swept_json` | JSON | ≤ 4000 chars; nullable; required when `retro_backfill_status IN ('complete', 'failed')` | Per-target sweep ledger. Array of `{surface_id, table, row_count, swept_at, success, failure_reason}` entries covering every §27.10.3 enforcement surface reached by the retroactive sweep |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Must hold seller-console role `seller_billing_admin` or `seller_org_admin` |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User or Ops ID | Last editor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete; equivalent to `revoked` when `ops_review_status=revoked` |

**Indexes.** `(org_id, scope_kind, scope_ref_type, scope_ref_id)` composite for fast suppression lookup; `(ops_review_status, created_at)` for Ops review queue; `(retro_backfill_status)` partial index on non-terminal states; `(effective_from, effective_until)` for active-window queries; `(authority_attestation_id_ref)` partial on non-null for attestation-to-opt-out reverse lookup (supports the §27.10.6.7 `GET /v1/opt-outs/authority-attestations/:id` detail response that enumerates dependent opt-outs).

**Scope Isolation.** Writes are restricted to seller-console sessions with role `seller_billing_admin` or `seller_org_admin`. Buyer-console API MUST return 404 (not 403) if a buyer token attempts any CRUD; error code `vendor_opt_out_cross_console_access` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 404). Ops Console retains full read + state-machine transitions. The Registry is queried by every public-page render path as a precondition — rendering MUST abort with a "Vendor opted out" placeholder when a matching opt-out is active.

**Suppression Match Semantics.** At page render, the registry is evaluated against the candidate `(seller_org_id, referenced_entity_type, referenced_entity_id)` tuple. Match rules:

- `global` → suppresses all references to this seller_org across all public-page types.
- `category` → suppresses references to this seller_org on any page whose primary Category matches `scope_ref_id` OR on any SoftwarePage whose SellerSoftware's Category matches.
- `software` → suppresses references to a specific SellerSoftware `scope_ref_id`.
- `page_type` → suppresses references to this seller_org on all pages of `page_type_filter`.
- `specific_page` → suppresses references on a single named public-page row (`scope_ref_id` + `scope_ref_type`).

**State Machine (`ops_review_status`).**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `auto_honored` | Seller creates | `effective_from ≤ now`, valid scope | Suppression active immediately; retro sweep scheduled |
| `auto_honored` | `pending_ops_review` | Flagged for review | Reason code in `{legal, gdpr_request, accuracy_dispute}` OR seller Org flagged by SIM (C.100) | Seller-visible status remains "Active"; Ops queue populated |
| `pending_ops_review` | `approved` | Ops approves | Ops user with `ops_opt_out_admin` role | Suppression remains active; `ops_reviewed_at` stamped |
| `pending_ops_review` | `rejected` | Ops rejects | Rejection reason required | Suppression reversed; `retro_backfill` re-fires in reverse |
| `approved` / `auto_honored` | `revoked` | Seller revokes OR Ops revokes | Any time | Suppression lifted; retro backfill re-populates the affected pages |

**Retention & DSAR.**

- Identity fields (`created_by`): pseudonymized on DSAR within 30 days per §6.8, leaving `retro_backfill_affected_page_count` and the opt-out record itself intact for audit.
- Reason notes: pseudonymized with the identity fields.
- Record retention: Org-life + 7 years to preserve Marketplace audit trail and legal defensibility of suppression decisions. Not subject to right-to-erasure under the §6.8.5 row #8 platform-integrity retained-row class.
- Residency: record stored in originating Seller Org's data region; consumers (global page-render paths) query via a globally-replicated read index.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Race between seller write and page render.** Public-page render paths MUST evaluate the Opt-Out Registry against a snapshot taken within 60s of the render; snapshots older than 60s are rejected and re-computed. Pages rendered before an opt-out's `effective_from` are re-rendered within 15 minutes of opt-out write (triggers `vendor_opt_out.applied` webhook + cache bust).
2. **Opt-out targeting a deleted entity.** If `scope_ref_id` points at a soft-deleted target, the opt-out remains valid for historical pages during the target's soft-delete window. After hard-purge of the target, `ops_review_status=auto_honored` rows with `scope_ref_type` pointing at the purged entity transition to `revoked` with reason `scope_target_purged` (authored here; add to `vendor_opt_out_rejection_reason`).
3. **Ops-imposed opt-outs vs. seller-originated opt-outs.** Ops may create opt-outs with `reason_code=ops_imposed`; these skip the seller-side write-gate (created_by is an Ops User ID) and cannot be revoked by the seller — only by Ops.
4. **Backfill sweep fails mid-flight.** If `retro_backfill_status=failed`, the opt-out remains active (fail-closed). The sweep worker re-attempts under the non-webhook `retroactive_sweep` worker policy and pages the Ops on-call after 5 consecutive failures.
5. **Cross-Category deprecation with successor.** If a Category is deprecated and successors are reassigned, `category`-scoped opt-outs are cloned at write to the successor Category with `reason_code=ops_imposed` (authored extension; flagged).
6. **Post-hoc attestation revocation.** The referenced `VendorOptOutAuthorityAttestation` (§27.10.2.1) is revoked or expires after the opt-out was written. The opt-out MUST remain `auto_honored` — authority was satisfied at write time per §27.10.11.5; `authority_attestation_id_ref` is preserved for audit. Re-activation of the same scope after `revoked` requires a fresh, `verified` attestation per §27.10.2.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Seller Billing Admin or Org Admin creating a `global` opt-out MUST see all referenced public pages redact the seller's name within 15 minutes (measured via `vendor_opt_out.applied` webhook timestamps).
2. Any buyer-console session attempting to read/write the Opt-Out Registry API MUST receive HTTP 404 with `vendor_opt_out_cross_console_access`.
3. A reason_code of `other` with empty `reason_note` MUST be rejected at write with `vendor_opt_out_reason_note_required` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).
4. Revoking an opt-out MUST re-publish the previously suppressed pages within 15 minutes and emit `vendor_opt_out.revoked`.
5. Retroactive backfill sweep MUST update `retro_backfill_affected_page_count` accurately (tolerance ±0) AND populate `retro_backfill_targets_swept_json` with one entry for every §27.10.3 enforcement surface where the opted-out Seller Org or SellerSoftware can appear. Every required surface entry MUST record `success=true`, `row_count`, and `swept_at` within the applicable §4.5.6 / §27.10.5 retroactive-sweep SLO; failure or omission leaves `retro_backfill_status=failed` and pages Ops. QA suite `vendor_opt_out_retro_backfill_surface_coverage` compares the §27.10.3 surface allowlist against the ledger.
6. A `POST /v1/opt-outs` write MUST populate `authority_attestation_id_ref` with the header-or-body-supplied `authority_attestation_id` AND the server MUST validate that the reference points to a `verified`-state `VendorOptOutAuthorityAttestation` row within the caller's `org_id` at write time; all other states (`pending_proof`, `proof_submitted`, `expired`, `failed`, `revoked`) are rejected with HTTP 403 `vendor_opt_out_authority_not_verified` per §27.10.6.1. QA test `vendor_opt_out_authority_attestation_ref_enforced` asserts.
7. Subsequent revocation of the referenced attestation MUST NOT transition this row's `ops_review_status`; a nightly reconciliation job emits `vendor_opt_out_authority_ref_orphaned` (new; Appendix G) when `authority_attestation_id_ref` points to a `revoked` or `expired` attestation for observability, but does NOT mutate the opt-out row. QA test `vendor_opt_out_authority_post_hoc_revocation` (shared with §27.10.9 AC #29) asserts.

### 4.4.9 SellerSoftware (Console-Scoped, Seller) {#4.4.9-sellersoftware}

**Authoring Intent.** SellerSoftware represents a single software product owned by a Seller Org — distinct from the Seller Org itself — per Summary §6.15.5. One Seller Org → many SellerSoftware rows. Powers Software Pages, Comparison Pages, per-product Capability Declarations, per-product KB namespaces, and Marketplace search granularity. Introduced because a vendor with five products cannot be adequately represented by a single Seller Profile row.

**Scope:** Console-scoped (Seller). Not Marketplace-domain — this is the authoring entity; the public-facing render is SoftwarePage (§4.4.11).

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Seller's organization |
| `console` | Enum | `seller` (fixed) | Identifies console scope |
| `seller_profile_id` | UUID | FK → Seller Profile | Parent profile |
| `name` | String | 1–200 chars | Product name as marketed |
| `slug` | String | 3–80 chars, `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, unique within `(org_id)` AND globally unique for published rows | URL segment; see Slug Collision Rule below |
| `tagline` | String | 0–200 chars | Short pitch |
| `description` | String | 0–5000 chars | Markdown; product description |
| `category_id` | UUID | FK → Marketplace Category (§4.4.7); `depth=1` preferred | Primary category |
| `secondary_category_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | 0–3 entries; FKs → Marketplace Category | Additional categories (surfaced in Comparison Pages) |
| `logo_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL; ≤ 2000 chars | Product logo |
| `hero_image_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL; ≤ 2000 chars; nullable | Hero/banner |
| `pricing_model` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_software_pricing_model`: `subscription`, `consumption`, `perpetual`, `custom`, `freemium` | Pricing type |
| `pricing_summary` | String | 0–1000 chars | Human-readable pricing note |
| `maturity_stage` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_software_maturity_stage`: `alpha`, `beta`, `ga`, `sunset` | Product lifecycle |
| `capability_declaration_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | 0–500 entries; FKs → Capability Declaration (§4.4.4) | Normalized association (see scope rule below) |
| `kb_namespace_id` | UUID (FK) | FK → KB Namespace (per KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4) | Software-level KB namespace; one-to-one |
| `former_kb_namespace_ids` | Array\[UUID\] | 0–10 entries | Historical namespaces from prior renames/merges; used by retrieval for provenance (KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4) |
| `claim_status` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_software_claim_status`: `unclaimed`, `claim_pending`, `claim_verified`, `claim_disputed`, `claim_revoked` | See state machine below |
| `claim_verified_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when `claim_status=claim_verified` |
| `claim_verified_by_method` | Enum | Nullable; see Appendix J `seller_software_claim_verification_method`: `dns_txt`, `email_verification`, `ops_manual_verification`, `sso_domain_match` | How claim was verified |
| `claim_disputed_by_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Organization | Disputing party (other Seller Org) |
| `page_status` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_software_page_status`: `no_page`, `page_drafting`, `page_pending_review`, `page_published`, `page_suppressed_by_opt_out`, `page_archived` | Tracks linked SoftwarePage lifecycle (denormalized for list views; SoftwarePage.publication_status is source of truth) |
| `seo_status` | Enum | See Appendix J `seller_software_seo_status`: `not_indexed`, `indexing_pending`, `indexed`, `deindexed_by_opt_out`, `deindexed_manual` | SEO indexing state |
| `seo_last_crawled_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last observed crawl (via Search Console API; updated daily) |
| `vendor_opt_out_honored_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last time the Opt-Out Registry was evaluated for this row (see Opt-Out Registry Source-of-Truth Rule below) |
| `vendor_opt_out_ref_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Vendor Opt-Out Record (§4.4.8) | Active opt-out suppressing this Software's visibility, if any |
| `retention_tier` | Enum | See Appendix J `data_retention_tier`: `standard`, `extended_financial` | Drives retention; `standard` by default |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Creator |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Last editor |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete; triggers KB namespace migration per KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4 |

**Indexes.** `(org_id, slug)` unique, `(slug) WHERE page_status='page_published'` unique (global slug contention only for published rows), `(category_id, claim_status)`, `(kb_namespace_id)` unique, `(vendor_opt_out_ref_id)` partial, `(deleted_at)`.

**Scope Isolation.** Console-scoped to the owning Seller Org. Capability Declarations referenced via `capability_declaration_ids` MUST resolve to declarations where `org_id` matches this SellerSoftware's `org_id`; cross-Org references rejected at write with `seller_software_cross_org_capability_ref` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422). Buyer-console API MUST NOT expose SellerSoftware rows in `draft`/`page_drafting` state; only `page_published` rows (via the SoftwarePage projection) are buyer-visible.

**Slug Collision Rule.** Slugs are unique within an Org (to support draft/staging workflows) and globally unique for rows with `page_status=page_published`. Transitioning a row to `page_published` when its slug collides with another published row MUST be rejected with `seller_software_slug_collision` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409). Slug may be changed while the row is in `no_page` or `page_drafting`; once published, slug becomes immutable (append-only — rename creates a 301 redirect slug-alias row authored in Phase 3).

**Opt-Out Registry Source-of-Truth Rule.** `vendor_opt_out_honored_at` is stamped every time the render path (or the nightly sweep) evaluates the Opt-Out Registry for this Software. `vendor_opt_out_ref_id` is populated only when an active opt-out matches this row; it is nulled when the opt-out is revoked or expires. The Opt-Out Registry (§4.4.8) remains the canonical source; `vendor_opt_out_ref_id` is a denormalized pointer for read-path performance and MUST be reconciled nightly against the Registry. Reconciliation drift ≥1% fires an Ops alert.

**State Machine (`claim_status`).**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `unclaimed` | Row created by Sourcera enrichment worker before any seller has claimed | Row auto-created from Summary §6.15.4 seller enrichment or ghost-bid imports | Public SoftwarePage may render in "unclaimed" state with a "Claim this listing" CTA |
| `unclaimed` | `claim_pending` | A seller Org initiates claim | Must provide one of: DNS TXT record, verified email at domain, SSO domain match | Claim expires after 14 days if not verified |
| `claim_pending` | `claim_verified` | Verification succeeds | `claim_verified_by_method` populated; domain cross-check passes | Seller Org granted edit rights; `seller_profile_id` set |
| `claim_pending` | `claim_disputed` | A second Org initiates concurrent claim | `claim_disputed_by_org_id` populated | Both claims frozen pending Ops resolution |
| `claim_disputed` | `claim_verified` | Ops resolves in favor of one party | `ops_resolution_note` logged in audit | Losing party notified and blocked from re-claim for 30 days |
| `claim_verified` | `claim_revoked` | Ops revokes (e.g., domain ownership lost, fraud) OR seller Org deleted | — | Row reverts to `unclaimed`; SoftwarePage suppressed |
| `claim_pending` | `unclaimed` | 14-day TTL expires without verification | — | Claim attempt cleared; logged in audit |

**KB Namespace Relationship.** Each SellerSoftware owns exactly one KB namespace (`kb_namespace_id`). Namespace is auto-created on SellerSoftware creation and auto-migrated to the Org namespace on SellerSoftware soft-delete per KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4 (which authored the migration procedure). `former_kb_namespace_ids` is append-only; entries never removed, so provenance audits across renames remain reconstructable.

**Retention & DSAR.**

- Row retention: Org-life. On Seller Org deletion (§7.2 cascade), SellerSoftware soft-deleted then hard-purged after 90 days, with KB namespace migrated to a platform-managed "orphan" namespace for retrieval continuity of historical bids.
- DSAR: `created_by` and `updated_by` pseudonymized on user deprovisioning; product content (description, capability refs) retained as Org-owned material.
- Residency: SellerSoftware rows stored in the Seller Org's data region; public-page projections (SoftwarePage) are globally cached at the edge.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Two Orgs claim the same product.** Resolved via `claim_disputed` state + Ops arbitration.
2. **Seller Org loses domain ownership.** Resolved via Ops revocation (`claim_revoked`) + 30-day re-claim block.
3. **Category deprecated while SellerSoftware references it.** Migration worker reassigns to successor Category (per §4.4.7); `secondary_category_ids` pruned of deprecated entries.
4. **KB namespace orphaned on deletion.** Handled by KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4 migration procedure.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Creating a SellerSoftware with a Category that is `state=deprecated` MUST be rejected with `seller_software_category_deprecated` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 422).
2. Two concurrent claims for the same `slug`+`name` from different Orgs MUST both transition to `claim_disputed`; neither Org may edit the row until Ops resolves.
3. Soft-deleting a SellerSoftware MUST trigger KB namespace migration within 5 minutes (observable via `kb_namespace_migration` audit event per KB_Engineering_Spec §5.4).
4. Publishing a SoftwarePage for a SellerSoftware with `claim_status != claim_verified` MUST be rejected with `seller_software_page_requires_verified_claim` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
5. Reading a SellerSoftware with `vendor_opt_out_ref_id != null` through any public endpoint MUST return the suppressed projection (name redacted to the seller's chosen placeholder, capability declarations hidden).
6. Capability Declaration references in `capability_declaration_ids` MUST be reverse-validated nightly; dangling references increment the `seller_software.capability_reference_drift` metric (Appendix G) and page the Ops on-call at drift ≥1%.

Auto-enriched via the Opus-tier `page_enrichment` capability, which crawls the seller's public surfaces and drafts content for seller review before publication. Verified domain ownership (via the Seller Org's SSO or Seller Profile claim workflow) gates publication.

**Scope:** Marketplace-domain (public). `org_id` retained as the canonical ownership pointer; however, read access is public and not gated by Org-level ACLs. Write access is restricted to Seller Org members with `seller_org_admin` or `seller_marketing_editor` (new role — added to Appendix J).

The `seller_` prefix disambiguates from the buyer-side surface; canonical-id-lock validator carries an explicit allow-list entry per §21.4.1.A. |

**Scope Isolation.** Publication path is public. Authoring/preview endpoints require seller-console session with the authoring roles above. Buyer-console sessions receive only the public projection (same as anonymous). The `pending_enrichment_draft_json` field MUST NEVER leak into the public projection — enforced by a whitelist-only API serializer.

**State Machine (`publication_status`).**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | Seller creates | — | Not yet enriched |
| `draft` | `pending_enrichment` | Enrichment requested | `seller_page_enrichment` capability AIOperation queued (§21.4.2 row 1; canonical `capability_id`); legacy `page_enrichment` alias accepted at API boundary and rewritten to canonical at write time per §21.4.1.A `CapabilityRegistryEntry.aliases` | AIOperation billed per `CapabilityRegistryEntry.cost_center_default` resolution at AIOperation creation (§4.8.1 / §4.8.2). `seller_page_enrichment` resolves to `customer_billed` at v7.1.0 ($8.00 value-priced / $1.10 cost-priced; `seller_starter` minimum plan-gate; per-tier quota is authoritative only in §34.1.2 cell **Seller Page Enrichment (Opus)**). Cost center stored on the AIOperation row + denormalized to `SellerOrgPage.enrichment_cost_center_resolved` for billing-ledger audit. Deploy-time validator `enrichment_cost_center_single_source` asserts neither §4.4.10 nor §4.4.11 nor §26.7.2 hardcodes a literal cost-center value outside the registry-resolution path. |
| `pending_enrichment` | `pending_review` | Enrichment completes | `pending_enrichment_draft_json` populated | Seller must review before publish |
| `pending_review` | `draft` | Seller rejects draft | — | Seller may edit and re-request enrichment |
| `pending_review` | `published` | Seller approves + publishes | `domain_ownership_verified_at` not null; `meta_title`, `meta_description` populated; no active matching opt-out | `schema_org_payload_json` regenerated at publish |
| `published` | `pending_review` | Seller edits (non-trivial) | Seller edits triggering enrichment re-run | Auto re-enrichment optional |
| `published` | `suppressed_by_opt_out` | Matching VendorOptOutRecord activates | — | Public URL returns a "Vendor opted out" stub; cache bust within 15 min |
| `suppressed_by_opt_out` | `published` | Opt-out revoked | — | Republished automatically |
| Any | `archived` | Seller archives OR Org deletion cascade | — | URL 410-gones; 410 response cached for 30 days then purged |

**Retention & DSAR.**

- Published rows retained for Org-life.
- On Seller Org deletion (§7.2): transition to `archived`, 90-day retention, then purge. `schema_org_payload_json` cache purged within 30 days; CDN cache explicitly busted.
- DSAR: authored fields (bios, contact callouts) containing PII are redacted within 30 days; page content is Org-owned and retained unless DSAR targets a specific author.
- Residency: SellerOrgPage stored in the Seller Org's `data_residency_region`; public cache served from global edge; page payload is non-PII by construction (any PII must be explicitly authored and is subject to DSAR sweep).

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Domain ownership revoked post-publication.** Trigger: Seller Profile claim revoked → cascade transitions SellerOrgPage to `suppressed_by_opt_out` with synthetic opt-out record (`reason_code=ops_imposed`). Authored extension.
2. **Enrichment returns content that fails content validators (§3.5 anti-spam).** Drafts rejected; Ops alerted; cost not charged to Platform Marketing (reversal per §34.11 Outcome Resolver).
3. **Schema.org cache drift.** Nightly reconciliation worker regenerates `schema_org_payload_json` if `updated_at > schema_org_payload_refreshed_at + 24h`.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publishing without `domain_ownership_verified_at` MUST be rejected with `seller_org_page_requires_domain_verification` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
2. A published SellerOrgPage receiving a matching opt-out MUST transition to `suppressed_by_opt_out` within 15 minutes (measured via `vendor_opt_out.applied` webhook chain).
3. Public GET requests for a suppressed page MUST return HTTP 200 with the placeholder body (not 404; 404 would break SEO and invite recrawl thrash); `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` header required.
4. `pending_enrichment_draft_json` MUST NOT appear in any public or buyer-console response payload; enforced by serializer test in §13.10-style QA suite.

- Publication additionally requires `claim_status=claim_verified` on the parent SellerSoftware; enforced at state transition with `seller_software_page_requires_verified_claim`.
- Slug changes before publication may be propagated from SellerSoftware slug changes; post-publication slug is immutable.
- Category reassignment on the parent SellerSoftware triggers a re-validation sweep: if the new Category is `deprecated` without successor, SoftwarePage transitions to `pending_review` automatically.
- `schema_org_payload_json` emits `Product` rather than `Organization` as the root type.

**Retention, DSAR, Residency.** Identical to SellerOrgPage (§4.4.10). On parent SellerSoftware soft-delete, SoftwarePage transitions to `archived` and the URL returns HTTP 410 for 30 days before hard-purge.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Parent SellerSoftware claim revoked.** Cascades to SoftwarePage `suppressed_by_opt_out` with synthetic opt-out (authored extension).
2. **Category deprecation without successor.** Sweep transitions SoftwarePage to `pending_review` and pages Ops; manual Category reassignment required before re-publish.
3. **Slug collision between SellerOrgPage and SoftwarePage.** Namespaces are distinct (`/sellers/:slug` vs `/software/:slug`); both routes accept independent slug namespaces. Collision within the SoftwarePage namespace enforced by `(slug)` unique index.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publishing a SoftwarePage whose parent SellerSoftware has `claim_status != claim_verified` MUST be rejected with `seller_software_page_requires_verified_claim` (already in Appendix I per §4.4.9 acceptance criterion).
2. Category deprecation on the parent MUST transition this SoftwarePage to `pending_review` within 60s.
3. All SellerOrgPage acceptance criteria (§4.4.10) apply, adapted to SoftwarePage FKs.

### 4.4.12 CategoryPage (Marketplace-Domain, Sourcera-Owned, Public) {#4.4.12-categorypage}

**Indexes.** `(category_id) WHERE publication_status='published'` unique, `(slug)` unique across published rows, `(next_scheduled_refresh_at)` partial on non-archived, `(editorial_review_status, updated_at)` for review queue, `(publication_status)`, `(publication_status, seo_indexed, last_published_at DESC)` for the published-and-indexed sitemap sweep (required for the residency-filtered public index per §40.3 — partial index scoped to `publication_status='published'` ensures EU/US residency-split sitemap generation completes within sub-500ms at scale).

**Scope Isolation.** No `org_id`; no Org-scoped ACLs. All customer-visible fields are public. Generation + editorial workflow runs entirely in the Ops Console. The page MUST never render vendor names in `referenced_vendor_opt_out_map_json`; enforced by a serializer test that walks `body_sections_json` and `vendor_shortlist_seller_software_ids` against the opt-out map.

**k-Anonymity Enforcement.** Any metric rendered on this page that is derived from buyer-side aggregates (e.g., "Average evaluation duration: 6 weeks across N buyers") MUST meet the §48.4.7 Signal-tier / §48.6.4 M9 floor per rendered metric. At render, any metric failing the floor is replaced with the placeholder "Insufficient data" and logged to `posthog.category_page_k_anon_gate_hit`. Publication is permitted with `k_anon_satisfied=false` only if the page contains zero aggregate-derived metrics (pure editorial content); the check is enforced at state transition to `published`.

**State Machine.** Same as `page_publication_status` (see §4.4.10), plus one added transition:

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `published` | `pending_review` | `next_scheduled_refresh_at` reached | Refresh job runs `category_faq_generation`; editorial-required categories re-enter review | If `editorial_review_status=not_required` (trivial refresh), transitions straight back to `published` without human review — allowed for minor version bumps where the diff-score from the last approved version is <10% (authored extension; flagged) |

**Retention.** Published rows: life of platform unless Category deprecated (archive after deprecation + 180 days; 301-redirect to successor CategoryPage). Rejected drafts retained 90 days then purged. DSAR: not applicable (no PII authored on platform-generated pages); referenced vendor identities are governed by the Opt-Out Registry.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **`category_faq_generation` failure.** Refresh job fails; page remains on prior `content_version`; Ops alerted after 3 consecutive failures.
2. **k-anon drops after publication** (signal cohort shrinks below floor due to DSAR or opt-out). Nightly sweep sets `k_anon_satisfied=false` and transitions aggregate-dependent pages to `pending_review`.
3. **Referenced vendor opts out after publication.** Render-path redaction using `referenced_vendor_opt_out_map_json`; `vendor_opt_out.applied` webhook fans out a cache-bust within 15 minutes.
4. **Editorial reviewer unavailable.** Queue depth alert at >20 pages pending review for >7 days.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publishing with `k_anon_satisfied=false` AND any rendered aggregate metric MUST be rejected with `category_page_k_anon_floor_not_met` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
2. `category_faq_generation` runs MUST be tagged `cost_center=sourcera_owned` in the Usage Event ledger (§4.3.18); any run tagged with a customer Org MUST be flagged and reversed via §34.11 Outcome Resolver.
3. A referenced SellerSoftware acquiring an active opt-out MUST cause this page to redact the vendor row within 15 minutes and emit `category_page.vendor_redacted`.
4. Category deprecation MUST transition all CategoryPages for that Category to `archived` within 24 hours and install a 301 redirect to the successor Category's CategoryPage.
5. A deterministic regression test (§44.4 load-style) validates that no metric rendered on a published CategoryPage references a signal cohort below the §48.6.4 M9 floor.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Publication with `|compared_seller_software_ids| < 2` after suppression MUST be rejected with `comparison_page_insufficient_vendors` (new; Appendix I; HTTP 409).
2. `schema_org_payload_json` MUST never list an opted-out `Product`; automated Schema.org validator in QA suite.
3. When a `suppressed_seller_software_ids` transition reduces non-suppressed count below 2, the page MUST archive + 410-gone within 15 minutes.
4. Editorial review MUST be completed before any publish; automated publish without `editorial_review_status=approved` MUST be rejected.
