### 4.4.28 TemplateLibraryEntry (Marketplace-Domain, Ops-Curated + Seller-Proposable, Public) {#4.4.28-templatelibraryentry}

**Authoring intent.** The Template Library (§48.2.10 Loop L9 Template Publish Incentive and §48.3.5 S6 template-reuse flywheel) curates reusable RFP / evaluation / scoring templates. TemplateLibraryEntry is the persisted template row.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | PK, immutable | Standard. |
| `template_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `template_kind` (new: `rfp_template`, `evaluation_criteria_template`, `scoring_rubric_template`, `requirement_list_template`, `vendor_question_template`); required | Template domain. |
| `canonical_slug` | String | 3–120 chars; `[a-z0-9-]+`; unique across template library; required | Public URL slug. |
| `display_name` | String | 3–120 chars; required | Human-readable name. |
| `description_markdown` | String | 50–2,000 chars; required | Template description. |
| `category_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; → TaxonomyNode (kind=`category`) | Category context. |
| `body_json` | JSON | ≤ 50,000 chars | Structured template content (requirement list, scoring rubric, etc.). |
| `body_content_version` | String | Semver; required | Versioning per §48.6.1 content-version convention. |
| `contributor_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → Organization | Set when a seller (S6 flywheel) OR buyer (L9 incentive) contributed the template. |
| `contributor_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → User | Specific user who contributed. |
| `curator_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → Ops User | Ops curator who approved (for Ops-curated templates). |
| `curation_state` | Enum | Appendix J `template_curation_state` (new: `draft_by_contributor`, `pending_ops_review`, `published`, `featured`, `deprecated`, `rejected_by_curator`); required | Curation lifecycle. |
| `featured_placement_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `template_featured_placement_kind` (existing: `category_top`, `surface_carousel`, `public_landing`); nullable | Set when `curation_state = 'featured'`. |
| `featured_placement_earned_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when featured-earning threshold crosses. |
| `usage_count_total` | Integer | Default 0; required | Count of template clones / instantiations. |
| `usage_count_30d` | Integer | Default 0; required | Rolling 30-day usage; nightly recompute. |
| `usage_count_threshold_for_featured` | Integer | Default 50; required | S6 flywheel featured-placement threshold per §48.3.5. |
| `last_published_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on first transition to `published`. |
| `last_deprecated_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on transition to `deprecated`. |
| `k_anon_render_gate_applicable` | Boolean | Required; default FALSE | TRUE for templates whose body includes aggregate signals (per §48.6.4); if TRUE, templates render through §48.6.4 k-anon gate. |
| `schema_org_payload_json` | JSON | ≤ 5,000 chars; nullable | Per §48.6.1 contract for Schema.org HowTo type. |
| `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `deleted_at` | Standard | Standard pattern | Soft delete forbidden for `curation_state IN ('published', 'featured')`; use `deprecated` transition instead. |

**Scope isolation.** Marketplace-domain (platform-public readable). Write access: `ops_marketplace_curator` (new Ops role) for direct Ops-curated templates; seller and buyer users via `POST /v1/templates/propose` for contributor-proposed templates. Read access: public (via Marketplace API) for `published` AND `featured`; Ops-only for `draft_by_contributor`, `pending_ops_review`, `deprecated`, `rejected_by_curator`.

**Required indexes.** `(template_kind, curation_state, usage_count_30d DESC)` (public browsing); `(canonical_slug)` UNIQUE; `(category_id, curation_state)` (category-top featured queries); `(contributor_org_id, curation_state) WHERE contributor_org_id IS NOT NULL` (sparse; contributor-facing dashboards); `(featured_placement_kind, featured_placement_earned_at DESC)` (sparse; featured carousel ordering).

**Retention.** Perpetual for `published` / `featured`; 1 year post-`last_deprecated_at` for `deprecated`; 90 days for `rejected_by_curator`. DSAR pseudonymization applies to `contributor_user_id`, `curator_user_id` per §6.8; template body preserved under §45.1.

**Curation state machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft_by_contributor` | Contributor proposes via `POST /v1/templates/propose` | Any authenticated user | Body validation; anti-spam §48.4.4 / §48.4.5 classifier. |
| (init) | `published` | Ops curator direct-creates via Ops endpoint | `ops_marketplace_curator` role | Bypasses contributor flow; `curator_user_id` populated. |
| `draft_by_contributor` | `pending_ops_review` | Contributor submits for review | Anti-spam classifier pass | Ops queue. |
| `pending_ops_review` | `published` | Ops curator approves | Curator approves | Featured placement consideration auto-evaluated post-publish. |
| `pending_ops_review` | `rejected_by_curator` | Ops curator rejects | Rejection note required | Contributor notified. |
| `published` | `featured` | Usage threshold crossed | `usage_count_30d >= usage_count_threshold_for_featured` | Emits `template_featured_placement_earned` (§48 extensions; existing). |
| `featured` | `published` | Usage threshold drops | `usage_count_30d < usage_count_threshold_for_featured / 2` (hysteresis to prevent flapping) | Demoted from featured. |
| `published`, `featured` | `deprecated` | Ops curator deprecates | `ops_marketplace_curator` | `last_deprecated_at` populated; redirect to replacement template if specified. |
| `deprecated` | `published` | Ops curator rehydrates | `ops_marketplace_curator`; rare | Undeprecation. |

**Invariants.** (a) `featured_placement_kind` is non-null IFF `curation_state = 'featured'`. (b) `curator_user_id` is non-null IFF `curation_state ∈ {published, featured, deprecated, rejected_by_curator}`. (c) `contributor_org_id` is non-null IFF template was contributor-proposed (else Ops-direct-authored). (d) `k_anon_render_gate_applicable = true` requires `category_id` to be a valid residency-aware category per §4.5.4.

**Clone / instantiation behavior.** A template clone creates a per-Org copy bound to the user's workspace; `usage_count_total` and `usage_count_30d` are atomically incremented on the source template. Clones fire `template_clone_attributed` (Loop L2 per §48.2.3) with `attribution_template_id = source_template_id`. The cloned content is Org-scoped and independent of subsequent template updates (no live-link).

**PostHog events.**

| Event | Trigger | Key Properties |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `template_library_entry_proposed` | Contributor proposes | `template_id`, `contributor_org_id`, `template_kind`, `category_id` |
| `template_library_entry_published` | Ops approves OR direct-creates | `template_id`, `curation_state_from`, `curator_user_id`, `publication_latency_days` |
| `template_library_entry_rejected` | Ops rejects | `template_id`, `contributor_org_id`, `rejection_reason_note_present=true` |
| `template_library_entry_deprecated` | Ops deprecates | `template_id`, `replacement_template_id` (nullable), `days_published` |
| `template_library_entry_cloned` | Clone fires | `source_template_id`, `cloning_org_id`, `cloning_user_id`, `template_kind` |
| `template_library_entry_featured_earned` | Usage threshold crossed (alias for existing `template.featured_placement_earned`) | `template_id`, `usage_count_30d`, `placement_kind` |
| `template_library_entry_featured_demoted` | Hysteresis demotion fires | `template_id`, `usage_count_30d_at_demotion` |

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Contributor-proposed templates MUST pass §48.4.4 content validators and §48.4.5 template-spam classifier before reaching `pending_ops_review`. QA test: `template_library_entry_anti_spam_gates`.
2. `canonical_slug` MUST be unique across the template library. QA test: `template_library_entry_slug_unique`.
3. Featured placement transition MUST be driven solely by `usage_count_30d` crossing `usage_count_threshold_for_featured`; manual promotion to `featured` without meeting the threshold MUST be blocked unless the actor is `ops_marketplace_supervisor` with an explicit override. QA test: `template_library_entry_featured_threshold_gated`.
4. Hysteresis MUST prevent featured-status flapping; a demoted template cannot re-enter `featured` for 7 days regardless of usage changes. QA test: `template_library_entry_featured_hysteresis`.
5. Deprecation MUST preserve clones' independent content (no live-link mutation). QA test: `template_library_entry_deprecation_preserves_clones`.
6. Public GET on a `draft_by_contributor` / `pending_ops_review` / `rejected_by_curator` template MUST return HTTP 404. QA test: `template_library_entry_public_read_gating`.

**Authoring intent.** M14 (§48.7.1) introduces BidSuccessShare as a seller-authored social-media share artifact for winning bids. NB-11 of the Phase 4 remediation promotes the entity from §48.7.1-inline to a §4.4 first-class field table at Master Spec fidelity.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | PK, immutable | Standard. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; → Organization (Seller) | Owning Seller Org. |
| `bid_workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; → BidWorkspace | Source workspace (MUST be at Phase 13 closed with `outcome_kind = awarded` at create time). |
| `buyer_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; → Organization (Buyer) | **NOT returned in seller-facing projections per §48.7.6 invariant #1.** Ops-only read surface. |
| `initiator_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; → User | Seller user who initiated the share. |
| `generated_post_text` | String | 50–500 chars; required | Platform-generated text per `bid_success_share_text_generation` capability. |
| `seller_edited_post_text` | String | 50–500 chars; nullable | Populated when seller edits generated text. |
| `seller_edit_count` | Integer | Default 0; max 5; required | Caps edit thrashing. |
| `anonymized_buyer_descriptor` | String | 10–120 chars; required | Anonymized descriptor (e.g., "a mid-market financial services firm") — NEVER the buyer name. |
| `anonymization_check_passed` | Boolean | Required; default FALSE | Set true on successful validator pass. |
| `anonymization_validator_version` | String | Semver; required | Validator version pinned for audit. |
| `third_party_vendor_opt_out_scan_passed` | Boolean | Required; default FALSE | Per NB-4 remediation; set true on NER scan pass against §4.4.8 Registry. |
| `third_party_vendor_opt_out_scan_latency_ms` | Integer | Nullable; ≤ 300 p95 | NER-scan observed latency. |
| `social_platform_targets` | Array[Enum] | Appendix J `bid_success_share_social_platform`; 0–4 entries | Targeted platforms (populated at publish). |
| `published_urls` | Array[String] | 0–4 entries; each ≤ 2,000 chars; Valid HTTPS URLs | Captured external URLs. |
| `share_status` | Enum | Appendix J `bid_success_share_status` (`draft`, `pending_anonymization_check`, `ready`, `published`, `expired`, `revoked_by_seller`, `revoked_by_ops`, `blocked_anonymization_fail`, `blocked_third_party_vendor_opt_out`); required | Lifecycle. |
| `revoked_reason_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `bid_success_share_revoked_reason`; nullable | Set on revoke transitions. |
| `signal_integrity_flags` | Array[String] | 0–10 entries; enum-bounded per §48.4.10 SIM classes | Populated by SIM sweep. |
| `published_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Publish timestamp. |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Required; default `created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'` | Auto-expiry. |
| `capability_invocation_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; → §4.8.3 AIOperation | Text-generation invocation with `cost_center=platform_marketing`. |
| `ops_revoke_reason_note` | String | 0–2,000 chars; nullable | Required when `revoked_reason_kind ∈ {ops_security_action, buyer_complaint, content_policy_violation}`. |
| `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `deleted_at` | Standard | Standard pattern | Soft delete forbidden for `share_status IN ('draft', 'pending_anonymization_check', 'ready', 'published')`. |

**Scope isolation.** Org-scoped (Seller Org). Seller-facing API responses MUST exclude `buyer_org_id` (enforced by §48.7.6 invariant #1 firewall). Buyer-side read access: NONE (buyer sees only the `buyer_win_share_opt_out` workspace setting toggle). Ops read access: full row including `buyer_org_id`.

**Required indexes.** `(bid_workspace_id, org_id)` UNIQUE per non-terminal `share_status` (enforces §48.7.1 AC #7); `(org_id, share_status, created_at DESC)` (seller-facing listing); `(expires_at) WHERE share_status = 'ready'` (sparse; nightly expiry sweep); `(buyer_org_id)` (Ops buyer-impact queries only).

**Retention.** 3 years post-terminal-status. DSAR pseudonymization applies to `initiator_user_id` per §6.8; `generated_post_text`, `seller_edited_post_text`, `anonymized_buyer_descriptor` preserved under §45.1.

**State machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | `POST /v1/bid-success-shares` | Bid workspace Phase 13, `outcome_kind=awarded`, plan eligible, buyer opt-out false |
| `draft` | `pending_anonymization_check` | Text generation AIOp completes | `capability_invocation_id` populated |
| `pending_anonymization_check` | `ready` | Validator + third-party opt-out scan both pass | Both Booleans set true |
| `pending_anonymization_check` | `blocked_anonymization_fail` | Validator fails | `fail_reason` captured in event |
| `pending_anonymization_check` | `blocked_third_party_vendor_opt_out` | NER scan matches opt-out registry | NB-4 control #6 fires |
| `ready` | `ready` (seller_edited) | `PATCH /v1/bid-success-shares/{id}` | Edits triggerre-validation; `seller_edit_count` increments |
| `ready` | `published` | `POST /v1/bid-success-shares/{id}/publish` | Re-checks buyer opt-out AND plan eligibility |
| `ready`, `published` | `revoked_by_seller` | `DELETE /v1/bid-success-shares/{id}` | Seller initiative |
| `ready`, `published` | `revoked_by_ops` | `POST /v1/ops/bid-success-shares/{id}/revoke` | Ops action |
| `ready` | `expired` | Nightly sweep | `expires_at <= now()` |
| terminal statuses | (terminal) | n/a | Append-only |

**Invariants, API endpoints, webhooks, notifications, and acceptance criteria** are fully authored at §48.7.1; this §4.4.29 entry is the canonical field-table record.

### 4.4.30 KBExportJob (Org-Scoped, Seller KB Export) {#4.4.30-kbexportjob}

**Authoring intent.** KBExportJob is the canonical async job entity for the §22.18.2 / §32.9 Honest Portability export endpoint. §22.18.2 remains authoritative for product behavior and archive semantics; this section is the canonical field-table home.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable; externally referenced as `export_id` in §32.9 endpoint I/O. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → Organization | Seller Org scope. Cross-Org reads return HTTP 404 `kb_export_job_not_found`. |
| `console` | Enum | Always `seller` | Buyer-console writes return HTTP 422 `kb_export_console_forbidden`. |
| `namespace_filter` | Enum | Appendix J `kb_export_namespace_filter`; default `all` | Values: `all`, `org_only`, `software_only`, `per_namespace_id`. `per_namespace_id` requires `namespace_ids[]`. |
| `namespace_ids` | Array[UUID] | ≤ 50; FK → KBNamespace (§22.3.4) | Every namespace MUST belong to `org_id`; otherwise HTTP 422 `kb_export_namespace_cross_org`. |
| `include_archived` | Boolean | Default false | Includes archived KBEntry rows when true. |
| `include_drafts` | Boolean | Default false | Includes `draft` / `under_review` KBEntry rows when true. |
| `format` | Enum | Appendix J `kb_export_format_kind_enum`; default `markdown_and_jsonl_zip_v1` | Export artifact format per §22.18.2.2 / §32.9. |
| `status` | Enum | Appendix J `kb_export_job_status`; required | Values: `queued`, `running`, `ready`, `expired`, `failed`; state machine at §22.18.2.5. |
| `requested_by` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → User | Seller user who initiated the export; MUST belong to `org_id`. |
| `requested_at` | Timestamp | Required | Server clock at API receipt. |
| `started_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Populated on `queued → running`. |
| `completed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Populated on `running → ready` or `running → failed`. |
| `ready_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Alias of `completed_at` when terminal state is `ready`. |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on `ready`; `ready_at + 72h`; expiry revokes the presigned URL. |
| `archive_size_bytes` | Integer | Nullable; ≥ 0 | Populated on `ready`. |
| `archive_entry_count` | Integer | Nullable; ≥ 0 | Count of exported KBEntry rows. |
| `archive_document_count` | Integer | Nullable; ≥ 0 | Count of exported KBDocument rows. |
| `archive_attachment_bytes` | Integer | Nullable; ≥ 0 | Bytes under `/attachments/` inside the archive. |
| `archive_sha256` | String | 64-char hex; nullable | SHA-256 of archive artifact; rendered for integrity verification. |
| `download_url` | String | Nullable | Presigned URL; 15-minute TTL, IP-bound, re-mintable per §32.9.2. |
| `residency_region` | Enum | Appendix J `data_residency_region`; required | Snapshot of seller Org residency at `requested_at`; archive storage MUST stay in the same region unless §40.4 evacuation rewrites atomically. |
| `failure_code` | Enum | Appendix J `kb_export_failure_code_enum`; nullable | Populated on `running → failed`. |
| `failure_detail` | String | ≤ 2048 chars; nullable | Seller-visible failure context; MUST NOT include raw KB body text. |
| `dsar_hold_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Stamped when an in-flight export pauses for §6.8 erasure processing. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required; alias of `requested_at` | Standard timestamp. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last write time. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → User | Alias of `requested_by`. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User or Appendix J `system_agent_id_enum` | Worker writes use `system_agent_kb_exporter`. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker; archive object deletion follows §22.18.2.6 DSAR rules. |

**Scope isolation.** Org-scoped, Seller-console-scoped. Every read/write MUST filter by `org_id` and `console='seller'`; cross-Org reads return HTTP 404; buyer-console export attempts return HTTP 422.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, created_at DESC)` for job-list rendering; `(org_id, status)` for in-progress rate-limit enforcement; `(status, expires_at)` for the expiry sweeper; `(dsar_hold_at)` partial WHERE `dsar_hold_at IS NOT NULL` for DSAR-paused job processing.

**Retention.** Failed / expired jobs retain for 90 days. Ready jobs retain for 13 months when referenced by a contest, DSAR, or support investigation; otherwise they follow §40.2 `kb_export_job` retention. The archive object inherits the KB corpus erasure fate per §22.18.2.6.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. A buyer-console session MUST NOT create or read a KBExportJob; API behavior returns the non-leaking status defined in §32.9.
2. `namespace_ids[]` MUST be validated against `org_id` before any export worker starts; cross-Org IDs cannot be logged in seller-visible failure text.
3. A `ready` job MUST have `archive_sha256`, `archive_size_bytes`, `ready_at`, and `expires_at` populated atomically with the terminal transition.
4. DSAR erasure in progress MUST stamp `dsar_hold_at` on every queued / running KBExportJob for the affected seller Org before KB body deletion begins.

### 4.4.31 KBCitationGraphEdge (Org-Scoped, Seller KB Value Graph) {#4.4.31-kbcitationgraphedge}

**Authoring intent.** KBCitationGraphEdge materializes the live citation graph used by §22.18.3.4, §22.18.4, §22.18.6.2, and §34.19 carry-over preservation. Export may snapshot the graph, but live graph updates occur only inside Sourcera.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable citation-edge id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → Organization | Seller Org owning the KB corpus and Bid Workspace. |
| `console` | Enum | Always `seller` | Never surfaced to buyer-console sessions. |
| `from_kb_entry_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → KBEntry (§22.3.1) | Cited entry providing evidence. |
| `to_bid_workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → BidWorkspace (§4.4.1) | Seller Bid Workspace where the citation landed. |
| `response_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → BidResponse (§4.4.2) or Response (§4.3.5) by bridge context | Populated when the citation is attached to a specific persisted answer. |
| `response_id_fallback` | UUID (FK) | Nullable | Used for pre-bid seed citations where the final response row is not yet materialized. |
| `citation_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `kb_citation_graph_edge_kind`; required | Values: `response_grounding`, `evidence_attribution`, `capability_extraction`. |
| `bid_outcome` | Enum | Appendix J `kb_citation_graph_bid_outcome`; required | Values: `open`, `won`, `lost`, `no_decision`, `cancelled`; snapshot updated at bid close. |
| `edge_weight` | Decimal(3,2) | 0.00–1.00; required | Default weights: response grounding 1.00, evidence attribution 0.80, capability extraction 0.60. |
| `last_outcome_synced_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last time bid-outcome updates propagated to the edge. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Citation event time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last write time. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | User, managed-agent, or system identity | Usually the AIOperation actor that created the citation. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User, managed-agent, or system identity | Outcome sync worker on bid close; system actor allowed. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete mirrors endpoint deletion; disqualification preserves rows per §22.18.6.5. |

**Scope isolation.** Org-scoped, Seller-console-scoped. Buyer-console and cross-Org reads return HTTP 404. Seller-facing projections may aggregate counts; raw buyer identifiers are not returned.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, from_kb_entry_id)`, `(org_id, to_bid_workspace_id)`, `(org_id, bid_outcome, updated_at)`, `(org_id, citation_kind, created_at DESC)`.

**Retention.** Mirrors the longer-lived endpoint among KBEntry and BidWorkspace unless §6.8 requires redaction. If both endpoints are hard-deleted, the edge is hard-deleted. Buyer disqualification does not delete edges; it suppresses win-rate updates per §22.18.6.5.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Citation graph writes MUST be atomic with the persisted response / draft citation that caused the edge.
2. A bid close MUST update `bid_outcome` and `last_outcome_synced_at` for every edge in that Bid Workspace before `win_rate_weight` recomputation reads the graph.
3. Cross-console reads of raw edges MUST return HTTP 404 even when buyer and seller belong to the same dual-console Org.

### 4.4.32 CapabilityDeclarationSuggestion (Org-Scoped, Seller KB-to-Capability Queue) {#4.4.32-capabilitydeclarationsuggestion}

**Authoring intent.** CapabilityDeclarationSuggestion is the review queue emitted by the §22.18.3.5 KB-to-Capability clustering pipeline before a seller publishes a §4.4.4 CapabilityDeclaration. It is a suggestion, not a published marketplace claim.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable suggestion id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK → Organization | Seller Org scope. |
| `console` | Enum | Always `seller` | Seller-only surface. |
| `canonical_capability_id` | String | Required; FK → CapabilityRegistryEntry.`capability_id` (§4.8.2) | Proposed canonical capability to claim. |
| `proposed_display_label` | String | 1–80 chars | Human-readable label shown in the seller review queue. |
| `evidence_kb_entry_ids` | Array[UUID] | 1–50; FK → KBEntry | Source evidence cluster; at least three entries required before promotion to CapabilityDeclaration unless Ops override is present. |
| `cluster_centroid_signature` | String | 64-char sha256 hex | Hash of the deterministic clustering vector / tag-set snapshot; used for idempotency and recompute de-dupe. |
| `confidence_score` | Decimal(4,3) | 0.000–1.000; required | Pipeline confidence for the suggestion, distinct from KBEntry confidence. |
| `suggestion_state` | Enum | Appendix J `capability_declaration_suggestion_state`; default `pending_review` | Values: `pending_review`, `published`, `dismissed`, `superseded`, `expired`. |
| `published_capability_declaration_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → CapabilityDeclaration (§4.4.4) | Set when the seller publishes the suggestion. |
| `dismissed_reason` | Enum | Appendix J `capability_declaration_suggestion_dismissed_reason`; nullable | Required when `suggestion_state='dismissed'`. |
| `source_pipeline_version` | String | Semver; required | Version of the clustering pipeline that emitted the row. |
| `last_recomputed_at` | Timestamp | Required | Input snapshot timestamp. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Row creation time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last write time. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | System or managed-agent identity | Usually `system_agent_classification_pipeline` or the `kb_to_capability_suggestion` AIOperation actor. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User, system, or managed-agent identity | Seller user on publish / dismiss; system on recompute. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker; terminal rows are retained for upgrade carry-over proof. |

**Scope isolation.** Org-scoped, Seller-console-scoped. Buyer-console reads return HTTP 404. Marketplace-domain pages never read suggestions directly; only published CapabilityDeclaration rows can affect public discovery.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, suggestion_state, confidence_score DESC)`, `(org_id, canonical_capability_id, suggestion_state)`, `(org_id, cluster_centroid_signature)` UNIQUE for non-terminal rows, `(published_capability_declaration_id)` partial WHERE non-null.

**Retention.** Pending suggestions live until published, dismissed, superseded, expired, or deleted with the Org. Published / dismissed / superseded rows retain for the plan-upgrade carry-over window and DSAR audit horizon per §34.19 / §40.2; user attribution pseudonymizes under §6.8.

**State machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (none) | `pending_review` | Clustering pipeline emits suggestion | `evidence_kb_entry_ids` non-empty and `canonical_capability_id` active | Initial state. |
| `pending_review` | `published` | Seller publishes | Creates §4.4.4 CapabilityDeclaration and stamps `published_capability_declaration_id` | Atomic with CapabilityDeclaration write. |
| `pending_review` | `dismissed` | Seller dismisses | `dismissed_reason` required | Future recompute may emit a new row only if `cluster_centroid_signature` changes. |
| `pending_review` | `superseded` | Pipeline emits stronger duplicate | New row references same canonical capability and higher confidence | Keeps audit trail. |
| `pending_review` | `expired` | Nightly sweep | Underlying evidence cluster no longer exists or confidence below threshold | No seller action required. |
| terminal | terminal | n/a | No reopen; a new row is emitted on recompute | Prevents silent resurrection. |

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Publishing a suggestion MUST create exactly one CapabilityDeclaration and set `published_capability_declaration_id` in the same transaction.
2. A dismissed suggestion MUST NOT reappear unless its `cluster_centroid_signature` changes.
3. Upgrade / downgrade transitions MUST preserve non-deleted suggestions byte-for-byte per §22.18.7 AC #74 and §34.19.

### 4.4.33 SellerInboxItem (Org-Scoped, Seller) {#4.4.33-sellerinboxitem}

**Authoring intent.** SellerInboxItem is the first-class item row behind §24.3 Seller Inbox. It materializes seller-facing action items and updates generated from Bid Workspace, Q&A, NDA, KB health, document-expiry, and phase-transition events. Buyer-console users never read this row; buyer-originating changes cross only through Console Bridge projections or notification events.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable item id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> Organization | Seller Org that owns the inbox item. |
| `console` | Enum | Always `seller` | Seller-console scope; buyer-console reads return HTTP 404. |
| `bid_workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK -> Bid Workspace (§4.4.1) | Required for Bid Workspace-scoped items; null only for Org-level KB or document-library items. |
| `seller_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK -> User | Targeted recipient when user-specific; null for Org-wide seller-admin items. |
| `seller_team_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK -> Team (§4.2.4) | Targeted team when the item is assigned to a seller team. |
| `item_group_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK -> SellerInboxItemGroup (§4.4.34) | Group row used for feed compaction. |
| `item_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_inbox_item_kind` | Values cover the §24.3 canonical item families. |
| `priority` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_inbox_priority` | Sort band: action-required items rank above updates, which rank above info. |
| `item_state` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_inbox_item_state`; default `pending` | Lifecycle: `pending`, `read`, `dismissed`, `expired`. |
| `source_event_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK -> ConsoleBridgeEvent, AuditEvent, or notification event id | Source event that produced the item. Polymorphic FK is resolved at application layer. |
| `source_entity_type` | Enum | Appendix J `audit_event_entity_type` compatible string | Source entity such as `bid_workspace`, `qa_thread`, `nda_record`, `kb_entry`, `document`, or `console_bridge_event`. |
| `source_entity_id` | UUID | Nullable | Source entity id for drilldown and audit correlation. |
| `action_url` | String | Internal route; nullable | Seller-console route opened by the item. Must not contain buyer-console-only identifiers. |
| `title` | String | 1-160 chars | Template-generated title; no free-form buyer-internal notes. |
| `body_markdown` | String | 0-2000 chars | Seller-visible body copy only; PII/body-field sweep applies per §6.8.4.5. |
| `read_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when the target user opens the item or uses mark-as-read. |
| `dismissed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set when the user dismisses the item. |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Optional expiry used for deadline-bound items. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Row creation time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last mutation time. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor or User | Usually `system_agent_webhook_dispatcher` or Console Bridge worker. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User or system actor | Last actor to read, dismiss, expire, or restore. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker. |

**Scope isolation.** Seller Org-scoped and seller-console-scoped. Reads require `(org_id, console='seller')` plus either the target `seller_user_id`, membership in `seller_team_id`, or a seller role authorized for Org-wide inbox items. Buyer-console reads, cross-seller reads, and cross-Bid-Workspace reads return HTTP 404 under the non-leak firewall rule.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, seller_user_id, item_state, priority, created_at DESC)`, `(org_id, bid_workspace_id, created_at DESC)`, `(item_group_id, created_at DESC)`, `(source_event_id)` unique where non-null, `(expires_at)` partial where `item_state='pending'`, `(deleted_at)`.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows the Inbox Item Group retention class in §4.3.22 / §40.2; dismissed or expired items are swept by the grouped-inbox TTL policy unless linked to audit-retained source events. DSAR Pattern A applies to `seller_user_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, and any subject-identifying text in `body_markdown`; source identifiers needed for audit integrity are retained under §6.8.5. Residency follows parent Bid Workspace residency when `bid_workspace_id` is present and Seller Org residency otherwise.

**State machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (none) | `pending` | Source event materializes item | Source event id is idempotency key when present | Initial state. |
| `pending` | `read` | User opens item or marks read | User is authorized recipient | Sets `read_at`; item remains visible in read filter. |
| `pending` or `read` | `dismissed` | User dismisses item | Item kind permits dismissal | Sets `dismissed_at`; reversible only through restore API once authored. |
| `pending` | `expired` | Expiry sweeper | `expires_at <= now()` | Deadline-bound item no longer actionable. |
| `dismissed` or `expired` | terminal | TTL / retention sweep | Retention rule satisfied | Sets `deleted_at` or hard-deletes per retention class. |

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Creating a SellerInboxItem MUST be idempotent on `source_event_id` when that field is present.
2. Seller Inbox reads MUST filter by `(org_id, console='seller')` before resolving `source_entity_id`.
3. A private Q&A or NDA item MUST NOT expose buyer-internal notes, internal comments, buyer scoring notes, or Target Account notes in `title`, `body_markdown`, or `action_url`.
4. A dismissed item MUST keep its source-event correlation until retention sweep.
5. DSAR pseudonymization MUST preserve source-event audit integrity while redacting subject-identifying body text.

### 4.4.34 SellerInboxItemGroup (Org-Scoped, Seller) {#4.4.34-sellerinboxitemgroup}

**Authoring intent.** SellerInboxItemGroup compacts related SellerInboxItem rows into one feed row, mirroring the buyer-side grouping purpose of §4.3.22 while keeping seller scope and Bid Workspace residency explicit.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable group id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> Organization | Seller Org scope. |
| `console` | Enum | Always `seller` | Seller-console scope. |
| `bid_workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK -> Bid Workspace (§4.4.1) | Populated for Bid Workspace-local groups. |
| `anchor_entity_type` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_inbox_anchor_entity_type` | Polymorphic grouping anchor. |
| `anchor_entity_id` | UUID | Nullable | Anchor id resolved at application layer. |
| `group_type` | Enum | Appendix J `inbox_item_group_type_enum` | Reuses the canonical grouping strategy enum from §4.3.22. |
| `priority` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_inbox_priority` | Highest-priority child item currently in group. |
| `item_count` | Integer | >= 0 | Number of non-deleted child SellerInboxItem rows. |
| `unread_count` | Integer | >= 0 | Child rows without `read_at`. |
| `latest_item_at` | Timestamp | Required | Most recent child item creation time. |
| `title` | String | 1-160 chars | Template-generated group label. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Row creation time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last grouping update. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor | Grouping worker or source-event worker. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor | Last grouping worker. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker. |

**Scope isolation.** Same as SellerInboxItem: seller Org + seller console. Group reads never bypass child-row authorization; a group with zero readable children is suppressed and returns no count.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, latest_item_at DESC)`, `(org_id, bid_workspace_id, latest_item_at DESC)`, `(org_id, anchor_entity_type, anchor_entity_id, group_type)` unique where `anchor_entity_id` is non-null, `(deleted_at)`.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows the SellerInboxItem child set and the §4.3.22 grouped-inbox retention pattern. DSAR redacts `title` only when it contains subject-identifying text. Residency follows the group's Bid Workspace when present and Seller Org residency otherwise.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. A second child item with the same `(org_id, anchor_entity_type, anchor_entity_id, group_type)` MUST upsert the existing group and increment `item_count` / `unread_count` transactionally.
2. `priority` MUST equal the highest-priority non-deleted child item.
3. A group MUST suppress from the feed when all child items are hidden by permission checks.
4. Group counters MUST update in the same transaction as child `read_at`, `dismissed_at`, `expired`, or `deleted_at` writes.

### 4.4.35 SavedSearch (Org-Scoped, Buyer/Seller) {#4.4.35-savedsearch}

**Authoring intent.** SavedSearch is the canonical persistence row for saved marketplace, vendor-discovery, and seller-signal search definitions. It backs §34.19.1 Class 7 ("Saved searches and alerts") so plan transitions can preserve the seller's search work without relying on implicit UI state. The entity is intentionally console-aware: Seller Console saved searches are protected seller assets; Buyer Console saved searches use the same schema but are not part of the seller-plan carry-over guarantee.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable saved-search id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> Organization | Owning Org. |
| `console` | Enum | Appendix J `saved_search_console` | `seller` rows are Seller Org assets; `buyer` rows stay buyer-console scoped. |
| `owner_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> User | User who owns the saved search. |
| `team_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable | Team-visible saved searches populate this when sharing is enabled. |
| `visibility` | Enum | Appendix J `saved_search_visibility` | `private` or `team`; cross-Org sharing is forbidden. |
| `surface_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `saved_search_surface_kind` | Surface family that owns the query grammar. |
| `name` | String | 1-120 chars | User-facing saved-search label. |
| `query_text` | String | Nullable; max 512 chars | Raw search string when the surface supports keyword search. |
| `query_json` | JSON | Required; schema versioned by `query_schema_version` | Structured query payload; must not contain raw buyer-side objects on seller rows. |
| `filters_json` | JSON | Required; default `{}` | Structured filter payload. |
| `sort_json` | JSON | Nullable | Surface-owned sort preference. |
| `result_count_last_seen` | Integer | \>= 0 | Last evaluated result count, used only for UI deltas. |
| `last_run_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last evaluation time. |
| `query_schema_version` | Integer | Required; \>= 1 | Enables non-breaking query migrations. |
| `data_residency_region` | Enum | Appendix J `data_residency_region` | Derived from the owning Org at create; rows store in-region. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Row creation time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last user/system update. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> User | Creator. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> User or System | Last updater. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker. |

**Scope isolation.** Reads and writes are scoped by `(org_id, console)`. Buyer-console principals cannot read seller-console saved searches; seller-console principals cannot read buyer-console saved searches. Team-visible rows are still Org-local and must pass RBAC for the owning console. Seller rows that originate from public Marketplace search may store public Marketplace criteria, but they must not persist buyer workspace identifiers, buyer user identifiers, or non-public buyer intent.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, console, owner_user_id, updated_at DESC)`, `(org_id, console, team_id, updated_at DESC)` where `team_id IS NOT NULL`, `(org_id, console, surface_kind, deleted_at)`, `(org_id, console, data_residency_region)`, `(deleted_at)`.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows §40.2 account-configuration retention for active and soft-deleted saved-search preferences. Seller-console rows are Class 7 protected assets under §34.19.1.A and therefore preserve across upgrades and downgrade read-only windows. DSAR erases `query_text` and any subject-identifying query/filter values when the requesting user is the subject; aggregate filter keys remain only when they no longer identify the subject. Residency follows `data_residency_region`; residency moves rewrite the row in the destination partition before old-region deletion.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Creating a SavedSearch MUST persist `query_json`, `filters_json`, `surface_kind`, `console`, and `data_residency_region` in one transaction.
2. Seller-console SavedSearch rows MUST be preserved byte-for-byte across every §34.19 plan upgrade and restored atomically after a re-upgrade from a read-only downgrade bucket.
3. A Buyer Console principal attempting to read a seller SavedSearch, or a Seller Console principal attempting to read a buyer SavedSearch, MUST receive the §7.2 non-leak 404 response.
4. Query-schema migrations MUST increment `query_schema_version` and retain the prior version until all active SearchAlert rows have re-evaluated successfully.
5. Soft deletion of a SavedSearch MUST pause or soft-delete dependent SearchAlert rows in the same transaction.

### 4.4.36 SearchAlert (Org-Scoped, Buyer/Seller) {#4.4.36-searchalert}

**Authoring intent.** SearchAlert is the scheduled notification contract attached to a SavedSearch. It makes "alerts" in §34.19.1 Class 7 buildable by separating query persistence from delivery cadence, channel, and alert state.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable alert id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> Organization | Owning Org; must match SavedSearch. |
| `console` | Enum | Appendix J `saved_search_console` | Must match the parent SavedSearch console. |
| `saved_search_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> SavedSearch (§4.4.35) | Parent search definition. |
| `owner_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> User | Alert recipient / owner. |
| `team_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable | Populated for team-owned alerts. |
| `alert_state` | Enum | Appendix J `search_alert_state` | Delivery lifecycle. |
| `frequency` | Enum | Appendix J `search_alert_frequency` | Evaluation cadence. |
| `channel` | Enum | Appendix J `search_alert_channel` | Delivery channel preference. |
| `last_evaluated_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last scheduler evaluation. |
| `last_delivered_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last successful notification delivery. |
| `next_evaluation_at` | Timestamp | Nullable unless `alert_state=active` | Scheduler cursor. |
| `last_result_fingerprint` | String | Nullable; max 128 chars | Stable hash used to suppress duplicate sends. |
| `silenced_until` | Timestamp | Nullable | User-requested quiet period. |
| `failure_code` | String | Nullable; max 128 chars | Last delivery or evaluation failure reason. |
| `data_residency_region` | Enum | Appendix J `data_residency_region` | Inherited from SavedSearch. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Row creation time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last update time. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> User | Creator. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> User or System | Last updater. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker. |

**Scope isolation.** SearchAlert authorization is the intersection of the parent SavedSearch scope and the recipient's current console RBAC. Delivery workers must re-check `(org_id, console, saved_search_id)` before evaluating the query or emitting a notification. A seller alert never includes buyer workspace identifiers unless those identifiers are already seller-visible through a Console Bridge projection.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, console, saved_search_id)`, `(org_id, console, owner_user_id, alert_state)`, `(alert_state, next_evaluation_at)`, `(org_id, console, data_residency_region)`, `(deleted_at)`.

**State machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (none) | `active` | Alert created | Parent SavedSearch active; frequency and channel valid | `next_evaluation_at` set. |
| `active` | `paused` | User pauses or parent SavedSearch soft-deleted | — | Scheduler stops evaluation. |
| `paused` | `active` | User resumes | Parent SavedSearch not deleted | `next_evaluation_at` recomputed. |
| `active` | `delivery_suppressed` | Duplicate fingerprint or quiet period | `last_result_fingerprint` unchanged OR `silenced_until > now` | No notification emitted. |
| `delivery_suppressed` | `active` | Next eligible evaluation window | New fingerprint OR quiet period elapsed | Scheduler resumes. |
| `active` | `errored` | Repeated evaluation/delivery failure | Three consecutive failures | `failure_code` populated; owner notified in-app. |
| `errored` | `active` | Successful manual retry or scheduler recovery | Parent SavedSearch valid | Failure fields retained for audit. |
| Any non-deleted | `deleted` | User deletes or parent deletion cascades | Soft delete only | `deleted_at` populated; terminal for delivery. |

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows the parent SavedSearch. Seller-console SearchAlert rows are Class 7 protected assets under §34.19.1.A. DSAR redacts alert recipient references by pseudonymizing the User row per §6.8.4 / §6.8.5 while preserving delivery-audit timestamps and fingerprints. Residency must equal the parent SavedSearch residency; cross-region scheduler workers are forbidden.

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. SearchAlert creation MUST fail if the parent SavedSearch has a different `org_id`, `console`, or `data_residency_region`.
2. Scheduler evaluation MUST load the parent SavedSearch and re-run console/RBAC authorization before executing the query.
3. Seller-console SearchAlert rows MUST be preserved byte-for-byte across every §34.19 plan upgrade and restored atomically after a re-upgrade from a read-only downgrade bucket.
4. Duplicate-result suppression MUST compare `last_result_fingerprint` before delivery and MUST NOT emit email or in-app notifications when unchanged.
5. A parent SavedSearch soft delete MUST transition all non-deleted child SearchAlert rows to `deleted` or `paused` in the same transaction.

### 4.4.37 SellerBidWorkspacePulseHealth (Bid-Workspace-Scoped, Seller) {#4.4.37-sellerbidworkspacepulsehealth}

**Authoring intent.** SellerBidWorkspacePulseHealth is the persisted seller-side health row behind §24.4 Seller Pulse. It records the score, term values, cadence, and final-lock state for a Seller Org's Bid Workspace without exposing buyer-internal Workspace details. It is the seller-console counterpart to WorkspacePulseHealth (§4.3.22.2), but its denominator set is seller-owned work: Bid Responses, seller deadlines, amendment re-verification, and KB utilization.

**Authored Extension -- requires human sign-off.** This entity and its Appendix J / Appendix M bindings were authored in the v7.2.0-REM Phase 5.5 Seller Pulse P1 pass to close D-5.5-016 / D-5.5-017 and the overlapping D-24-010 / D-24-011 / D-24-012 / D-24-014 cluster. Registry row: AE-V72REM-PH5P55-SELLER-PULSE-01.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Stable snapshot id. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> Organization | Seller Org that owns the Bid Workspace. |
| `console` | Enum | Always `seller` | Seller-console scope; buyer-console reads return HTTP 404. |
| `bid_workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | Required; FK -> Bid Workspace (§4.4.1) | Seller bid context. |
| `source_workspace_id_hash` | String | SHA-256; required | One-way correlation hash for the bound buyer Workspace; raw buyer `workspace_id` is not returned to seller clients. |
| `recorded_at` | Timestamp | Required; UTC | Compute timestamp for tick / daily / final snapshots. |
| `recorded_date_utc` | Date | Required | UTC date bucket for daily summary uniqueness. |
| `snapshot_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_pulse_snapshot_kind`; required | `tick`, `daily_summary`, or `final_lock`. |
| `weight_set` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_pulse_weight_set`; required | Phase-derived weight set selected by §24.4.2. |
| `pipeline_phase` | Enum | Appendix J `pipeline_phase`; required | Bound buyer Workspace phase projected through Console Bridge. |
| `bid_workspace_status` | Enum | Appendix E Bid Workspace status | Seller-side bid state at compute time. |
| `score_value` | Decimal | 0-100; required | Final bounded Seller Pulse Health Score. |
| `color_band` | Enum | Appendix J `pulse_health_color_band`; required | `green`, `yellow`, or `red`; shared semantic band with §20.3.3. |
| `prior_color_band` | Enum | Appendix J `pulse_health_color_band`; nullable | Previous persisted band for transition detection. |
| `response_completion_pct` | Decimal | Nullable; 0-100 | Submitted Bid Responses divided by materialized response items. |
| `on_time_submission_pct` | Decimal | Nullable; 0-100 | Submitted responses that met seller-side deadline divided by submitted responses. |
| `amendment_reverification_turnaround_pct` | Decimal | Nullable; 0-100 | Re-verification-required amendments cleared within the applicable §44.1 / §25.5 service target divided by required amendments. |
| `kb_utilization_pct` | Decimal | Nullable; 0-100 | Submitted responses that include at least one verified KB citation divided by submitted responses. |
| `deadline_readiness_pct` | Decimal | Nullable; 0-100 | Non-overdue seller-owned deadlines divided by seller-owned deadlines for the active Bid Workspace phase. |
| `raw_inputs_json` | JSONB | Required; redacted aggregate counts only | Counts used to compute the terms. MUST NOT store buyer-internal notes, buyer scores, response body text, Q&A post bodies, requirement text, comments, email addresses, or attachment contents. |
| `band_transition_event_id` | UUID | Nullable | Event id emitted when `color_band` moves into yellow or red after the corresponding event family is registered. |
| `locked` | Boolean | Default `false` | True once `snapshot_kind=final_lock` or terminal Bid Workspace state freezes the score. |
| `locked_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Required when `locked=true`. |
| `lock_reason` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_pulse_lock_reason`; nullable | Terminal reason for the lock. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Required | Row creation time. |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Required | Last write time. |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor | Usually Seller Pulse compute scheduler. |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | System actor | Last compute / lock worker. |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete marker. |

**Scope isolation.** Reads require `(org_id, console='seller', bid_workspace_id)` and a seller role authorized on the Bid Workspace. Buyer-console reads, cross-seller reads, and raw buyer Workspace lookups return HTTP 404 under the §7.2 non-leak rule. The row never stores buyer-internal comments, buyer scoring notes, buyer-only Target Account notes, or competitor seller names.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, bid_workspace_id, recorded_at DESC)`, `(org_id, bid_workspace_id, snapshot_kind, recorded_date_utc)` unique for `snapshot_kind='daily_summary'`, `(org_id, bid_workspace_id, locked)`, `(color_band, recorded_at DESC)` partial where `color_band IN ('yellow','red')`, `(deleted_at)`.

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Retention follows the §40.2 SellerBidWorkspacePulseHealth row. DSAR pseudonymizes actor FKs; raw aggregate counts remain only when they contain no subject-identifying text. `raw_inputs_json` is aggregate-only and must pass the §6.8.4.5 body-field sweep before export. Residency follows the parent Bid Workspace (§4.4.1), which follows Seller Org residency; the buyer-side source Workspace remains in buyer residency and is represented only by `source_workspace_id_hash`.

**State machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (none) | `tick` | Bid Workspace tick | Bid Workspace active and at least one non-null term exists | Initial compute after any material seller-side event. |
| `tick` | `daily_summary` | Daily summarizer | Latest tick exists for `recorded_date_utc` | Upserts one daily row per UTC date. |
| `tick` or `daily_summary` | `final_lock` | Bid Workspace terminal state | `bid_workspace_status IN {won, lost, submitted_and_not_awarded, withdrawn, disqualified}` OR bound Workspace enters Phase 13 closure | Freezes latest score; `locked=true`. |
| `tick` | `tick` | Response, amendment, deadline, KB-citation, or phase projection event | Not locked | Recomputes current tick row; preserves prior color for transition detection. |
| `final_lock` | terminal | Retention sweep | Retention rule satisfied | No mutable recompute after final lock. |

**Acceptance criteria.**

1. Every Bid Workspace tick that changes a response, amendment, seller deadline, KB citation, or projected phase MUST recompute SellerBidWorkspacePulseHealth unless the latest row is locked.
2. `score_value` MUST remain in the inclusive 0-100 range; null terms MUST be excluded with weight renormalization, and all-null inputs MUST write `score_value=0` / `color_band=red` with `raw_inputs_json.empty_reason`.
3. Final-lock rows MUST be immutable except for retention / DSAR redaction metadata.
4. Buyer-console reads MUST return HTTP 404 for every SellerBidWorkspacePulseHealth endpoint, including Ops-support impersonation paths unless the impersonation session is seller-console-scoped.
5. `raw_inputs_json` MUST contain counts only and MUST fail validation if body text, comments, Q&A post bodies, requirement text, email addresses, or attachment contents are present.

## 4.5 Marketplace Entities {#4.5-marketplace-entities}

### 4.5.1 Marketplace Listing (Marketplace Domain, Public) {#4.5.1-marketplace-listing}

**Authoring Intent.** Marketplace Listing is the seller-authored public Marketplace row for a sellable product or service. It is the canonical listing object rendered by §27 Marketplace Listings, selected by EvalStarter longlists (§4.5.9), referenced by EOIs (§4.5.2), and moderated by Marketplace Abuse Report (§4.5.7) and Ops Marketplace Listing Moderation (§50.25). The entity is seller-owned but marketplace-visible; all buyer reads use the public projection and never gain Seller Org private fields.

**Scope:** Marketplace-domain, seller-owned. `org_id`, `seller_profile_id`, and `console='seller'` scope writes to the Seller Console. Public reads expose only the public listing projection when `status=published`. Buyer-console and anonymous reads MUST NOT expose draft, archived, hidden, flagged, or removed rows except as the documented 410/redirect state. Ops moderation reads all fields.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Seller's organization |
| `console` | Enum | Fixed `seller`; Appendix J `marketplace_entity_console` | Firewall discriminator for seller-owned marketplace rows |
| `seller_profile_id` | UUID | FK → Seller Profile | Link to Seller Profile |
| `title` | String | 1–200 chars | Product/service name |
| `slug` | String | 3–100 chars, lowercase, unique | URL-safe identifier; immutable after first publish except through 301 alias migration |
| `tagline` | String | 0–200 chars | Short pitch |
| `description` | String | 0–5000 chars | Full product description; body-field PII sweep per §6.8.4.5 |
| `category_taxonomy_node_id` | UUID (FK) | FK → Taxonomy Node (§4.5.4) where `kind=marketplace_category` and `state IN {active, deprecated}` | Canonical category binding. Replaces the legacy inline `category` enum. If node is `deprecated`, write must also populate successor display data for redirect |
| `sub_category` | String | Max 100 chars | Optional display sub-category; MUST resolve to an approved Controlled-Vocabulary Tag (§4.5.5) before publish |
| `logo_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL | Product logo; stored in residency-matching object storage |
| `hero_image_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL | Hero/banner image; stored in residency-matching object storage |
| `pricing_model` | Enum | Appendix J `seller_software_pricing_model` | Pricing type |
| `pricing_description` | String | 0–1000 chars | Pricing details |
| `min_price_cents_monthly` | BigInt | Nullable; >= 0 | Minimum monthly price in integer cents; null if custom/TBD |
| `max_price_cents_monthly` | BigInt | Nullable; >= `min_price_cents_monthly` when both non-null | Maximum monthly price in integer cents |
| `currency_code` | Enum | Appendix J `billing_currency`; default `usd` | Currency for the listed price range. Customer billing remains governed by §34 / §4.8 |
| `status` | Enum | Appendix J `marketplace_listing_status` | Listing lifecycle; see State Machine below |
| `published_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When listing first entered `published` |
| `feature_highlights` | Array[String] | Max 10 items | Top 3–5 features |
| `integrations` | Array[String] | Integration names | e.g., `["Salesforce", "SAP", "Oracle"]` |

| `languages_supported` | Array[String] | ISO 639-1 codes | e.g., `["en", "es", "fr"]` |
| `video_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL | Demo/overview video (optional); stored in residency-matching object storage |
| `documentation_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL | Help/documentation link; stored in residency-matching object storage |
| `data_residency_region` | Enum | Appendix J `data_residency_region`: `us`, `eu`, `apac`, `custom` | **D-1.4-001 remediation, 2026-05-01.** Required at create. Inherited from the seller Org's `data_residency_region` at row write time. Governs storage partitioning of the listing payload, the `logo_url`, `hero_image_url`, `video_url`, and `documentation_url` referenced binaries. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | Seller User ID | Creator; Pattern B DSAR treatment per §6.8.4.1 |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User ID | **D-1.4-013 remediation, 2026-05-01.** Last editor per §4.1 Principle #2 audit-trail; Pattern B DSAR treatment |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete |

**Indexes.** `(org_id, status, updated_at DESC)` for Seller Console listing management; `(slug)` unique partial where `deleted_at IS NULL`; `(category_taxonomy_node_id, status, published_at DESC)` for Marketplace browse; `(seller_profile_id, status)` for Seller Profile projections; `(data_residency_region, status)` for residency-bounded edge cache invalidation.

**Legacy category migration.** Legacy rows carrying the inline `category` enum (`erp`, `crm`, `hrms`, `analytics`, `supply_chain`, `integration`, `other`) migrate to the matching §4.5.4 Taxonomy Node by slug. `other` migrates to the Ops-maintained `marketplace_category:other` node and is flagged for seller review before republish. New writes MUST NOT accept the inline enum; write attempts return HTTP 422 `marketplace_listing_category_requires_taxonomy_node`.

**State Machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Actor | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | Seller creates listing | Seller Org active; category FK resolves; residency set | Seller | Draft visible only to Seller Org and Ops |
| `draft` | `published` | Seller publishes | Required public fields valid; category node active or deprecated-with-successor; media scan clean | Seller | Stamps `published_at` if null; emits Marketplace Listing publish signals |
| `published` | `flagged_for_review` | Abuse report or automated signal | §4.5.7 report created or SIM detector fires | System / Ops | Public listing may remain visible until severity rule decides hide |
| `published` or `flagged_for_review` | `hidden` | Ops moderation hold | Abuse severity high/critical OR §50.25 manual hide | Ops | Public browse suppresses listing; direct URL returns review notice or 410 per §27.8 |
| `flagged_for_review` or `hidden` | `published` | Ops clears report / appeal overturned | Abuse report closure `dismissed` or appeal `overturned` | Ops | SEO noindex removed on next cache purge |
| `draft` or `published` or `hidden` | `archived` | Seller archives | No open EOI Acceptance requires listing visibility | Seller | Direct URL redirects to Seller Profile; can be republished |
| `archived` | `published` | Seller republishes | Same publish validation as draft publish | Seller | Preserves original `published_at`; updates `updated_at` |
| Any non-terminal state | `removed` | Ops delists or seller hard-removes | Abuse ban, vendor opt-out global delist, Org closure, or seller deletion request | Ops / Seller | Terminal for public URL; direct URL returns 410 and canonical fallback |
| `removed` | (no path) | — | Terminal | — | New listing row required |

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Active listings are retained for Seller Org life. Archived listings retain public-content tombstones for 180 days for redirect and SEO integrity, then retain only structural identifiers needed by EOI, abuse, and analytics rows. Removed listings keep a 410 tombstone for 7 years when removal is abuse-, legal-, or billing-related; otherwise purge after the 180-day redirect window. `created_by` and `updated_by` follow Pattern B; public copy fields (`title`, `tagline`, `description`, `pricing_description`) are swept for subject PII per §6.8.4.5. Residency follows the seller Org's `data_residency_region` and all referenced binaries must remain in a matching storage backend.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Taxonomy node deprecated after publish.** Resolved: published listing remains readable, write/edit requires selecting the successor node unless the deprecated node has no successor and Ops grants an exception.
2. **Seller attempts to publish with Decimal price values from legacy clients.** Resolved: API rejects with `marketplace_listing_price_requires_integer_cents`; migration worker converts existing Decimal values by multiplying by 100 and rounding half-even before deploy cutover.
3. **Buyer requests a hidden or removed listing by direct URL.** Resolved: hidden returns a review-state projection without private seller data; removed returns HTTP 410 with a category fallback.
4. **Abuse report hides a listing while active EOIs exist.** Resolved: EOI/NDA/acceptance records remain intact; public browse suppresses the listing; seller and buyer workflows continue from the private records.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Creating or updating a Marketplace Listing MUST reject any category input that is not a resolvable §4.5.4 Taxonomy Node with `kind=marketplace_category`.
2. `min_price_cents_monthly`, `max_price_cents_monthly`, and `currency_code` MUST be stored as integer cents plus Appendix J `billing_currency`; no Decimal money field may be persisted.
3. Seller-console reads MUST be scoped to `org_id`; buyer and anonymous reads MUST return only `status=published` public projections unless the direct URL is in the documented hidden/removed path.
4. Every state transition MUST conform to the State Machine and write an Audit Event with `entity_type=marketplace_listing`.
5. A publish transition MUST fail unless required public fields, media scan status, residency, taxonomy FK, and pricing field invariants validate in the same transaction.
6. DSAR processing MUST preserve structural listing references used by EOIs, abuse reports, analytics, and redirects while redacting actor FKs and body-field PII per the Retention paragraph.

### 4.5.2 EOI Record (Expression of Interest) (Marketplace Domain) {#4.5.2-eoi-record}

**Authoring Intent.** EOI Record captures the Expression of Interest lifecycle bound to a Marketplace Listing before buyer acceptance materializes an EOI Acceptance Record (§4.5.8). It is a marketplace-domain cross-console object: seller-side draft/submit flows and buyer-side acceptance flows both act on the same durable row, but each console receives a projection constrained by §7.2.

**Scope:** Marketplace-domain, buyer/seller cross-console. `marketplace_listing_id` resolves the seller side; `buyer_org_id` and optional Workspace context resolve the buyer side. `console='marketplace'` marks the row as a neutral bridge record. Sellers see only EOIs that target their listing; buyers see only EOIs tied to their Org/workspace. Third-party Orgs receive HTTP 404.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `console` | Enum | Fixed `marketplace`; Appendix J `marketplace_entity_console` | Neutral cross-console marketplace record |
| `marketplace_listing_id` | UUID | FK → Marketplace Listing | Product reference |
| `seller_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Organization ID | Denormalized from Marketplace Listing.`org_id`; immutable after create |
| `buyer_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Organization ID | Buyer expressing or receiving interest |
| `buyer_user_id` | UUID (FK) | User ID | Buyer-side actor when known; nullable for seller-origin draft until buyer acceptance |
| `eoi_status` | Enum | Appendix J `eoi_record_status` | EOI lifecycle; see State Machine below |
| `eoi_submitted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When EOI was sent to the buyer-side recipient |
| `eoi_acknowledged_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When recipient acknowledged |
| `eoi_approved_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When buyer accepted / approved and §4.5.8 materialized |
| `eoi_rejected_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When recipient declined |
| `eoi_withdrawn_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When submitting party withdrew before approval |
| `rejection_reason` | String | 0–500 chars | If rejected, why |
| `estimated_contract_value_cents` | BigInt | Nullable; >= 0 | Estimated contract value in integer cents |
| `currency_code` | Enum | Appendix J `billing_currency`; default from buyer Org wallet when present, else `usd` | Currency for `estimated_contract_value_cents` |
| `estimated_implementation_timeline_days` | Integer | >= 0 | Expected go-live in days |
| `data_residency_region` | Enum | Appendix J `data_residency_region`: `us`, `eu`, `apac`, `custom` | **D-1.4-002 remediation, 2026-05-01.** Required at create. **Tie-break rule:** EOI Record residency follows the buyer Org's `data_residency_region` at row write time. Cross-residency notification to the seller crosses via the §4.7.1 Console Bridge canonicalization layer. Enterprise strict-residency lock blocks cross-residency EOI submissions with HTTP 422 `eoi_record_residency_lock_violation`. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | User ID | Creator; Pattern B DSAR treatment |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User ID | **D-1.4-014 remediation, 2026-05-01.** Last editor per §4.1 Principle #2 audit-trail; Pattern B DSAR treatment |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete; Ops-only after retention windows |

**Indexes.** `(buyer_org_id, eoi_status, updated_at DESC)` for buyer EOI queue; `(seller_org_id, eoi_status, updated_at DESC)` for seller EOI queue; `(marketplace_listing_id, eoi_status, created_at DESC)` for listing-scoped review; `(buyer_org_id, data_residency_region, eoi_status)` from D-1.4-002; `(created_by, created_at DESC)` for DSAR export and anti-abuse review.

**State Machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Actor | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | EOI draft created | Listing resolves; buyer/seller scope resolves; residency set | Seller or buyer flow | Draft is visible only to authoring side plus Ops |
| `draft` | `submitted` | Submit EOI | Required fields valid; rate limits pass; listing `status=published` unless direct private flow allows | Seller / Buyer | Stamps `eoi_submitted_at`; emits notification |
| `submitted` | `acknowledged` | Recipient acknowledges | Recipient Org matches `buyer_org_id` or `seller_org_id` projection as applicable | Buyer / Seller | Stamps `eoi_acknowledged_at`; does not create acceptance |
| `submitted` or `acknowledged` | `approved` | Buyer accepts | §4.5.8 acceptance write succeeds atomically | Buyer | Stamps `eoi_approved_at`; creates EOI Acceptance Record |
| `submitted` or `acknowledged` | `rejected` | Recipient rejects | `rejection_reason` supplied when policy requires | Buyer / Seller | Stamps `eoi_rejected_at`; terminal except Ops reopen |
| `draft` or `submitted` or `acknowledged` | `withdrawn` | Authoring side withdraws | No active EOI Acceptance exists | Seller / Buyer | Stamps `eoi_withdrawn_at`; terminal |
| `rejected` or `withdrawn` | `submitted` | Ops reopen | Correction window ≤ 14 days; Ops note required | Ops | Audit-only exception; cannot bypass rate limits |

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** Raw EOI rows retain for 24 months after terminal state, then roll up to monthly aggregate metrics unless an EOI Acceptance, Target Account, Bid Workspace, abuse report, legal hold, or CRM sync activity references the row; referenced rows retain for the parent record's retention horizon. Actor FKs (`buyer_user_id`, `created_by`, `updated_by`) follow Pattern B. Free-text `rejection_reason` and CRM snapshots participate in §6.8.4.5 body-field sweep. Residency follows buyer Org per D-1.4-002.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **Listing removed after EOI submission.** Resolved: EOI remains readable to both parties; new acceptance is blocked unless Ops revalidates the seller and target listing.
2. **Two buyer admins accept concurrently.** Resolved: §4.5.8 unique `eoi_record_id` acceptance invariant wins; the losing transition returns `eoi_acceptance_duplicate`.
3. **Legacy Decimal contract value submitted.** Resolved: API rejects with `eoi_contract_value_requires_integer_cents`; migration converts legacy `estimated_contract_value_usd` to `estimated_contract_value_cents = dollars * 100`.
4. **Cross-console enumeration attempt.** Resolved: any caller whose Org is neither `buyer_org_id` nor `seller_org_id` receives HTTP 404; seller projection never exposes buyer-internal workspace fields.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. EOI writes MUST validate `marketplace_listing_id`, `seller_org_id`, `buyer_org_id`, `eoi_status`, residency, and integer-cents contract value in one transaction.
2. Every status mutation MUST conform to the State Machine and reject illegal transitions with `eoi_invalid_state_transition`.
3. Creating an EOI Acceptance Record MUST atomically transition `eoi_status` to `approved`; partial acceptance without EOI status update is forbidden.
4. Buyer and seller API projections MUST be distinct and MUST return HTTP 404 to third-party Orgs and wrong-console sessions.
5. CRM Sync field mappings and routing rules MUST reference `estimated_contract_value_cents` plus `currency_code`; `estimated_contract_value_usd` is a legacy migration alias only.
6. DSAR processing MUST pseudonymize actor FKs, sweep body PII, and preserve aggregate marketplace metrics according to the Retention paragraph.

### 4.5.3 NDA Record (Marketplace Domain) {#4.5.3-nda-record}

**Authoring Intent.** NDA Record is the cross-console contract object that gates seller visibility into NDA-protected buyer materials and anchors the §25 / §24 Q&A NDA authorization model. It records who issued the NDA, each side's signature state, the executed document URL, expiry, revocation, and custom terms. The contract row survives user erasure to preserve legal-defense and audit integrity.

**Scope:** Marketplace-domain, buyer/seller cross-console. `buyer_org_id` and `seller_org_id` jointly scope the row; `console='marketplace'` marks the neutral contract domain. Buyer and seller projections expose the contract fields each side needs to sign and verify access; internal signatory email details are redacted to the opposite side unless the executed document itself carries those details. Ops sees all fields.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | Primary key | Auto-generated |
| `console` | Enum | Fixed `marketplace`; Appendix J `marketplace_entity_console` | Neutral cross-console contract record |
| `buyer_org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Buyer's organization |
| `seller_org_id` | UUID | FK → Organization | Seller's organization |
| `marketplace_listing_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → Marketplace Listing | Listing that initiated the NDA path when applicable |
| `eoi_record_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; FK → EOI Record | Source EOI when NDA follows §4.5.8 acceptance |
| `nda_status` | Enum | Appendix J `nda_record_status` | NDA lifecycle; see State Machine below |
| `nda_type` | Enum | Appendix J `nda_record_type` | NDA type |
| `nda_document_url` | String | Valid HTTPS URL | NDA document (PDF or link); stored in residency-matching object storage |
| `nda_issued_by` | Enum | Appendix J `nda_record_issued_by` | Who provided template |
| `nda_issued_at` | Timestamp | UTC | When NDA created |
| `nda_signed_by_buyer` | Boolean | Default: false | Buyer signature status |
| `nda_buyer_signed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Buyer signature timestamp |
| `nda_buyer_signatory_email` | String | Valid email | Buyer signatory email; Pattern A string-column pseudonymization on DSAR |
| `nda_signed_by_seller` | Boolean | Default: false | Seller signature status |
| `nda_seller_signed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Seller signature timestamp |
| `nda_seller_signatory_email` | String | Valid email | Seller signatory email; Pattern A string-column pseudonymization on DSAR |
| `nda_expires_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When NDA expires |
| `revoked_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | When revoked before expiry |
| `revoked_by` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; User ID | Actor who revoked; Pattern B DSAR treatment |
| `revocation_reason` | String | 0–1000 chars, nullable | Required when `nda_status=revoked` |
| `custom_terms` | JSON | Max 5000 chars | Custom NDA modifications; body-field PII sweep applies |
| `data_residency_region` | Enum | Appendix J `data_residency_region`: `us`, `eu`, `apac`, `custom` | Required at create. Tie-break: buyer Org residency when NDA gates buyer materials; seller Org residency only for seller-issued mutual NDA templates with no buyer Workspace yet. Cross-residency execution uses §4.7.1 bridge canonicalization. |
| `created_at` | Timestamp | Immutable | UTC |
| `updated_at` | Timestamp | Auto-updated | UTC |
| `created_by` | UUID (FK) | User ID | Creator (buyer or seller); Pattern B DSAR treatment |
| `updated_by` | UUID (FK) | User ID | Last mutator; Pattern B DSAR treatment |
| `deleted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Soft delete after retention horizon only; hard-delete forbidden while contract evidence is retained |

**Indexes.** `(buyer_org_id, seller_org_id, nda_status)` for bilateral lookup; `(buyer_org_id, nda_status, nda_expires_at)` for buyer NDA gate; `(seller_org_id, nda_status, nda_expires_at)` for seller access; `(marketplace_listing_id, nda_status)` partial where `marketplace_listing_id IS NOT NULL`; `(eoi_record_id)` partial where `eoi_record_id IS NOT NULL`; `(nda_expires_at, nda_status)` for expiry worker.

**State Machine.**

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Actor | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `draft` | NDA created | Buyer and seller Orgs resolve; document URL or template selected | Buyer / Seller / Marketplace | Draft visible to issuer side and Ops |
| `draft` | `pending_buyer` | Seller or marketplace submits NDA requiring buyer signature | `nda_issued_by IN {seller, marketplace}`; document scan clean | Seller / System | Buyer notified; seller Q&A remains gated |
| `draft` | `pending_seller` | Buyer submits NDA requiring seller signature | `nda_issued_by=buyer`; document scan clean | Buyer | Seller notified; seller Q&A remains gated |
| `pending_buyer` | `executed` | Buyer signs | Buyer signature captured; seller signature already captured or not required by unilateral-seller flow | Buyer | Stamps buyer signature fields; emits `nda_executed` bridge event when complete |
| `pending_seller` | `executed` | Seller signs | Seller signature captured; buyer signature already captured or not required by unilateral-buyer flow | Seller | Stamps seller signature fields; emits `nda_executed` bridge event when complete |
| `pending_buyer` | `pending_seller` | Buyer signs first on mutual NDA | Buyer signature captured; seller signature still required | Buyer | Keeps NDA gated until seller signs |
| `pending_seller` | `pending_buyer` | Seller signs first on mutual NDA | Seller signature captured; buyer signature still required | Seller | Keeps NDA gated until buyer signs |
| `executed` | `expired` | Expiry worker | `nda_expires_at < now` | System | Revokes NDA-gated read eligibility on next permission refresh |
| Any non-terminal state | `revoked` | Revocation or appeal/disqualification cascade | `revocation_reason` supplied; Ops required after execution unless both parties consent | Buyer / Seller / Ops | Revokes NDA-gated read eligibility; contract row preserved |
| `expired` or `revoked` | (no path) | — | Terminal | — | New NDA row required |

**Retention, DSAR, and residency.** NDA Records retain for Org-life + 7 years after `nda_expires_at`, `revoked_at`, or Workspace closure, whichever is latest, under the §40.2 financial/legal-record exception and §6.8.5 legal-defense retained-row class. Hard-delete is forbidden during that horizon. `created_by`, `updated_by`, and `revoked_by` follow Pattern B. `nda_buyer_signatory_email` and `nda_seller_signatory_email` follow Pattern A string-column pseudonymization to `anonymized_<console>_user_<base32(hash)[:16]>@anonymized.invalid`; the contract row, signature timestamps, NDA type, issuer, and non-PII legal facts are preserved. `custom_terms` participates in §6.8.4.5 body-field sweep. Residency follows the tie-break rule in the field table.

**Failure Modes Addressed.**

1. **One party signs while the other revokes.** Resolved: transition uses row-level compare-and-swap on `nda_status`; losing write receives `nda_invalid_state_transition`.
2. **NDA expires while Q&A page is open.** Resolved: authorization predicate refresh suppresses reads and compose actions on the next permission check; emits `qa_thread.access_revoked` with `nda_expired_qa_revoked`.
3. **DSAR targets a signatory.** Resolved: signatory email pseudonymizes in place; contract row and signature facts remain under legal-defense retention.
4. **Document storage residency mismatch.** Resolved: write rejected with `E_RESIDENCY_MISMATCH`; document must be re-uploaded to the residency-matching backend.

**Acceptance Criteria.**

1. Creating an NDA Record MUST set `console='marketplace'`, both Org FKs, `nda_status`, `nda_type`, `nda_issued_by`, residency, and audit fields in one transaction.
2. Every NDA status mutation MUST conform to the State Machine and reject illegal transitions with `nda_invalid_state_transition`.
3. Seller Q&A / NDA-gated reads MUST grant access only when `nda_status=executed`, `nda_expires_at > now`, and no revocation-equivalent blocker exists.
4. Expiry worker MUST transition every executed NDA whose `nda_expires_at < now` to `expired` within 15 minutes and emit the relevant access-revocation audit event.
5. Revocation after execution MUST require either both-party consent or Ops authority, write `revoked_at`, `revoked_by`, and `revocation_reason`, and suppress gated reads within 60 seconds.
6. DSAR processing MUST pseudonymize signatory emails while preserving the NDA contract row and actor-FK audit trail for the required legal-retention horizon.

### 4.5.4 Taxonomy Node (Platform-Scoped, Ops-Managed, Multi-Kind Controlled Vocabulary) {#4.5.4-taxonomy-node}
