### 48.5.1 M1 Stakeholder Read-Only Invite {#48.5.1-m1-stakeholder-read-only-invite}

#### Purpose

M1 converts non-evaluator stakeholders — CFO, General Counsel (GC), CISO, Executive Sponsor, Head of Procurement, Head of Department-X — into Sourcera users via a magic-link invitation that grants read-only access to Phase 8+ artifacts (vendor responses, demos, scoring summaries, Selection Reports, post-Phase-13 Selection Records). The mechanic exists because the canonical procurement signoff loop requires multiple non-evaluator approvers whose engagement with Sourcera artifacts has historically happened over email, PDF exports, and ad-hoc Zoom screenshares. M1 brings those approvers into the platform with zero friction (no plan upgrade, no seat fee, no NDA gate at signup) while preserving the §5.4 Guest permission firewall on what they can see and do.

#### Trigger

A Workspace Owner (§5.3) OR Evaluation Lead (§5.3) clicks "Invite Stakeholder" on (a) the Workspace header > Members panel; (b) the Selection Report header > Share panel (Phase 12+); (c) the Phase 8 vendor-demo summary; (d) the Phase 13 Closure summary. The trigger is gated to `phase ≥ 8` (Phase 8 = Buyer Due Diligence & Demos per §10.8). Attempting to issue an M1 invite before Phase 8 returns HTTP 422 `m1_stakeholder_invite_phase_too_early` (Appendix I — new) with the human-readable reason "Stakeholder invitations are available from Phase 8 onward; the workspace is currently in Phase {n}." Pre-Phase-8 invitations are explicitly forbidden because the artifacts that M1 surfaces (vendor responses, demo notes, scoring summaries) do not yet exist in shippable form.

#### Actor & Entity Schema

**Acting entity.** Buyer Org user with `workspace_owner` OR `evaluation_lead` role on the originating Workspace. `workspace_admin` MAY also issue per the §5.11 Feature Access Matrix row added in this section's appendix-update block.

**Targeted entity.** A named individual (email + display name + intended stakeholder role) who is NOT a current member of the Workspace AND whose email is NOT on the §48.4.8 Suppression List. The targeted individual MAY OR MAY NOT already be a Sourcera user.

**New entity: StakeholderInvite (Workspace-Scoped, Buyer-Only).** Tracks each issuance from creation through redemption, expiry, OR revocation. Append-only per §4.3.16 audit pattern.

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | PK, immutable | Standard. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | → Organization (§4.2.1); buyer Org; required | Primary RBAC scope. |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | M1 is buyer-only. |
| `workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | → Workspace (§4.3.1); required | The workspace whose Phase 8+ artifacts are being shared. |
| `invite_code` | String | 16 chars, URL-safe Base32, unique | Magic-link redemption token. |
| `inviter_user_id` | UUID (FK) | → User (§4.2.3); required | Must hold `workspace_owner`, `evaluation_lead`, OR `workspace_admin` at issuance time. |
| `stakeholder_email` | String | Valid email; max 320 chars; lowercased before storage | Target email. |
| `stakeholder_email_domain` | String | Max 253 chars; lowercased | Denormalized for §48.4.3 shared-use-domain check + §48.4.8 suppression-list lookup. |
| `stakeholder_display_name` | String | 1–120 chars | Recipient display name; required to surface in audit log + Selection Report read-receipt. |
| `stakeholder_role_label` | Enum | Appendix J `m1_stakeholder_role_label` (new): `cfo`, `gc_legal`, `ciso_security`, `executive_sponsor`, `head_of_procurement`, `head_of_department`, `board_observer`, `compliance_officer`, `other` | Display-only label; does NOT grant any RBAC privilege. |
| `stakeholder_role_label_other_note` | String | 0–120 chars; required when `stakeholder_role_label=other`; nullable otherwise | Free-text label for edge stakeholder roles (e.g., "Risk Committee Chair"). |
| `permission_profile` | Enum | Appendix J `guest_permission_profile` (existing per §5.4): `read_only` (M1 default and ONLY allowed value at issuance) | M1 invitations always provision the Guest `read_only` profile per §5.4.1. Future expansion to `contributor` / `scorer` is explicitly NOT in M1 scope (those Guest profiles require the existing §5.4 Workspace Owner invite flow which already exists). |
| `assigned_use_case_ids` | Array[UUID] | Empty array OR ≤ 100 UUIDs | Subset of Workspace Use Cases the stakeholder may view per §5.4.5; empty array = full Use Case visibility within `read_only` profile. |
| `phase_floor_at_issuance` | Integer | 8–13; required | The phase of the Workspace at issuance time; recorded for audit so a later phase regression (rare; only via Ops correction) is observable. |
| `accept_url` | String | URL; max 2,000 chars; computed: `https://app.sourcera.io/invites/stakeholder/{invite_code}` | Materialized for email-template rendering convenience. |
| `email_send_status` | Enum | Appendix J `m1_email_send_status` (new): `queued`, `sent`, `delivered`, `bounced`, `deferred`, `suppressed`, `failed` | Mirrors §41 Loops.so delivery telemetry. |
| `email_payload_hash` | String | SHA-256, 64 chars | Per §48.4.1 dedup; identical hash within 24h coalesces. |
| `redemption_status` | Enum | Appendix J `m1_redemption_status` (new): `pending`, `redeemed`, `expired`, `revoked_by_inviter`, `revoked_by_ops`, `bounced_undeliverable`, `suppressed_pre_send` | Lifecycle state per §48.5.1.x state machine below. |
| `redeemed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on first successful magic-link redemption. |
| `redeemed_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → User (§4.2.3) | Set when the recipient signs up (or is matched to existing Sourcera user via SSO). |
| `redeemed_org_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → Organization (§4.2.1) | The Org under which the stakeholder is provisioned — usually a NEW Org (single-user) for first-time stakeholders, OR the inviter's Org if Domain Auto-Join (M6) matches at redemption. |
| `redemption_path_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `m1_redemption_path_kind` (new): `new_org_provisioned`, `existing_user_added_as_guest`, `m6_domain_auto_join_to_inviter_org`, `existing_member_no_op` | The path the redemption took. |
| `expires_at` | Timestamp | Required; computed at issuance: `created_at + 14 days` | The magic link expires 14 days after issuance. |
| `revoked_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on revocation. |
| `revoked_by_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → User (§4.2.3) | Inviter, Workspace Owner, OR Ops user. |
| `revoked_reason` | Enum | Appendix J `m1_revoked_reason` (new): `inviter_changed_mind`, `wrong_recipient_address`, `phase_regressed_below_8`, `ops_security_action`, `recipient_left_company`, `other` | Required when `revoked_at` is non-null. |
| `revoked_reason_note` | String | 0–500 chars | Required when `revoked_reason=other`. |
| `read_receipt_event_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; default 0 | Incremented every time the redeemed stakeholder loads a Selection Report OR Phase 12 summary in this Workspace. |
| `last_read_receipt_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Updated on each receipt event. |
| `signal_integrity_flags` | Array[Enum] | Appendix J `growth_loop_signal_integrity_flag` (existing per §48.2.12); empty array default | Populated by SIM (Summary C.100) on velocity / harvest patterns. |
| `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `deleted_at` | Standard | Standard pattern | Soft delete is functionally equivalent to revocation; prefer `revoked_at` for forensic clarity. |

**Scope isolation.** Workspace-scoped on `workspace_id` (which inherits Org scope on `org_id`). Read access at the buyer console is granted to: the inviter, the Workspace Owner, the Evaluation Lead, the Workspace Admin, AND any Org Owner / Org Admin per §5.2 + §5.3. The targeted stakeholder MAY read their OWN row (only via the redemption path, post-signup) but CANNOT enumerate other StakeholderInvite rows in the Workspace. Cross-Org reads are blocked at the API layer with HTTP 404 `stakeholder_invite_cross_org_access` (Appendix I — new). The Vendor Console MUST 404 on any attempted access.

**Required indexes.** `(workspace_id, redemption_status)`, `(stakeholder_email_domain, created_at DESC)` (sparse for SIM velocity-anomaly scans), `(invite_code)` UNIQUE, `(org_id, inviter_user_id, created_at DESC)` (per-issuer audit), `(expires_at) WHERE redemption_status='pending'` (nightly expiry sweep), `(redeemed_user_id, workspace_id)` (per-stakeholder workspace map; sparse).

**Retention.** Workspace-life + 7 years per platform-integrity + financial-audit policy (StakeholderInvite rows underlie procurement signoff trails and may be subpoenaed). `stakeholder_email`, `stakeholder_display_name`, `stakeholder_role_label_other_note`, and identity fields (`inviter_user_id`, `redeemed_user_id`, `created_by`) are pseudonymized within the §6.8.6 fulfillment window while preserving aggregate counts for §48.3 dashboards. Not subject to right-to-erasure under the applicable §6.8.5 retained-row classes.

##### StakeholderInvite Lifecycle State Machine

Per the §5 / Appendix-A / Appendix-D / Appendix-E pattern, all `redemption_status` transitions are documented below. Terminal states are append-only.

| From | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `pending` | StakeholderInvite row written + email queued | All pre-issuance gates pass | Default initial state. |
| (init) | `suppressed_pre_send` | Pre-issuance gate fails on §48.4.8 SuppressionList match OR §4.4.8 Vendor Opt-Out match | Suppression / opt-out check fires | Row written for forensic record; no email sent; non-leak generic error to inviter. |
| `pending` | `redeemed` | Magic-link click + SSO completion within 14d | Invite not expired, not revoked, redeeming email matches `stakeholder_email` | `redeemed_at`, `redeemed_user_id`, `redeemed_org_id`, `redemption_path_kind` populated. |
| `pending` | `bounced_undeliverable` | Loops.so reports bounce | Hard bounce OR ≥ N deferred attempts | Inviter notified via `m1.invite.bounced`. |
| `pending` | `expired` | Nightly sweep at `expires_at` | `redemption_status=pending` AND `now > expires_at` | Inviter NOT notified by default; opt-in weekly digest. |
| `pending` | `revoked_by_inviter` | Inviter / Workspace Owner / Org Owner DELETE | Caller holds eligible role | `revoked_at`, `revoked_by_user_id`, `revoked_reason` populated. |
| `pending` | `revoked_by_ops` | Ops DELETE OR phase regression below 8 | Ops `ops_security_admin` OR phase machine fires regression | `revoked_reason ∈ {ops_security_action, phase_regressed_below_8}`. |
| `redeemed` | `revoked_by_inviter` | Inviter / Workspace Owner / Org Owner DELETE post-redemption | Caller holds eligible role | Removes §5.4 Guest Membership; recipient notified via `m1.access.revoked`. |
| `redeemed` | `revoked_by_ops` | Ops DELETE OR phase regression below 8 | Ops OR phase machine | Suspends §5.4 Guest Membership. |
| `revoked_by_ops` (phase regression) | `redeemed` | Workspace re-advances to Phase 8+ | Original recipient still active; `revoked_reason=phase_regressed_below_8` | Auto-restoration; recipient notified via `m1.access.restored`. |
| `redeemed`, `expired`, `revoked_*`, `bounced_undeliverable`, `suppressed_pre_send` | (terminal) | n/a | Append-only post-terminal | New invitations require new StakeholderInvite rows. |

**Invariants.** (a) `redeemed_*` fields are non-null IFF `redemption_status=redeemed`. (b) `revoked_at`, `revoked_by_user_id`, `revoked_reason` are non-null IFF `redemption_status ∈ {revoked_by_inviter, revoked_by_ops}`. (c) `read_receipt_event_count > 0` requires `redemption_status=redeemed` at some point in row history (terminal `revoked_by_*` rows MAY have `read_receipt_event_count > 0` from prior redemption phase).

#### Workflow

1. **Pre-issuance gate.** UI surface checks: (a) `workspace.phase ≥ 8` else disable button + tooltip "Available from Phase 8 onward (currently Phase {n})"; (b) inviter holds `workspace_owner` OR `evaluation_lead` OR `workspace_admin` else hide the button; (c) stakeholder slot count = number of currently-pending + redeemed StakeholderInvite rows in this Workspace is below the per-Workspace ceiling of 25 (per §39 Object Size Constraints update — see appendix-update block; rationale: a typical procurement-signoff loop has at most 6–10 stakeholders; ceiling 25 covers edge cases without becoming a spam vector). Above ceiling returns HTTP 422 `m1_workspace_stakeholder_ceiling_exceeded`.
2. **Inviter fills modal.** UI fields: stakeholder email (required), display name (required), role label (dropdown; `other` reveals free-text note), assigned Use Cases (optional multi-select, default empty = full visibility within `read_only` profile), personal-message free text (optional ≤ 500 chars; included in email body). Validation errors render inline per §3.3 modal pattern.
3. **Server validation.** Before write: (a) `stakeholder_email` lower-cased + RFC-5322 syntax check (HTTP 400 `invalid_email_address` on failure); (b) `stakeholder_email_domain` checked against §48.4.8 SuppressionListEntry (HTTP 422 `growth_loop_anti_spam_target_suppressed` per Appendix I — pre-existing); (c) `stakeholder_email` checked against §4.4.8 Vendor Opt-Out Registry — if the email belongs to a Seller Org user with a `global` opt-out, the invite is suppressed AND the inviter is shown a non-leaking generic error per §48.4.8 confidentiality semantics; (d) per-inviter rate cap: 10 M1 invites per inviter per 24h (HTTP 429 `m1_inviter_rate_limit_exceeded` — Appendix I — new) with `Retry-After`; (e) per-Workspace stakeholder ceiling re-checked atomically.
4. **Row write + email queue.** StakeholderInvite row written with `redemption_status=pending`, `email_send_status=queued`. Email handed to Loops.so adapter (§41.1) with the M1 magic-link template and a `payload_hash` for §48.4.1 dedup.
5. **Email send.** Loops.so adapter sends; delivery telemetry mirrors back to `email_send_status`. Bounces transition `redemption_status → bounced_undeliverable` AND notify the inviter via in-app Pulse + email (`m1.invite.bounced` notification — Appendix C extension below).
6. **Recipient receives email.** Email subject: "{Inviter Name} from {Buyer Org} invites you to review the {Workspace Name} evaluation"; body contains personal message (if any), workspace name, stakeholder role label, and a single magic-link CTA. Footer carries the §41.3 unsubscribe + opt-out language.
7. **Recipient clicks magic link.** Browser lands at `/invites/stakeholder/{invite_code}`. Server verifies: invite exists; not expired; not revoked. On any failure, render a friendly explainer page per §3.3 error-state pattern (see UX Surfaces below).
8. **Redemption path resolution.** Server resolves `redemption_path_kind`:
   - If `stakeholder_email` already maps to a User in any Org AND that User is already a Workspace member → `existing_member_no_op`; redirect to the Workspace landing page; no row mutation.
   - Else if the User exists but is NOT a Workspace member → `existing_user_added_as_guest`; create §5.4 Guest Workspace Membership with profile `read_only` and `assigned_use_case_ids` from the StakeholderInvite row; redirect to the Workspace landing page.
   - Else if the email's domain matches a verified Domain Auto-Join Claim (M6, §48.5.6) for the inviter's Org AND the inviter's Org has Domain Auto-Join enabled for stakeholder invites → `m6_domain_auto_join_to_inviter_org`; provision the recipient as a member of the inviter's Org with the Org's default seat role per §5.2 AND ALSO grant Workspace Guest `read_only`; mark the M6 claim row with the new auto-join.
   - Else → `new_org_provisioned`; provision a fresh single-user Org per §7.1 Organization Lifecycle (Buyer Free plan; SSO via Google/Microsoft per §6.1; the recipient becomes Org Owner of the new Org); attach the new User to the inviter's Workspace via §5.4 Guest Membership with profile `read_only`.
9. **Post-redemption confirmation.** StakeholderInvite row updated with `redemption_status=redeemed`, `redeemed_at`, `redeemed_user_id`, `redeemed_org_id`, `redemption_path_kind`. The inviter receives a `m1.invite.redeemed` notification (Appendix C extension below). The new Guest Membership inherits §5.4 RBAC including the Phase 8+ artifact visibility AND the §5.4.5 Use Case scoping.
10. **Read-receipt tracking.** Each time the redeemed stakeholder loads a Selection Report OR Phase 12 summary OR Phase 13 Closure summary, the StakeholderInvite row's `read_receipt_event_count` increments AND `last_read_receipt_at` is updated. Receipt events emit `m1_read_receipt_recorded` PostHog event (appendix update below). The Workspace Owner sees a per-stakeholder "Last viewed" column in the Members panel.
11. **Expiry sweep.** Nightly job at 02:30 UTC scans `(expires_at < now AND redemption_status='pending')`; transitions to `expired` AND emits `m1_invite_expired` event. The inviter is NOT notified by default (an unredeemed invite is low signal); Workspace Owner-configurable preference to opt into expiry digest.
12. **Revocation.** Inviter, Workspace Owner, OR Ops user MAY revoke a pending OR redeemed invite. Revocation of a pending invite simply zeros the magic-link. Revocation of a redeemed invite REMOVES the §5.4 Guest Membership AND emits `m1_redemption_revoked`; the recipient is notified by email (`m1.access.revoked` notification — Appendix C extension below) explaining the revocation. The recipient's Sourcera Org (if newly provisioned via `new_org_provisioned`) is NOT deleted — only the Workspace access is removed.

**Phase regression edge case.** If the Workspace regresses below Phase 8 (rare; only via Ops emergency-correction per §10 phase-machine), all pending M1 StakeholderInvite rows for that Workspace transition to `revoked_by_ops` with `revoked_reason=phase_regressed_below_8`; redeemed invites' Guest Memberships are SUSPENDED (read access frozen) until the Workspace re-advances to Phase 8+. The recipients receive `m1.access.suspended` notification (Appendix C extension below) explaining the temporary suspension.

#### UX Surfaces

| Surface | §3.3 Pattern | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| "Invite Stakeholder" button (Workspace header > Members) | `Sidebar Navigation + Modal` per §3.3.1 | Visible only at `phase ≥ 8`; tooltip if phase too early. |
| Stakeholder Invite Modal | `Modal + Keyboard` per §3.3.1 | Tab through fields; Enter submits; Esc cancels; first-field auto-focus. |
| Magic-link landing page (anonymous) | `Full-page route + Single CTA` per §3.3 (auth landing analogue) | No sensitive data pre-auth; the page name the Workspace and inviter only after the recipient clicks "Continue with Google/Microsoft." |
| Stakeholder-view Selection Report | Per §3.3.7 Detail Panel + Split View | Banner: "You are viewing this report as a Stakeholder ({role label}) invited by {Inviter Name}. You have read-only access until {expiry of associated permissions, if any}." |
| Workspace Members > Stakeholders tab | `Sidebar Navigation + Inline Table` per §3.3.1 | Per-row: stakeholder name, role label, redemption status, last viewed timestamp, actions (resend, revoke). |
| Inviter "Bounce" Pulse card | `In-App Inbox` per §20 | "{stakeholder_email} bounced — check for typos" with "Resend" + "Revoke" actions. |
| Mobile parity | Per §3.4 Mobile Translation | Modal becomes full-screen sheet; Magic-link page is mobile-first single CTA. |

**Empty / error / loading states.** First-time empty (Phase ≥ 8, no invites yet) shows an explainer card with one-line copy: "Bring CFO, Legal, Security, and Sponsors into the loop with read-only access to vendor responses and the Selection Report." Loading shows skeleton-row table. Error states: per-bounce "We couldn't deliver to {email}" inline; per-redemption-failed (rare; magic-link malformed or expired) full-page friendly explainer page with Sourcera support contact.

**Accessibility (§37.1).** All M1 surfaces meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Magic-link landing page MUST be keyboard-navigable, screen-reader-friendly, and contrast-compliant. The Stakeholder-view banner MUST be announced by screen readers on every load (`aria-live=polite`).

#### Data Collected / Retained

Per the StakeholderInvite field table above. Privacy posture: the `stakeholder_email` and `stakeholder_display_name` are PII; pseudonymized within 30 days on DSAR. `read_receipt_event_count` and `last_read_receipt_at` are aggregable usage signals; preserved indefinitely for §48.3 dashboards. `signal_integrity_flags` are SIM-Ops-only, never customer-readable. The recipient's redeemed User identity, if newly provisioned, follows the §6.8 PII retention lifecycle of any other Sourcera User.

**Residency.** StakeholderInvite rows live in the originating buyer Workspace's data region per §1.6 Deployment Regions. The Loops.so email send respects §41.3 SPF/DKIM/DMARC and §47.4 data-residency-aware routing.

#### Anti-Abuse Controls

1. **Per-inviter rate cap (§48.4.1 alignment).** 10 M1 invites per inviter per 24h. Above cap → HTTP 429 `m1_inviter_rate_limit_exceeded` with `Retry-After`.
2. **Per-Workspace stakeholder ceiling (§39 update).** 25 active StakeholderInvite rows per Workspace. Above → HTTP 422 `m1_workspace_stakeholder_ceiling_exceeded`.
3. **Per-stakeholder-email cross-Workspace anomaly detection (SIM).** If the same `stakeholder_email` is invited by ≥ 5 distinct buyer Orgs in a 30-day rolling window, SIM emits `velocity_anomaly` (per §48.2.12 + §48.4.10) and the 6th-onward invite for that email enters a deferred-send queue pending Ops review. This catches the "stakeholder email farming" pattern where an actor harvests M1 to seed multi-Org member relationships in a recipient's mailbox.
4. **§48.4.3 shared-use-domain registry.** `stakeholder_email_domain` matched at server validation step 3; gmail.com / outlook.com / etc. ARE allowed for M1 (unlike L1 / M5) because real CFO / GC / CISO recipients sometimes use personal addresses, BUT shared-use-domain invites emit `m1_invite_shared_use_domain_warn` (PostHog appendix update below) and are subject to a tighter SIM threshold (≥ 3 distinct buyer Orgs in 30d → velocity_anomaly).
5. **§48.4.8 SuppressionList lookup.** Hard reject before write per validation step 3; HTTP 422 with non-leaking generic error.
6. **§4.4.8 Vendor Opt-Out registry.** `stakeholder_email` matched at validation step 3 — opted-out vendor users are NEVER invitable as M1 stakeholders to preserve the global opt-out invariant; suppressed silently per §48.4.8 confidentiality.
7. **Email-template content validation (§48.4.4).** The personal-message free-text field passes XSS sanitizer + PII detector + profanity classifier before email send. Failures block send AND surface a remediation banner.
8. **DMARC preflight (§48.4.2).** If the buyer Org's `org_email_domain` has `dmarc_alignment_pass_rate < 0.85` (rolling 7d), M1 invites use Sourcera's neutral `noreply@sourcera.io` From: address with the inviter's name in the display field rather than send-on-behalf-of; the inviter is informed via Pulse: "Your domain's email reputation is below threshold; M1 invites will send from Sourcera's address until reputation recovers — {Reconnect Domain Verification}."
9. **Read-receipt manipulation mitigation.** `read_receipt_event_count` is debounced server-side: at most one increment per `(invite_id, session_id, hour)` to prevent inflated counts via repeated reloads.

#### Plan Gating & Entitlement

M1 is included on every Buyer plan tier (Free, Starter, Growth, Scale, Enterprise) with no per-mechanic gating. The per-Workspace ceiling (25) is universal per §39 update. Rationale: M1's value to the procurement loop is universal; gating it would penalize the smallest customers' ability to execute signoff, which is the very scenario where read-only stakeholder visibility moves the hardest. The §5.11 Feature Access Matrix is updated to include the row "Issue M1 Stakeholder Invite": ✓ for `org_owner`, `workspace_owner`, `evaluation_lead`, `workspace_admin`; ✗ for everyone else (see appendix-update block).

#### Telemetry Events

| Event | Trigger | Key Properties |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `m1_invite_issued` | StakeholderInvite row written; email queued | `m1_invite_id`, `workspace_id`, `inviter_user_id`, `stakeholder_email_domain_hash` (SHA-256, 12 hex), `stakeholder_role_label`, `assigned_use_case_count`, `phase_floor_at_issuance` |
| `m1_invite_email_delivered` | Loops.so reports `delivered` | `m1_invite_id`, `delivery_latency_seconds` |
| `m1_invite_email_bounced` | Loops.so reports `bounced` | `m1_invite_id`, `bounce_kind ∈ {hard_bounce, soft_bounce, complaint, deferred_max_attempts}` |
| `m1_invite_clicked` | Magic-link click recorded (pre-auth) | `m1_invite_id`, `time_to_click_seconds`, `user_agent_class` (per §4.3.18 enum) |
| `m1_invite_redeemed` | Redemption completes | `m1_invite_id`, `redemption_path_kind`, `time_to_redemption_seconds`, `redeemed_user_id`, `redeemed_org_id`, `was_new_org_provisioned` (Boolean) |
| `m1_read_receipt_recorded` | Stakeholder loads a Phase 8+ artifact (debounced 1/h/session) | `m1_invite_id`, `artifact_kind ∈ {selection_report, phase_12_summary, phase_13_summary, vendor_response_view, demo_summary}`, `artifact_id` |
| `m1_invite_expired` | Nightly sweep | `m1_invite_id`, `time_from_issuance_to_expiry_seconds` |
| `m1_invite_revoked` | Inviter / Ops revokes | `m1_invite_id`, `revoked_by_user_id`, `revoked_reason`, `was_redeemed_at_revocation` (Boolean) |
| `m1_invite_shared_use_domain_warn` | Shared-use domain detected at validation (§48.4.3) | `m1_invite_id`, `stakeholder_email_domain_hash` |
| `m1_inviter_rate_limit_hit` | Per-inviter cap exceeded | `inviter_user_id`, `org_id`, `attempted_count_in_window`, `next_allowed_at` |
| `m1_workspace_stakeholder_ceiling_hit` | Per-Workspace cap exceeded | `workspace_id`, `org_id`, `current_count`, `ceiling` |

All events carry the §48 standard property set (`org_id`, `console=buyer`, `signal_freshness_seconds_max`); DSAR-erased rows redact `stakeholder_email_domain_hash` and pseudonymize `inviter_user_id` / `redeemed_user_id`.

#### Notifications Fired

| Notification | Recipient | Channels | Frequency | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `m1.invite.issued` | Stakeholder (recipient) | Email | Immediate | Magic-link email; §41 templates. |
| `m1.invite.bounced` | Inviter | In-App + Email | Immediate | "We couldn't deliver to {email}" + Resend / Revoke CTAs. |
| `m1.invite.redeemed` | Inviter, Workspace Owner | In-App | Immediate | "{Stakeholder} ({role}) accepted your invite." |
| `m1.access.revoked` | Stakeholder (recipient) | Email | Immediate | Explains revocation; offers Sourcera support contact. |
| `m1.access.suspended` | Stakeholder (recipient) | Email | Immediate | On Workspace phase regression below 8; explains temporary suspension. |
| `m1.invite.expired_digest` | Inviter | Email | Weekly opt-in (default off) | Aggregated weekly summary of expired pending invites. |

All notifications respect §29.3 user preferences AND §41.3 unsubscribe semantics; transactional notifications (`m1.invite.issued`, `m1.access.revoked`, `m1.access.suspended`) are NOT subject to opt-out per §41.4. New notification kinds registered in Appendix C update block below.

#### Webhooks Fired

Per §31.1 transport semantics (HMAC-SHA256, `event_id`, Appendix F retry curve, DLQ after 5 failures, ≤256 KB). All webhooks use the `growth_domain` event class (Appendix J `webhook_event_class` extension below) and are Org-scoped to the buyer Org.

| Webhook event_type | Trigger | Payload Highlights |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `growth.m1.invite.issued` | StakeholderInvite write | `m1_invite_id`, `workspace_id`, `inviter_user_id`, `stakeholder_email_domain_hash`, `phase_floor_at_issuance` |
| `growth.m1.invite.redeemed` | Redemption | `m1_invite_id`, `redemption_path_kind`, `redeemed_user_id` (pseudonymized hash for cross-Org consumers), `redeemed_org_id` |
| `growth.m1.invite.revoked` | Revocation | `m1_invite_id`, `revoked_by_user_id`, `revoked_reason` |
| `growth.m1.access.suspended` | Phase regression | `m1_invite_id`, `workspace_id`, `phase_at_suspension` |

Email contents (`stakeholder_email`, `stakeholder_display_name`) are NEVER included in webhook payloads — only the SHA-256 hash of the email domain is exposed, preserving recipient privacy in third-party integrations.

#### API Endpoints

All endpoints follow §32 patterns: cursor pagination (default 50, max 250), §32.2 auth headers, §32.4.5 rate-limit class `growth_domain` (5,000 req/h burst per Org, shared with other §48 endpoints), error codes from Appendix I.

| Method | Path | Auth Scope | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `POST` | `/v1/orgs/{org_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stakeholder-invites` | `write:workspaces` + role in {`workspace_owner`, `evaluation_lead`, `workspace_admin`} | Issue M1 invite. Idempotency-Key header supported per §32.8 conventions. |
| `GET` | `/v1/orgs/{org_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stakeholder-invites` | `read:workspaces` + role in {`workspace_owner`, `evaluation_lead`, `workspace_admin`, `org_owner`, `org_admin`} | List per-Workspace invites; supports `?status=` filter and `?inviter_user_id=` filter. |
| `GET` | `/v1/orgs/{org_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stakeholder-invites/{invite_id}` | Same as list | Fetch one. |
| `POST` | `/v1/orgs/{org_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stakeholder-invites/{invite_id}/resend` | `write:workspaces` + role same as issue | Resend the magic-link email; respects per-inviter rate cap. |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/orgs/{org_id}/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stakeholder-invites/{invite_id}` | `write:workspaces` + role same as issue OR Ops `ops_security_admin` | Revoke (sets `revoked_at`, `revoked_by_user_id`, `revoked_reason`). |
| `POST` | `/v1/invites/stakeholder/{invite_code}/accept` | None (anonymous; gated by valid invite_code + SSO completion) | Magic-link redemption endpoint. Returns the redirect URL post-resolution. |

**Concrete request/response example — issue invite.**

```http
Authorization: Bearer srck_org_abc_xxx
Idempotency-Key: m1-issue-2026-04-15-001
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "stakeholder_email": "cfo@buyer-co.com",
  "stakeholder_display_name": "Jane Doe",
  "stakeholder_role_label": "cfo",
  "assigned_use_case_ids": [],
  "personal_message": "Per our 4/14 sync — ready for your sign-off."
}
```

```http
HTTP/1.1 201 Created
X-RateLimit-Limit: 5000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 4986
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "data": {
    "id": "m1inv_01HXYZ...",
    "workspace_id": "ws_def",
    "inviter_user_id": "usr_inv1",
    "stakeholder_email": "cfo@buyer-co.com",
    "stakeholder_display_name": "Jane Doe",
    "stakeholder_role_label": "cfo",
    "assigned_use_case_ids": [],
    "phase_floor_at_issuance": 12,
    "redemption_status": "pending",
    "email_send_status": "queued",
    "expires_at": "2026-04-29T16:30:00Z",

```

**Error responses follow §32.6 schema.** New error codes (Appendix I update below): `m1_stakeholder_invite_phase_too_early` (HTTP 422), `m1_workspace_stakeholder_ceiling_exceeded` (HTTP 422), `m1_inviter_rate_limit_exceeded` (HTTP 429), `stakeholder_invite_cross_org_access` (HTTP 404), `m1_invite_code_invalid_or_expired` (HTTP 410, accept endpoint), `m1_invite_already_redeemed` (HTTP 409, accept endpoint).

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. M1 invite issuance MUST be hard-gated to `workspace.phase ≥ 8`; pre-Phase-8 attempts MUST return HTTP 422 `m1_stakeholder_invite_phase_too_early`.
2. The per-inviter rate cap (10/24h) MUST be enforced atomically; concurrent issuance attempts that would breach the cap MUST return HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`.
3. The per-Workspace stakeholder ceiling (25) MUST be enforced atomically; over-ceiling returns HTTP 422 `m1_workspace_stakeholder_ceiling_exceeded`.
4. Magic-link redemption MUST resolve to exactly one of the four `redemption_path_kind` values; ambiguous resolution MUST raise an `analytics_invariant_violation` PagerDuty alert AND fail closed (the recipient sees a friendly "We couldn't complete your sign-in; please contact the inviter" page).
5. Magic-link expiration MUST be enforced server-side at exactly `created_at + 14 days`; clock drift > 5 minutes raises a §42 P2 alert.
6. Read-receipt event de-duplication MUST limit `read_receipt_event_count` increments to one per `(invite_id, session_id, hour)`; QA test `m1_read_receipt_dedup` asserts.
7. Workspace phase regression below 8 MUST suspend all redeemed M1 Guest Memberships within 60 seconds AND emit `m1.access.suspended` notifications.
8. SIM cross-Workspace velocity-anomaly detection (≥ 5 distinct buyer Orgs inviting the same `stakeholder_email` within 30d) MUST defer the 6th-onward invite to the Ops review queue within 5 minutes of the threshold cross.
9. Vendor Opt-Out registry check MUST silently suppress invites to opted-out emails per §48.4.9 confidentiality; the inviter receives the generic `growth_loop_anti_spam_target_suppressed` error with no leak of the opt-out reason.
10. M1 webhooks MUST exclude `stakeholder_email` and `stakeholder_display_name` fields entirely; only `stakeholder_email_domain_hash` is exposed.
11. The full M1 funnel `m1_invite_issued → m1_invite_clicked → m1_invite_redeemed → m1_read_receipt_recorded` MUST be PostHog-Insights-Funnels queryable per `org_id`, per `inviter_user_id`, and per `stakeholder_role_label`.
12. M1 invite issuance MUST be visible in the §6.7 Audit Log with `audit_action_type=m1_stakeholder_invite_issued` (Appendix J update); revocation logs as `m1_stakeholder_invite_revoked`.

#### Failure Modes Addressed

1. **Inviter mistypes the recipient email and the invite goes to the wrong person.** Resolved: bounce-back triggers `m1.invite.bounced` notification with one-click Revoke + Resend; if the email reaches a real but wrong recipient (typo to a valid address), the recipient sees the inviter name + Workspace name on the magic-link landing page and can decline by simply not redeeming; the inviter sees zero `m1_invite_clicked` events and can revoke after a sensible window. Auditable.
2. **Stakeholder forwards the magic-link email to a colleague.** Resolved: redemption is single-use AND the redeeming user must complete SSO with the email address that was invited. If the colleague's email differs from `stakeholder_email`, redemption is REJECTED with HTTP 403 `m1_invite_email_mismatch` (Appendix I — new) AND emits `m1_invite_redemption_email_mismatch` PostHog event for SIM correlation. The colleague is shown a "Ask the inviter to send you your own invite" message.
3. **Workspace phase regresses below 8 mid-session while a stakeholder is reading the Selection Report.** Resolved: phase regression triggers immediate Guest-Membership suspension (per AC #7); the stakeholder's session is invalidated on next request with HTTP 403 `workspace_access_suspended_phase_regressed` (Appendix I — new) and a friendly redirect page. No data leakage; auditable in the StakeholderInvite row's `revoked_reason=phase_regressed_below_8`. When the Workspace re-advances to Phase 8+, suspended Memberships are auto-restored AND `m1.access.restored` notification (Appendix C extension) is sent.
4. **Inviter is removed from the Workspace before all their issued invites are redeemed.** Resolved: existing pending invites remain valid (the recipient's view continues to attribute the invite to the original inviter for audit clarity); the new Workspace Owner inherits the ability to revoke pending invites OR resend them under the new Workspace Owner's name (a `m1_invite_inviter_reassigned` audit event is logged). This avoids orphaning invites when team composition changes mid-evaluation.
5. **Stakeholder loses access to their original SSO identity provider (e.g., changed jobs).** Resolved: read-only Guest Membership persists until explicitly revoked; on next access, the recipient may re-authenticate with any matching email per §6.1 — or the inviter may revoke and re-issue to a new email address with a new role label (`recipient_left_company` is a registered `revoked_reason` value).

### 48.5.2 M2 Selection Report Public Link (Watermarked) {#48.5.2-m2-selection-report-public-link}

#### Purpose

M2 turns the §10.12 Selection Report — the Phase-12 artifact that captures vendor rankings, the recommended primary vendor, and rationale — into a shareable public artifact via a watermarked, per-section-redactable public link. The mechanic exists because procurement teams already share Selection Reports outside the organization (LinkedIn case studies, RFP-response social proof, board pre-reads, vendor-side marketing collateral) and the historical practice has been ad-hoc PDF exports stripped by hand; M2 brings the share into the platform with cryptographic provenance, retroactive Vendor Opt-Out honoring, configurable per-section redaction, and a watermark that brands every page as "Selected via Sourcera." M2 is the active replacement for the retired L3 Loop (§48.2.4).

#### Trigger

A Workspace Owner OR Org Owner clicks "Generate Public Link" on the Selection Report header > Share panel. The trigger is gated to `workspace.phase ≥ 12` (Phase 12 = Selection & Recommendation per §10.12) AND `selection_report.status='approved'` (per §10.12 Step 5 approval workflow OR §10.12 Step 4 if no approval workflow is configured for the Org). Pre-approval attempts return HTTP 422 `m2_selection_report_not_approved` (Appendix I — new). Workspaces in `phase=13_closed` MAY ALSO generate M2 public links (the artifact is more useful post-closure for case-study sharing).

#### Actor & Entity Schema

**Acting entity.** Buyer Org user with `org_owner`, `org_admin`, OR `workspace_owner` role on the Workspace. The §5.11 Feature Access Matrix is updated to include the row "Generate M2 Public Selection Report Link" with these three roles ✓ and all others ✗ (see appendix-update block).

**Targeted entity.** The §10.12 Selection Report — a denormalized snapshot at the moment of M2 publication.

**New entity: PublicSelectionReport (Workspace-Originated, Marketplace-Domain, Public).** A Marketplace-domain entity per §4.5 governance (publicly readable; renders to anonymous viewers; honors §4.5.6 Vendor Opt-Out Render Contract; respects §4.4.8 retroactive opt-out scans).

| Field | Type | Constraints | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `id` | UUID | PK, immutable | Standard. |
| `org_id` | UUID (FK) | → Organization (§4.2.1); buyer Org; required | RBAC scope for write/manage; reads are public. |
| `console` | Enum | `buyer` (fixed) | M2 is buyer-originated. |
| `workspace_id` | UUID (FK) | → Workspace (§4.3.1); required | The Workspace whose Selection Report is being shared. |
| `selection_report_snapshot_id` | UUID (FK) | → SelectionReport entity (§10.12; placeholder Known Gap noted in RECONCILIATION.md — full SelectionReport entity authoring deferred); required | The frozen snapshot of the report content at publication. |
| `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` | String | SHA-256, 64 chars | Provenance — proves the public-link content matches the workspace's approved Selection Report at the publication moment; used to detect drift. |
| `share_slug` | String | 14 chars, URL-safe Base32, unique platform-wide | Materialized as the URL path component: `https://reports.sourcera.io/{share_slug}`. Random per row. |
| `link_visibility` | Enum | Appendix J `m2_link_visibility` (new): `link_only_unguessable`, `password_protected`, `email_allowlist` | The access-control posture chosen at publication. |
| `password_hash` | String | Argon2id hash, 256 chars; nullable | Required IFF `link_visibility=password_protected`; never logged; rotated via republish. |
| `email_allowlist_domains` | Array[String] | ≤ 50 entries; lowercased; ≤ 253 chars each | Required IFF `link_visibility=email_allowlist`; visitor must complete §6.1 SSO (Google/Microsoft) and resolve to a domain in this list. |
| `redaction_profile` | JSON | Schema per §48.5.2.x below; ≤ 4,000 chars | Per-section redaction toggles. |
| `watermark_config` | JSON | Schema per §48.5.2.x below; ≤ 1,000 chars | Watermark text + position + opacity overrides. |
| `watermark_text_resolved` | String | ≤ 200 chars | The exact rendered watermark string, computed at publication. |
| `cover_kind` | Enum | Appendix J `m2_cover_kind` (new): `default_branded`, `buyer_logo_only`, `no_cover` | Cover-page treatment. |
| `expiry_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Optional auto-expiry; null = no expiry. |
| `revoked_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Set on revocation. |
| `revoked_by_user_id` | UUID (FK) | Nullable; → User (§4.2.3) | Inviter, Workspace Owner, Org Owner, OR Ops. |
| `revoked_reason` | Enum | Appendix J `m2_revoked_reason` (new): `inviter_changed_mind`, `vendor_opt_out_breakage`, `selection_report_corrected`, `legal_takedown`, `ops_security_action`, `other` | Required when `revoked_at` non-null. |
| `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Last time the §4.4.8 retroactive opt-out scan re-applied to this row. |
| `vendor_opt_out_redacted_vendor_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; default 0 | Number of vendor identities currently redacted on this rendered link. |
| `view_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; default 0 | Anonymous + authenticated cumulative loads (debounced 1/min/IP). |
| `unique_visitor_count_30d` | Integer | ≥ 0; default 0 | Distinct IP-address-hash count, rolling 30-day window. |
| `download_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; default 0 | Cumulative PDF downloads. |
| `last_viewed_at` | Timestamp | Nullable | Updated per view event. |
| `published_at` | Timestamp | Required | Publication moment. |
| `republished_count` | Integer | ≥ 0; default 0 | Number of republish operations (each republish updates `selection_report_snapshot_id`, `share_slug` is unchanged, `password_hash` MAY rotate). |
| `signal_integrity_flags` | Array[Enum] | Per §48.2.12 enum; empty array default | SIM-populated. |
| `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`, `updated_by`, `deleted_at` | Standard | Standard pattern | `created_by` MUST hold one of the three eligible roles. Soft delete equivalent to `revoked_by_user_id=ops_user_id` + `revoked_reason=ops_security_action`. |

**Scope isolation.** The PublicSelectionReport row is org-scoped on `org_id` for write/manage; the rendered public surface is governed by the §4.5 Marketplace-Domain Render Contract: anonymous reads are gated by (a) `share_slug` URL match; (b) `link_visibility` enforcement (password OR email-allowlist); (c) `revoked_at IS NULL`; (d) `expiry_at > now OR expiry_at IS NULL`; (e) §4.5.6 Vendor Opt-Out re-application before render. Cross-Org enumeration is blocked: the `share_slug` is unguessable (14 chars Base32 ≈ 70 bits entropy) and the row is never listed in any cross-Org index.

**Required indexes.** `(org_id, workspace_id, published_at DESC)` per-Org list view; `(share_slug)` UNIQUE (read path); `(vendor_opt_out_redacted_at)` (sparse; opt-out resweep job); `(expiry_at) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expiry_at IS NOT NULL` (nightly expiry sweep); `(workspace_id)` (per-Workspace public-link inventory).

**Retention.** Workspace-life + 7 years for the row metadata (audit + Stripe-billing relevance for §48.3 conversion attribution). The rendered HTML/PDF artifact is regenerated on every load from `selection_report_snapshot_id` + `redaction_profile`; no separate cached HTML is stored beyond the §31 edge-cache TTL (60s default; tunable). DSAR pseudonymization applies to `created_by`, `revoked_by_user_id`, AND any author-name fields embedded in the snapshot per §6.8 redaction rules.

##### PublicSelectionReport Lifecycle State Machine

The `lifecycle_state` of a PublicSelectionReport is derived from the `revoked_at` and `expiry_at` fields per the table below; the entity has no explicit enum field for state because the state is fully determined by the two timestamps. The state machine documents the user-facing access semantics.

| From (Computed State) | To | Trigger | Conditions | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| (init) | `published_active` | POST publish | All publish gates pass | `published_at`, `share_slug`, `selection_report_snapshot_id` populated; `revoked_at IS NULL`; `expiry_at > now OR IS NULL`. |
| `published_active` | `published_active` | PATCH republish | Caller holds eligible role | `republished_count` increments; `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` refreshes; `share_slug` preserved. |
| `published_active` | `revoked` | DELETE | Inviter / Workspace Owner / Org Owner / Ops | `revoked_at`, `revoked_by_user_id`, `revoked_reason` populated; edge cache busted within 60s; public render returns HTTP 410 `m2_link_revoked`. |
| `published_active` | `expired` | Nightly sweep at `expiry_at` | `expiry_at IS NOT NULL` AND `now > expiry_at` AND `revoked_at IS NULL` | Public render returns HTTP 410 `m2_link_expired`; inviter notified via `m2.link.expired`. |
| `expired` | `published_active` | PATCH republish (extending OR removing `expiry_at`) | Caller holds eligible role | Restores public access. |
| `revoked` | (terminal) | n/a | n/a | Append-only post-revocation; only Ops MAY un-revoke via emergency procedure (logged separately). |
| `published_active` (with vendor-name redactions) | `published_active` (with additional redactions) | Nightly Vendor-Opt-Out resweep | New §4.4.8 opt-out filed since `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at` | `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at` updates; `vendor_opt_out_redacted_vendor_count` increments; render reflects within 60-min cache TTL. |

**Invariants.** (a) `share_slug` is immutable across all transitions; republish never changes it. (b) `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` mutates ONLY on republish; QA test asserts. (c) The public render path MUST always re-derive content from `selection_report_snapshot_id` + current `redaction_profile`; cached HTML beyond the 60s edge TTL is forbidden.

#### Per-Section Redaction Profile Schema

The `redaction_profile` JSON controls what content from the underlying Selection Report is included in the rendered public artifact. Toggle granularity is per-section; redactions are additive (anything turned off is hidden; nothing is exposed unless explicitly enabled OR enabled by default).

| Section Key | Default Visible | Description | Redaction Replacement |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| `executive_summary` | true | The procurement-goals narrative + recommendation summary. | If false, section omitted entirely from PDF / web. |
| `vendor_rankings_table` | true | The ranked vendor table with per-vendor weighted scores. | If false, replaced with "Vendor rankings withheld at the buyer's discretion." |
| `vendor_names_visible` | true | Whether vendor names are spelled out OR replaced with "Vendor A / B / C" pseudonyms. | If false, the rankings table and per-vendor sections render with stable pseudonyms. |
| `winning_vendor_section` | true | The named-winning-vendor section (rationale, evidence). | If false, replaced with a generic "Recommendation withheld" placeholder. |
| `losing_vendors_sections` | true | Per-losing-vendor rationale paragraphs. | If false, sections omitted. |
| `scoring_rubric_appendix` | false | The full scoring rubric used. | If true, rubric appended to PDF. |
| `requirements_appendix` | false | Per-Use-Case requirement list. | If true, appended; redacts requirement statements that the Workspace Owner has flagged `confidential=true`. |
| `tco_appendix` | false | TCO projection per vendor (§15). | If true, appended; never includes per-vendor unit pricing if the underlying TCO data flagged `pricing_confidential=true`. |
| `evaluator_names_visible` | false | Whether individual evaluator names appear in the report. | If false, evaluators rendered as "Evaluator A / B / C." |
| `internal_comments_visible` | false (NEVER overrideable to true) | Internal Comments (§4.3.11) must NEVER leak to the public surface. | Hard-coded false; the API REJECTS publication with HTTP 422 `m2_redaction_profile_internal_comments_must_be_false` if a client sends `true`. |
| `org_logo_inclusion` | true | Buyer Org logo on cover page. | If false, omitted. |
| `signoff_signatures_visible` | false | Workspace Owner / Approver signatures. | If true, only role labels (e.g., "CFO") are shown; never names — name leakage is hard-blocked at render. |

**Redaction profile validation rules.** At publish: (a) JSON validates against §48.5.2.x JSON schema (Appendix J registers the schema reference); (b) `internal_comments_visible` MUST be `false` else HTTP 422; (c) any unknown key returns HTTP 422 `m2_redaction_profile_unknown_key`; (d) any value other than Boolean for a Boolean-typed key returns HTTP 422 `m2_redaction_profile_invalid_value_type`. Stored as canonicalized JSON for stable hashing.

**Republish semantics.** Mutating the `redaction_profile` requires a republish — the same `share_slug` is preserved, but `republished_count` increments AND a new `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` is computed. The `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at` resweep is forced. Republish emits `m2_link_republished` PostHog event. Vendor opt-outs filed BETWEEN publish and republish are honored at republish; this is in addition to the periodic retro sweep.

#### Watermark Spec

The watermark is rendered server-side on every PDF page AND as a CSS overlay on every web-rendered page. Its purpose is provenance + brand: every shared artifact MUST be attributable to Sourcera AND to the issuing buyer Org so downstream readers know the origin and so unauthorized reproduction is detectable.

**Watermark layers (from back to front).**

1. **Diagonal page-fill text watermark (PDF + web).** Default text: `Selected via Sourcera — {Buyer Org Display Name} — {Workspace Name} — {published_at YYYY-MM-DD}`. Override via `watermark_config.text_override` (max 200 chars; subject to §48.4.4 content validators); empty override falls back to default. Rendered at 45° angle, repeated to fill the page, opacity 0.10 (`#1a1a1a` text color), font Inter Medium (web fallback `system-ui`), font-size 14pt.
2. **Sourcera footer logo (PDF + web).** Sourcera wordmark + small "Selected via Sourcera" badge in the bottom-right of every PDF page; on web, fixed-position bottom-right with matching styling. Footer never overridable; clicking the badge on web opens a new tab to `https://sourcera.io/about-selection-reports` (a public marketing page describing the artifact's authenticity + verifiability).
3. **Page-corner provenance hash (PDF only).** The first 8 chars of `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` rendered in 6pt monospace at the bottom-left of every PDF page (e.g., `verify: a3f9b2c4`). This lets a reader in possession of the PDF cross-check provenance against the public link's verification endpoint (see API endpoint `GET /v1/public-reports/{share_slug}/verify` below).

**Watermark config schema.**

```json
{
  "text_override": "Optional custom watermark string ≤ 200 chars",
  "opacity_override": 0.10,
  "footer_badge_disabled": false,
  "provenance_hash_disabled": false
}
```

`opacity_override` is range-bounded `[0.05, 0.25]`; out-of-range returns HTTP 422 `m2_watermark_opacity_out_of_range`. `footer_badge_disabled` and `provenance_hash_disabled` MAY be `true` only when the M2 link is provisioned for a Sourcera Sales-Ops co-marketing case-study (a special `co_marketing_authorized=true` flag set by Ops on the row); customer attempts to set either to `true` return HTTP 403 `m2_watermark_disable_unauthorized`. The `co_marketing_authorized` flag is registered as an Authored Extension in RECONCILIATION.md (rationale: case-study microsites need flexibility but the default is non-overridable provenance).

#### Workflow

1. **Pre-publish gate.** UI verifies (a) inviter holds an eligible role; (b) `workspace.phase ≥ 12` AND `selection_report.status='approved'`; (c) per-Org M2 publication ceiling: 100 active PublicSelectionReport rows per Org (§39 update; rationale: prevents enumeration abuse while accommodating case-study volumes). Above ceiling → HTTP 422 `m2_org_active_link_ceiling_exceeded`.
2. **Publication modal.** UI fields: `link_visibility` (radio: `link_only_unguessable`, `password_protected`, `email_allowlist`); password input (if password_protected; ≥ 12 chars; subject to §6.1 password complexity); allowlist domains input (if email_allowlist); `redaction_profile` (per-section toggles per the table above); watermark text override; cover_kind selector; optional expiry date picker. Live preview pane on the right side of the modal renders the to-be-published artifact (using the same render path as the public surface, with a "PREVIEW" overlay).
3. **Server validation.** Schema validation per §48.5.2.x; password complexity check; allowlist-domain syntax check; §48.4.4 content validators on `watermark_config.text_override` and on any free-text fields in the snapshot; §4.4.8 Vendor Opt-Out scan against ALL vendors named in the snapshot — vendors with active opt-outs at publish time are pre-redacted (replaced with "Vendor Opted Out" labels) and the inviter is shown a banner: "{N} vendor names will be redacted due to active opt-outs." Inviter MAY proceed, OR cancel and consult.
4. **Publication write.** PublicSelectionReport row written; `share_slug` generated; `selection_report_snapshot_id` frozen; `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` computed; `watermark_text_resolved` populated; `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at = published_at`; `vendor_opt_out_redacted_vendor_count` populated.
5. **Edge cache warm.** The render path is invoked once at publish to populate the §31 edge cache; subsequent anonymous loads hit the cache.
6. **Inviter receives confirmation.** UI shows the `share_slug` URL with copy button; the email channel sends a `m2.public_link.published` confirmation (Appendix C extension below).
7. **Public access.** Anonymous viewer hits `https://reports.sourcera.io/{share_slug}`. Server: (a) verifies row exists, not revoked, not expired; (b) enforces `link_visibility` (password page OR SSO landing for allowlist); (c) re-runs Vendor Opt-Out scan if `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at` is older than the §4.4.8 60-second snapshot freshness floor; (d) renders HTML (web) OR PDF (download) per request `Accept` header.
8. **Read-receipt + view tracking.** Each successful render increments `view_count` (debounced 1/min/IP-hash); `unique_visitor_count_30d` updates via the daily aggregation job; `last_viewed_at` updates per view. PDF downloads emit `m2_pdf_downloaded`.
9. **Vendor Opt-Out retroactive scan (cross-cutting).** A nightly Ops-managed job at 02:30 UTC scans every active PublicSelectionReport row and re-applies any new Vendor Opt-Outs filed since `vendor_opt_out_redacted_at`. Newly affected rows have their cached render busted within 60 seconds AND emit `m2_link_vendor_opt_out_resweep_applied`. The Workspace Owner is notified via `m2.link.vendor_opt_out_applied` (Appendix C extension below) with the count of newly-redacted vendors.
10. **Republish.** Inviter MAY republish at any time to (a) update redaction profile; (b) rotate password; (c) extend / remove expiry; (d) refresh the snapshot to a corrected Selection Report (rare; only after an Ops-approved §10.12 correction). Republish preserves `share_slug` for link-stability AND increments `republished_count`.
11. **Revocation.** Inviter / Org Owner / Ops MAY revoke. Revocation removes the public access immediately (edge cache busted within 60s) AND replaces the public URL with a friendly "This link has been revoked" page.

#### UX Surfaces

| Surface | §3.3 Pattern | Notes |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| "Generate Public Link" button (Selection Report header > Share) | `Sidebar Navigation + Modal` per §3.3 | Visible only at `phase ≥ 12` AND `selection_report.status='approved'`. |
| Publication Modal with Live Preview | `Modal + Split View` per §3.3.3 | Left: form fields; right: live preview iframe; Cmd+S saves & publishes; Esc cancels. |
| Public Link Inventory (Workspace > Share > Public Links) | `Inline Table` per §3.3 | Per-row: share_slug URL, view count, unique visitors 30d, download count, opt-out redaction count, actions (copy, republish, revoke). |
| Public-facing artifact (anonymous) | Custom marketing-domain template; per §1.6 marketing domain | No Sourcera app chrome; cover page + watermarks per spec; sticky footer with Sourcera badge. |
| Password gate page | Single-CTA full-page route | Plaintext password input; rate-limited per IP (5 attempts / 10 min); after 5 failures, IP shown a friendly "Too many attempts" page. |
| Email-allowlist SSO landing | Single-CTA full-page route | Google / Microsoft SSO buttons; on completion, server checks resolved email's domain against `email_allowlist_domains`. |
| Mobile parity | Per §3.4 Mobile Translation | Modal becomes full-screen sheet; preview pane stacks below form on mobile. Public artifact responsive. |

**Empty / error / loading states.** First-time empty state on the Workspace Public Links inventory shows an explainer card: "Publish a watermarked, vendor-opt-out-aware version of your Selection Report for board pre-reads, case studies, or vendor-side social proof." Error states: per-bounce password retry inline message; per-revocation friendly explainer; per-expiry friendly "This link has expired" with optional "Contact the buyer" link if the Workspace Owner has enabled it.

**Accessibility (§37.1).** Public-facing artifact MUST meet WCAG 2.1 AA: contrast-compliant watermark (opacity ≤ 0.10 ensures background-text contrast); semantic HTML for screen readers; alt text on all graphical elements; PDF tagged for screen-reader navigation.

#### Data Collected / Retained

Per the PublicSelectionReport field table. The rendered artifact's contents are re-derived from `selection_report_snapshot_id`; no separate snapshot of the rendered HTML / PDF is stored (re-derivation guarantees retroactive opt-out semantics work). Anonymous viewer IP addresses are SHA-256-hashed before storage per §4.3.18; raw IPs never persist. The first-page `view_count` debouncing window key includes IP-hash and timestamp truncated to the minute.

**Residency.** The PublicSelectionReport row lives in the originating Org's data region. The rendered PDF is generated server-side in the Org's region and served via a globally-cached edge per §1.6.

#### Anti-Abuse Controls

1. **§48.4.4 content validators** — applied to `watermark_config.text_override` AND to all snapshot text fields at publish (XSS sanitizer, structured-data injection guard, profanity classifier, off-topic spam classifier per §48.4.4).
2. **§4.4.8 Vendor Opt-Out registry** — pre-applied at publish AND retroactively re-applied via the §48.5.2 nightly resweep job; never overridable by the inviter.
3. **Per-Org publication ceiling (100 active rows).** §39 update; HTTP 422 above ceiling.
4. **Password rate-limit (5 attempts / 10 min per IP).** Prevents brute-force password guess.
5. **Email-allowlist SSO requirement.** Allowlist visibility ALWAYS requires §6.1 SSO completion — no email-only entry.
6. **`internal_comments_visible` hard-locked false.** Server REJECTS publish with HTTP 422 if a client sends true. QA test `m2_internal_comments_never_leak` asserts.
7. **Watermark provenance hash never disabled (default).** Co-marketing exemption requires Ops `co_marketing_authorized=true` flag; customer attempts to disable return HTTP 403.
8. **Edge cache TTL bounded.** Default 60s; never tunable above 600s. Prevents stale render after opt-out filing.
9. **Snapshot drift detection.** Nightly QA job recomputes `selection_report_snapshot_payload_hash` from `selection_report_snapshot_id` and compares to stored value; mismatches raise `analytics_invariant_violation` PagerDuty alert (per §48.4 SIM AC #5).
10. **§48.4.8 SuppressionList lookup.** Buyer Orgs on the SuppressionList are blocked from publishing M2 links; HTTP 422 `growth_loop_anti_spam_target_suppressed`.

#### Plan Gating & Entitlement

M2 is included on every Buyer plan tier (Free, Starter, Growth, Scale, Enterprise) with the per-Org publication ceiling of 100 active rows being universal per §39 update. Rationale: M2 is a customer-acquisition mechanic for Sourcera (every public link carries the Sourcera footer + verification page link); gating it would suppress the supply-side viral coefficient. The §5.11 Feature Access Matrix update restricts the role authorization to `org_owner`, `org_admin`, `workspace_owner`. Co-marketing watermark-disable flag (`co_marketing_authorized=true`) is Ops-only; never customer-self-serve.
